sentences: My second cousin came to our family dinner. 我的遠房表親來參加我們家的晚餐。
She only meets her second cousin during New Year holidays. 她只有過年時才會見到遠房堂親。
The second hand on this clock is broken. 這個時鐘的秒針壞了。
I watched the second hand move around the dial. 我看著秒針繞著錶面移動。
He is currently studying at a local secondary school in Taipei. 他目前就讀於台北的一所當地中學。
Improving public health is our secondary goal after education. 提升公共衛生是我們繼教育之後的第二目標。
Secondary education usually begins after elementary school. 中等教育通常在小學之後開始。
The city is investing more money in secondary education. 這座城市正投入更多經費在中等教育上。
My brother teaches history at a secondary school. 我哥哥在一所中學教歷史。
She moved to a new secondary school last year. 她去年轉到一所新的中學。
I bought a secondhand desk from my neighbor. 我跟鄰居買了一張二手書桌。
His secondhand story missed a few details. 他轉述來的消息少了幾個細節。

meaning: 隱蔽；秘密或隱藏的情況。
sentences: The project was planned in complete secrecy. 這項計畫完全秘密進行。
She disliked the secrecy around the decision. 她不喜歡這個決定背後的保密做法。
Please keep this information secret and don't tell anyone. 請對這項資訊保密，不要告訴任何人。
The secret to a long life is a healthy diet and regular exercise. 長壽的秘訣是健康的飲食與規律的運動。
She handles most of the secretarial work in the office. 她負責辦公室大部分的秘書工作。
The course teaches basic secretarial skills. 這門課教授基本秘書技能。

meaning: 政府秘書的辦公室或部門。
sentences: The secretariat sent the meeting schedule this morning. 秘書處今天早上寄出了會議時程。
Please leave the form with the secretariat. 請把表格交給秘書處。
The secretary is responsible for managing the manager's schedule. 秘書負責管理經理的行程。
She works as a legal secretary in a large law firm. 她在一家大型律師事務所擔任法律秘書。
Sweat is a natural secretion of the body. 汗水是人體自然分泌物。
The doctor checked the wound for unusual secretion. 醫師檢查傷口是否有異常分泌物。
She's a secretive girl, not giving away much about her life. 她是個神秘的女孩，很少透露自己的生活。
Why are you acting all secretive? What are you hiding? 為什麼你表現得很神秘？你在隱藏什麼？
She secretly wrapped the gift in the kitchen. 她偷偷地在廚房包禮物。
I secretly hoped the rain would stop. 我暗自希望雨快點停。
The small sect met in a quiet hall. 這個小教派在安靜的大廳聚會。
The book compares one sect with another. 這本書比較不同派別。

meaning: 屬於某個教派、與某個教派有關或部分屬於某個教派。
sentences: We were discussing solutions to the sectarian violence between Sunnis and Shias. 我們正在討論遜尼派和什葉派之間宗派暴力的解決方案。
Something described as sectarian is of, relating to, or partial to a sect. 被描述為宗派的事物屬於某個教派、與某個教派有關或部分屬於某個教派。
The library has a large section dedicated to historical novels. 圖書館有一個專門放歷史小說的大區域。
Please check the business section of the newspaper for the news. 請查看報紙的商業版塊以獲取新聞。
The U.S. civil war can be considered a sectional dispute. 美國內戰可以被視為局部爭端。
Something described as sectional is relating to conflict between areas. 被描述為局部的東西與區域之間的衝突有關。
The service sector is the largest part of the country's economy today. 服務業（部門）是當前該國經濟中最大的部分。
Significant investments are being made in the private sector to boost growth. 為了刺激增長，正對私營部門（領域）進行重大投資。
The school is secular, not tied to any church. 這所學校是世俗的，不隸屬任何教會。
They held a secular memorial at the park. 他們在公園舉辦了一場非宗教的追思會。
Please make sure you secure all the doors and windows before leaving the house. 離開房子前，請確保鎖好（固定好）所有的門窗。
The company managed to secure a major contract with a global technology firm. 該公司成功與一家全球科技公司簽署（獲得）了一份重大合約。

meaning: 以安全的方式；沒有恐懼或憂慮；無危險。
sentences: Check all personal items are securely stowed in the overhead lockers. 檢查所有個人物品是否安全存放在頭頂儲物櫃。
If someone acts securely, they do so in a way that is in a secure manner; without fear or apprehension; without danger. 如果某人的行為是安全的，那麼他們就會以安全的方式這樣做；沒有恐懼或憂慮；無危險。
The guard checked security at the back gate. 警衛查看後門的安全狀況。
A steady job gave her some financial security. 穩定的工作帶給她一些經濟保障。
My uncle drives a blue sedan to work. 我叔叔開一輛藍色轎車上班。
The rental sedan was easy to park. 租來的轎車很好停。
The hotel lobby had a sedate atmosphere. 飯店大廳有一種沉穩莊重的氣氛。
He gave a sedate answer instead of arguing. 他沒有爭辯，而是沉著地回答。
The dentist used light sedation during the procedure. 牙醫在治療過程中使用了輕度鎮靜。
She felt sleepy after the sedation wore off. 鎮靜效果退去後，她覺得很想睡。
The doctor gave him a mild sedative before surgery. 手術前，醫師給了他溫和的鎮靜劑。
Do not drive after taking a sedative. 服用鎮靜劑後不要開車。

meaning: 不動；相對靜止；住在附近。
sentences: The oyster is a sedentary mollusk; the barnacles are sedentary crustaceans. 牡蠣是一種久坐的軟體動物。藤壺是定居的甲殼類動物。
Something described as sedentary is not moving; relatively still; staying in the vicinity. 被描述為久坐的東西並不是在移動；相對靜止；住在附近。

meaning: 從河流或其他水體中沉澱出來的小顆粒的集合，特別是污垢。
sentences: Sediment settled at the bottom of the bottle. 沉澱物沉在瓶底。
Heavy rain carried sediment into the river. 大雨把泥沙沖進河裡。
The billionaire was seduced by the glamour and excitement of the big city. 這位億萬富翁被大城市的魅力與刺激所誘惑（吸引）。
It is wrong to try and seduce someone into committing a serious crime. 試圖引誘某人犯重罪是不對的。

meaning: 玩弄女性的人, 騙子
sentences: In the novel, the seducer wins trust with sweet words. 在小說裡，那名誘惑者用甜言蜜語取得信任。
The story warns readers not to trust a smooth seducer. 這個故事提醒讀者不要輕信花言巧語的騙子。
The advertisement relies on the seduction of luxury. 這則廣告靠奢華感來吸引人。
He understood the seduction of easy money. 他明白輕鬆賺錢的誘惑。

meaning: 加 诱人的，有吸引力的
sentences: The cake had a seductive smell of butter and sugar. 那個蛋糕散發出奶油和糖的誘人香氣。
The idea sounded seductive, but it was too risky. 這個想法聽起來很吸引人，但風險太高。
The play presents the seductress as clever and lonely. 這齣戲把那名誘惑者描寫得聰明又孤單。
In the old film, the seductress hides her real plan. 在那部老電影裡，那名女騙子隱藏了真正的計畫。
Her sedulity helped the team finish the report early. 她的勤勉讓團隊提早完成報告。
The coach praised his sedulity during practice. 教練稱讚他練習時很勤奮。

meaning: 四 勤勉的,和勤苦工作的
sentences: He was sedulous about checking every detail. 他很勤勉地檢查每個細節。
A sedulous student reviewed the notes every night. 一位勤奮的學生每晚複習筆記。
It was so dark that I could hardly see anything in front of me. 天太黑了，我幾乎看不見面前的任何東西。
I'll see you at the cinema entrance at 7:00 p.m. tonight. 我們今晚七點在電影院門口見。
Farmers sow seeds in the spring and harvest crops in the autumn. 農夫在春天播種，在秋天收穫。
The little bird was happily pecking at the sunflower seeds. 小鳥正開心地啄食著向日葵種子。

meaning: 四 無籽的, 無核的
sentences: I bought seedless grapes for the children. 我買了無籽葡萄給孩子們。
Seedless watermelon is easy to eat at a picnic. 野餐時吃無籽西瓜很方便。
Seeing her smile made everyone feel better. 看到她微笑，大家心情都變好了。
He left early after seeing the dark clouds. 他看到烏雲後就提早離開了。
They decided to seek professional advice before making a decision. 他們決定在做出決定前尋求專業建議。
The refugees are seeking asylum in neighboring countries. 難民們正向鄰國尋求庇護。
Every job seeker should prepare a clear resume. 每位求職者都應準備清楚的履歷。
The mountain trail attracted many adventure seekers. 這條山路吸引了許多冒險者。
It seems that we will have good weather for our picnic tomorrow. 看起來我們明天的野餐會有好天氣。
She seems to be very happy with her new job and colleagues. 她似乎對她的新工作和同事感到非常滿意。

meaning: 以得體的方式；莊重地;有禮地。
sentences: If someone acts seemingly, they do so in a way that is in a seemly manner; decorously; with propriety. 如果某人的行為看似合理，那麼他的行為方式就很得體；莊重地;與禮。
The speaker responded seemingly during the discussion. 說話者似乎在討論中做出了回應。
It seems cold outside today. 今天外面似乎很冷。
She seems happy with her new job. 她看起來很喜歡新工作。
I have seen this movie twice. 這部電影我已經看過兩次。
She had never seen snow before that winter. 在那個冬天以前，她從沒看過雪。

meaning: 一到這座海濱城市,他的錢包就被偷了,所以他不得不
sentences: The villagers believed the old seer could predict storms. 村民相信那位老先知能預測暴風雨。
In the story, a seer warns the king about danger. 故事中，一位預言者警告國王有危險。
The children were playing on the seesaw at the neighborhood park. 孩子們正在社區公園玩蹺蹺板。
The price of gold has been seesawing up and down lately. 金價最近一直起伏不定。
He was seething after the rude phone call. 接完那通無禮的電話後，他氣得冒火。
She sat there seething while others laughed. 別人發笑時，她坐在那裡氣得發抖。
The market is divided into several different segments based on age and income. 市場根據年齡和收入劃分為幾個不同的部分。
She cut the orange into segments and shared them with the children. 她把橘子切成片（切片）分給孩子們。

meaning: 分成片段的行為或實例。
sentences: Customer segmentation helped the shop plan its discounts. 顧客分群幫助商店規劃折扣。
The app uses image segmentation to find the face in a photo. 這個程式用影像分割找出照片中的臉。

meaning: 一種長網，頂部附有浮子，底部附有沈子（重物），用於淺水中捕魚。
sentences: The fishermen pulled the seine slowly toward the shore. 漁夫們慢慢把圍網拉向岸邊。
A long seine caught many small fish in the shallow water. 一張長圍網在淺水區捕到許多小魚。
The lab tracks seismic activity under the island. 實驗室追蹤島嶼下方的地震活動。
That vote caused a seismic shift in local politics. 那次投票在地方政治上造成巨大變動。
The opportunity was too good to miss, so he decided to seize it immediately. 這個機會太好了，不能錯過，所以他決定立即抓住它。
The police seized a large quantity of illegal drugs during the raid last night. 警方在昨晚的突襲行動中沒收了大量的非法毒品。
The seizing of the goods surprised the shop owner. 貨物被扣押讓店主很驚訝。
Seizing the chance, she asked one more question. 她抓住機會又問了一個問題。

meaning: 透過武力或法律權利取得佔有的行為。
sentences: the seizure of a thief, a property, a throne, etc. 奪取小偷、財產、王位等
The search warrant permitted the seizure of evidence. 搜索令允許扣押證據。
He seldom goes to the cinema because he prefers watching at home. 他很少去電影院，因為他比較喜歡在家看。
It seldom rains in this desert region during the summer months. 這個沙漠地區在夏季幾個月裡很少下雨。
Please select your favorite color from the choices provided. 請從提供的選項中選擇您最喜歡的顏色。
Only a few elite students were selected for the exchange program. 只有少數精英學生被選中參加交換計畫。
The shop offers a wide selection of organic fruit and vegetables. 這家店提供多樣化的有機水果和蔬菜選擇。
The selection process for the scholarship was very rigorous. 獎學金的甄選過程非常嚴格。
The university has a very selective admission process for its new students. 大學對新生的錄取過程非常嚴格（精挑細選）。
He is very selective about the people he invites to his holiday parties. 他對邀請參加假期派對的人選非常挑剔（精挑細選）。

meaning: 以選擇性的方式，僅影響或適用於某些選定的案例。
sentences: If someone acts selectively, they do so in a way that is in a selective manner, only affecting or applying to some selected cases. 如果某人有選擇性地行動，他們就會以選擇性的方式這樣做，只影響或適用於某些選定的情況。
The speaker responded selectively during the discussion. 發言者在討論中選擇性地作出回應。

meaning: 選擇或選擇的某人或某事。
sentences: Use the selector to choose a different color. 使用選擇器挑選不同顏色。
The washing machine has a small selector for water level. 這台洗衣機有一個水位選擇鈕。
She took a deep interest in self-improvement and development. 她對自我提升與發展產生了濃厚的興趣。
It's important to be true to your true self and your beliefs. 忠於真實的自我與信念是很重要的。
It was very selfish of him to take all the credit for the work. 他獨攬所有工作功勞是非常自私的。
You should not be so selfish; try to think about other people. 你不應該這麼自私；試著為他人著想。
She is a selfless volunteer who devotes her time to helping others. 她是一位無私的志工，奉獻時間幫助他人。
The soldiers were praised for their selfless courage. 士兵們因其無私的勇氣而受到讚揚。
They decided to sell their old house and move to the city. 他們決定賣掉舊房子搬到城市。
The store sells a wide variety of fresh fruit and vegetables. 這家店銷售各式各樣的新鮮水果和蔬菜。

meaning: 賣東西的人；供應商；一名職員。
sentences: The seller packed the vase carefully. 賣家小心包裝花瓶。
Ask the seller if the bike has been repaired. 問問賣家這台腳踏車是否修過。
Selling homemade cookies helped the class raise money. 賣手工餅乾幫班上募到錢。
He is good at selling ideas to his team. 他很擅長向團隊推銷想法。

meaning: 為了經濟利益或其他利益而出賣自己的原則的人。
sentences: The concert was a sellout in two hours. 演唱會兩小時內就售罄。
Fans called the singer a sellout after the advertisement. 廣告播出後，粉絲說那位歌手出賣原則。

meaning: 瑣碎的或瑣碎的；狡辯, 挑剔。
sentences: Something described as semantic is petty or trivial; quibbling, niggling. 被描述為語義的東西是瑣碎的或瑣碎的；狡辯，挑剔。
The word semantic is often used to describe a person, thing, or situation. 語義一詞通常用於描述人、事物或情況。

meaning: 語言學的一個分支，研究詞的意義。
sentences: Semantics helps us understand how words carry meaning. 語意學幫助我們理解文字如何表達意思。
The argument was partly about semantics. 這場爭論部分是在爭語意。

meaning: 男性生殖器官產生的黏稠乳狀液體，含有生殖細胞。
sentences: The clinic tested the semen sample in the lab. 診所在實驗室檢測了精液樣本。
Semen analysis can help doctors check fertility problems. 精液分析可以幫助醫師檢查生育問題。
I'm taking five different courses this semester, including history and science. 我這學期修了五門不同的課程，包括歷史與科學。
The final exams are usually held at the end of each academic semester. 期末考試通常在每個學期末舉行。

meaning: 半拖車；牽引拖車；十八輪車；一篇文章。
sentences: A semi blocked the highway after the accident. 事故發生後，一輛半拖車擋住了高速公路。
The driver parked the semi behind the warehouse. 司機把半拖車停在倉庫後面。
A semicolon is used to separate two independent clauses in a sentence. 分號用於分隔句子中兩個獨立的子句。
Make sure you use the semicolon correctly in your essay. 確保在你的文章中正確使用分號。

meaning: 當輪只剩下四名球員或球隊的附加賽，決賽前的階段。
sentences: Our team lost in the semifinal last night. 我們隊昨晚在準決賽輸了。
She trained hard before the semifinal match. 準決賽前，她很努力訓練。

meaning: 極具影響力，特別是在某些原創方面，並為未來的發展或研究提供基礎。
sentences: "The Structure of Scientific Revolutions" was a seminal work in the modern philosophy of science. 《科學革命的結構》是現代科學哲學的一部開創性著作。
Something described as seminal is highly influential, especially in some original way, and providing a basis for future development or research. 被描述為開創性的東西具有很高的影響力，特別是以某種原創的方式，並為未來的發展或研究提供基礎。
The professor organized a weekly seminar to discuss recent scientific discoveries. 教授每週組織一次研討會來討論最近的科學發現。
All senior students are required to attend the graduation seminar next month. 所有大四學生都必須參加下個月的畢業研討會（討論課）。

meaning: 一位在外國神學院接受教育的羅馬天主教神父；神學院學生。
sentences: He studied theology at a seminary. 他在神學院讀神學。
The seminary library is quiet in the afternoon. 神學院圖書館下午很安靜。

meaning: 在一些兩院制立法體系中，上議院或眾議院。
sentences: The senate voted on the new budget today. 參議院今天表決了新預算。
She hopes to win a seat in the senate. 她希望贏得參議院席次。
The senator proposed a new bill to improve environmental protection laws. 參議員提出了一項改善環保法規的新法案。
She was elected as a senator for her state in the national elections last year. 她在去年的大選中當選為她所在州的參議員。
Please send me an email with the project details as soon as possible. 請傳送電子郵件給我告知專案細節，越快越好。
I need to send this package to my parents in New York. 我需要把這個包裹寄給在紐約的父母。
The sender forgot to write a return address. 寄件人忘了寫回郵地址。
Check the sender before opening the message. 打開訊息前先確認寄件人。
He is a senior software engineer with over ten years of work experience. 他是一位擁有超過十年工作經驗的資深軟體工程師。
The hotel offers special discounts for senior citizens on weekdays. 飯店在平日為年長者提供特別折扣。

meaning: 與其他成員相比，衡量一個人成為組織成員的時間長短，並著眼於向那些成為組織成員時間較長的人授予特權。
sentences: Promotion depends partly on seniority. 升遷部分取決於年資。
Her seniority gave her first choice of vacation dates. 她因年資較深，可以優先選休假日期。
She felt a strange burning sensation in her eyes and decided to see a doctor. 她感到眼睛有一種奇怪的灼熱感。
The young musician's debut album caused a major sensation in the music world. 這位年輕音樂家的首張專輯在樂壇引起了巨大的轟動。
The bakery's mango pie was sensational. 那家麵包店的芒果派好吃得不得了。
The paper ran a sensational headline about the arrest. 那家報紙用聳動標題報導那起逮捕。
I had a sense that someone was outside. 我有種有人在外面的感覺。
Her sense of direction is terrible. 她的方向感很差。
I sensed trouble when the dog stopped barking. 狗突然不叫時，我就察覺不對勁。
She sensed his worry before he spoke. 他還沒開口，她就感覺到他的擔心。
The argument felt senseless after a while. 吵到後來整件事顯得毫無意義。
The fall left him senseless for a minute. 那一摔讓他短暫失去知覺。

meaning: 對創造性表達或情感問題具有敏銳的敏感性；藝術或情感意識。
sentences: His design shows a modern sensibility. 他的設計展現出現代感。
The director has a strong visual sensibility. 那位導演有很強的視覺敏感度。
It's sensible to save some money for the future and unexpected expenses. 為未來與意外支出存點錢是明智的。
She gave a sensible explanation for why she was late for the meeting. 她對自己會議遲到給出了一個合理的解釋。
She has very sensitive skin and needs to use special soap. 她皮膚非常敏感，需要使用特殊的肥皂。
The manager was very sensitive to the employees' concerns. 經理對員工們關心的問題非常敏感。
The new sensor has a high level of sensitivity and can detect tiny vibrations. 新傳感器具有很高的靈敏度，可以檢測到微小的振動。
She is known for her sensitivity to the needs and feelings of others. 她以對他人需求和感受的敏感而聞名。
The automatic doors use a motion sensor to open when someone approaches. 自動門使用運動傳感器（感應器），當有人靠近時會自動打開。
The new car is equipped with various sensors to assist the driver with parking. 這輛新車配備了各種傳感器以輔助駕駛員停車。
The museum built a sensory room for kids. 那間博物館設了一間感官體驗室給孩子。
Strong soap can overwhelm my sensory system. 味道很重的肥皂會讓我的感官很受刺激。

meaning: 屬於或關於身體感官的；感官的。
sentences: Plato believed that this sensual world in which we live is inferior to the heavenly realm. 柏拉圖認為，我們所處的這個感官世界低於天堂境界。
Something described as sensual is of or pertaining to the physical senses; sensory. 被描述為感性的東西是屬於或與身體感官有關的；感官的。
The painting captures the sensuality of human form. 這幅畫捕捉了人體的性感。
Her voice carried a quiet sensuality. 她的聲音帶著沉靜的性感。

meaning: 貨幣的細分，等於愛沙尼亞克朗的百分之一。
sentences: The price was listed in kroons and sent. 價格以克朗和分為單位標示。
One sent was worth a small part of the old currency. 一分曾是舊貨幣中的小單位。
Could you please translate this English sentence into Chinese? 你能把這句英文句子翻譯成中文嗎？
The prisoner was given a ten-year sentence for his crimes. 該囚犯因其罪行被判處十年徒刑。
Consider fish, who are apparently sentient yet cognitively extremely primitive in comparison with humans. 以魚類為例，它們顯然具有感知能力，但與人類相比，其認知能力卻極為原始。

Obviously, other morally relevant considerations would apply to the case of a sentient fetus, as by acquiring sentience it acquires interests and moral status. 顯然，其他與道德相關的考慮因素也適用於有感知能力的胎兒，因為透過獲得感知能力，它獲得了利益和道德地位。
The public sentiment regarding the new policy is generally positive. 公眾對這項新政策的情緒（意見）總體上是積極的。
The letter was filled with warm sentiments and expressions of gratitude. 這封信充滿了溫慢的情感和感激之情。
She has a sentimental attachment to the old family home where she grew up. 她對自己成長的舊家有一種情感上的依戀。
He kept all the old letters for sentimental reasons, as they reminded him of his youth. 出於情感原因，他保留了所有舊信件，因為它們讓他想起了青春。

meaning: 電腦程式識別的唯一值，用於以特殊方式處理，或標記一組資料的結尾。
sentences: A sentinel stood at the gate all night. 一名哨兵整晚站在門口。
The program uses a sentinel value to mark the end of the list. 這個程式用哨兵值標記清單結尾。

meaning: 哨兵值班；當哨兵的時間。
sentences: The sentry checked every visitor at the gate. 哨兵在門口檢查每位訪客。
A tired sentry leaned against the wall. 一名疲憊的哨兵靠在牆邊。
The two countries are separated by a high mountain range. 這兩個國家被一座高山脈隔開。
It's important to keep your personal life separate from work. 將個人生活與工作分開是很重要的。

meaning: 以單獨的方式；不在一起；分開。
sentences: We've been living separately for three years. 我們已經分居三年了。
Tackle the different parts of the climb separately before attempting the whole thing in one go. 在嘗試一次完成整個攀爬之前，先分別完成攀登的不同部分。
The two countries signed a treaty to ensure the separation of powers. 兩國簽署了一項條約以確保權力分立。
They decided to undergo a temporary separation to re-evaluate their relationship. 他們決定暫時分開，以重新評估他們的關係。

meaning: 以 政治上 、 合法 或<a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="/wiki/ecmic 類型的方式對待社會成員。
sentences: Separatism grew stronger after years of unfair treatment. 多年不公平待遇後，分離主義變得更強。
The article explains why separatism spread in that region. 文章說明分離主義為何在那個地區擴散。

meaning: 主張或尋求將一個國家或地區分裂為兩個政治上獨立的國家或地區的人。
sentences: A separatist group called for a public vote. 一個分離主義團體要求舉行公投。
The government opened talks with separatist leaders. 政府開始與分離派領袖對話。
The historian traced the sept back to Ireland. 歷史學家把這個氏族追溯到愛爾蘭。
Members of the sept gathered for a yearly meal. 氏族成員聚在一起吃年度餐會。
The cabin uses a septic tank behind the shed. 那間小屋在棚子後面用化糞池。
The plumber checked the septic line this morning. 水電師傅今天早上檢查了化糞管線。

meaning: 前面提到的事件之後發生的事件的統稱；後果。
sentences: The sequel was funnier than the first movie. 續集比第一集更好笑。
She waited three years for the sequel to the novel. 她等了三年才等到那本小說的續集。
The teacher asked the students to put the events of the story in the correct sequence. 老師要求學生按正確的順序排列故事中的事件。
A sequence of unexpected events led to the sudden change in the project plan. 一系列意外事件導致了專案計畫的突然變動。
Something described as sequential is succeeding or following in order. 被描述為連續的事物是按順序連續或跟隨的。
The word sequential is often used to describe a person, thing, or situation. 「順序」一詞通常用於描述人、事物或情況。

meaning: 隔離的過程或行為；擱置或分開。
sentences: The court ordered the sequestration of the company assets. 法院下令扣押公司資產。
Carbon sequestration can reduce the amount of gas in the air. 碳封存可以減少空氣中的氣體量。
He sang a serenade under her window. 他在她窗下唱了一首小夜曲。
The band played a gentle serenade at the wedding. 樂團在婚禮上演奏了一首溫柔的小夜曲。
She had a serene expression on her face as she sat quietly by the lake. 她安靜地坐在湖邊，臉上帶著安詳的表情。
The mountain village is a serene and peaceful place, away from the city. 那座山村是一個寧靜且安詳的地方，遠離了城市。
The quiet lake gave her a sense of serenity. 安靜的湖讓她感到平靜。
He found serenity by walking alone in the park. 他獨自在公園散步時找到了寧靜。
The old uniform was made of dark serge. 那套舊制服是用深色嗶嘰布做的。
She brushed dust from the serge coat. 她刷掉嗶嘰布外套上的灰塵。
The young sergeant led his platoon through the difficult mountain terrain. 那位年輕的中士帶領他的小隊穿過艱難的山區地形。
He was promoted to the rank of sergeant after years of excellent service. 在多年優秀服務後，他被晉升為中士（或警官）。
The police are searching for a serial killer who has committed several crimes. 警方正在搜尋一名犯下幾起罪案的連環（連續的）殺手。
The magazine features a serial story that is updated every single week. 雜誌刊登了一個每週更新的連載故事。
The television series about space exploration has been very popular this year. 關於太空探索的電視系列劇今年非常受歡迎。
The author published a series of books for children about animals and nature. 作者出版了一套關於動物和自然的兒童叢書（系列書籍）。
The doctor said that her condition is serious but stable. 醫生說她的情況很嚴重但很穩定。
You should take this matter more seriously; it's very important. 你應該更認真地對待這件事，它非常重要。

meaning: 以極端或主要的方式；主要是。
sentences: Unless you're seriously strapped (armed), you're about to be not okay too. 除非你嚴重束縛（武裝），否則你也不會好起來的。
If someone acts seriously, they do so in a way that is in an extreme or major way; majorly. 如果某人的行為是嚴肅的，那麼他們的行為方式就是極端的或主要的；主要是。
The priest gave a powerful sermon on the importance of peace and kindness. 牧師發表了一場關於和平與善良重要性的強有力佈道。
Stop giving me a sermon about my mistakes; I already know I was wrong. 別再為我的錯誤對我說教（講道）了；我已經知道我錯了。

meaning: 蛇，尤其是大型或危險的蛇。
sentences: A green serpent slid across the warm rock. 一條綠色的蛇滑過溫熱的石頭。
The child was frightened by the painted serpent on the wall. 孩子被牆上畫的蛇嚇到了。
The serpentine path through the mountains was narrow and dangerous. 山間蜿蜒的小路狹窄而危險。
Something described as serpentine is curving in alternate directions; sinuous. 被描述為蛇形的東西正在向不同的方向彎曲；蜿蜒的。
Use the serrated knife for the bread. 切麵包要用鋸齒刀。
The leaf has a serrated edge like a tiny saw. 那片葉子的邊緣像小鋸子一樣有鋸齒。

meaning: 某些其他動物體液的含水部分，例如牛奶；乳清。
sentences: She put a vitamin serum on her face before bed. 她睡前在臉上擦了維他命精華液。
The lab stored the blood serum in a small tube. 實驗室把血清存放在小試管裡。
The wealthy family employed several servants to manage the house. 這個富裕家庭雇用了幾名僕人來管理家務。
Public servants play a vital role in serving the local community. 公務員在服務當地社區方面發揮著至關重要的作用。
The restaurant serves a wide variety of delicious Italian dishes. 這家餐廳供應多樣化且美味的義大利菜。
He served in the army for three years before starting university. 他在大學開始前在軍中服役了三年。
The company's central server crashed this morning, causing a temporary outage. 公司的中央伺服器今天早上當機，導致暫時停電。
The waiter worked as a server at a luxury restaurant in the city center. 那名服務生在市中心的一家豪華餐廳擔任侍者。
The hotel provides excellent service to all its guests. 這間飯店為所有客人提供優質的服務。
Our car needs a full service before our long road trip. 我們的車在長途旅行前需要全面保養。
The recipe provides enough ingredients for four servings of the dish. 該食譜提供的食材足夠做四份這道菜。
She is currently serving as the senior manager of the local research team. 她目前擔任當地研究團隊的高級經理。
Sesame seeds are a popular topping for bread and rolls. 芝麻是麵包常用的配料。
She added some toasted sesame seeds to the salad. 她在沙拉中加了一些烤芝麻。
The final session of the international summit will focus on climate change. 國際峰會的最後一次會議將聚焦於氣候變遷。
The students attended a three-hour training session on new software techniques. 學生們參加了為期三小時的新軟體技術培訓課程（一段時間）。
Please set the table for dinner; the guests will arrive soon. 請擺好餐具準備吃晚餐，客人很快就到了。
The sun sets in the west and rises in the east. 太陽從西方落下，從東方升起。
The project experienced a major setback when the manager decided to resign. 當經理決定辭職時，專案遭遇了重大挫折。
We must learn to overcome setbacks and continue to pursue our future goals. 我們必須學會克服阻礙（挫折）並繼續追求未來目標。

meaning: 設定某事的人，例如挑戰或考試。
sentences: The exam was so hard we assumed the question setter must have been in a bad mood. 考試太難了，我們猜想題者一定心情不好。
The setter of this crossword has been known to throw us all for a loop occasionally. 眾所周知，這個填字遊戲的設定者偶爾會讓我們所有人陷入困境。
The novel is located in a beautiful rural setting in the south of France. 這部小說的背景設定在法國南部美麗的農村環境中。
You can adjust the brightness and contrast in the display settings of your laptop. 您可以在筆電的顯示設定中調整亮度和對比度。
They managed to settle the dispute without going to court. 他們成功解決了糾紛而沒有對簿公堂。
They decided to settle in a small village near the coast. 他們決定在沿海的一個小村莊裡定居。
My teacher wrote settle(ment) next to the idea of moving in for good. 老師把這個詞標在表示長久定居的概念旁。
The lawyer highlighted settle(ment) in the file about the final agreement. 律師在那份最終協議的檔案裡特別標出和解這個詞。
The baby looked settled after the warm bath. 洗完熱水澡後，寶寶看起來安定多了。
The bill is settled, so we can leave. 帳已經結清，我們可以走了。
The two sides reached a settlement after months of talks. 雙方談了數月後達成和解。
The settlement included money for repairs. 和解內容包含修繕費用。
The first settlers arrived in the new land and built small wooden cabins. 第一批定居者抵達這片新土地，並建造了小木屋。
The history museum tells the story of early European settlers in Australia. 這座歷史博物館講述了早期歐洲定居者在澳洲的故事。

meaning: 為特定目的而設計的設備；一個裝置。
sentences: The camera setup took less than ten minutes. 相機架設不到十分鐘就完成了。
Her desk setup includes two screens. 她的桌面配置有兩個螢幕。
There are seven days in a week. 一週有七天。
The child is seven years old today. 這孩子今天七歲了。
Her birthday is on the seventeenth of May. 她的生日是五月十七日。
He finished seventeenth in the marathon. 他在馬拉松中得到第十七名。
Our office is on the seventh floor. 我們辦公室在七樓。
She was the seventh person in line. 她是排隊中的第七個人。
A sharp shard can sever the cord. 尖銳碎片可能會割斷那條繩子。
He decided to sever ties with the scam group. 他決定和那個詐騙集團斷絕關係。
I have visited Japan several times and I love the culture. 我去過日本好幾次，我很喜歡當地的文化。
There are several different ways to solve this difficult problem. 有幾種不同的方法可以解決這個難題。

meaning: 切斷行為或被切斷的狀態。
sentences: The company offered him three months of severance. 公司給了他三個月的資遣費。
She used her severance to pay rent while looking for work. 她找工作期間用資遣費付房租。
The region experienced a severe drought that lasted for several months. 該地區經歷了持續數月的嚴重乾旱。
He received severe injuries in the car accident and was rushed to the hospital. 他在車禍中受了重傷（劇烈的傷害），被緊急送往醫院。

meaning: 嚴重地、嚴厲地。可用來形容受傷、損害、批評或天氣等程度非常強烈。
sentences: The storm severely damaged several houses near the coast. 暴風雨嚴重破壞了海岸附近的幾棟房子。
She was severely criticized for ignoring the safety rules. 她因忽視安全規則而受到嚴厲批評。

meaning: 不良事物的程度；惡劣或嚴重。
sentences: The doctor explained the severity of the injury. 醫師說明了傷勢的嚴重程度。
The storm increased in severity overnight. 暴風雨一夜之間變得更嚴重。
My mother taught me how to sew a button back onto a shirt when I was young. 我小時候母親教我如何把扣子縫回襯衫上。
She spent the afternoon sewing a beautiful new dress for her daughter's birthday. 她花了一個下午為女兒的生日縫製一件漂亮的新洋裝。

meaning: 水和固體廢棄物的懸浮液，透過下水道運輸進行處理或處理。
sentences: Untreated sewage can pollute rivers. 未經處理的污水會污染河川。
The city invested in a modern sewage system. 該市投資建造了現代化的污水處理系統。

meaning: 管道或渠道，或管道或渠道系統，用於清除人類排泄物並提供排水。
sentences: A broken sewer caused a bad smell in the street. 破裂的下水道讓街上很臭。
Workers repaired the sewer under the road. 工人修好了路下的污水管。

meaning: 正在或已經被縫製的東西。
sentences: She put down her sewing and went to answer the door. 她放下針線活去開門。
The sewing has come undone on this seam. 這條接縫處的縫線已鬆開。
The application form asks for your name, age, and sex. 申請表要求填寫您的姓名、年齡與性別。
Gender equality means that both sexes should have equal rights. 性別平等意味著男女雙方都應享有平等的權利。

meaning: 照顧教堂建築及其墓地並可能擔任掘墓人和敲鐘人的教堂官員。
sentences: The sexton unlocked the church before the morning service. 教堂司事在早禮拜前打開教堂。
An elderly sexton rang the bell at noon. 一位年長的教堂司事在中午敲鐘。
Education plays a vital role in preventing sexual discrimination in society. 教育在預防社會性別歧視方面發揮著至關重要的作用。
Biological researchers are studying the sexual reproduction of exotic plants. 生物研究人員正研究外來植物的有性生殖。

meaning: 性的品質；以性別為特徵或區分的事物。
sentences: The class discussed sexuality with care and respect. 課堂上以謹慎且尊重的方式討論性議題。
Many teenagers have questions about sexuality. 許多青少年對性有疑問。
She kissed him sexually. 她性地吻了他。
If someone acts sexually, they do so in a way that is in a sexual manner; erotically. 如果某人有性行為，他們的行為方式就是性行為；色情地。
She wore a stunning red dress that made her look very sexy and elegant. 她穿了一件讓她看起來既性感又優雅的亮麗紅洋裝。
The new perfume has a very sophisticated and sexy scent. 這款新香水有一種非常精緻且迷人的香味。
The homeless man was wearing a shabby old coat and worn-out shoes. 那名無家可歸的人穿著一件破舊的大衣和磨損的鞋子。
I found his behavior towards his colleagues to be rather shabby and unkind. 我發現他對同事的行為相當卑鄙（不厚道）且不友善。

meaning: 居住（居住或與之一起生活）；窩棚。
sentences: To shack means to live (in or with); to shack up. 棚屋意味著居住（居住在其中或與之一起居住）；窩棚。
People may shack in different situations depending on the context. 根據具體情況，人們可能會在不同的情況下搭棚。
Grandpa peeled a shaddock after dinner. 爺爺晚餐後剝了一顆文旦。
A ripe shaddock smells fresh and sweet. 成熟的柚子聞起來清新香甜。
We sat in the shade of a large oak tree to escape the hot afternoon sun. 我們坐在巨大的橡樹蔭下，以躲避午後炎熱的陽光。
The curtains come in many different shades of blue, from pale to deep. 這些窗簾有許多不同深淺（色調）的藍色，從淺藍到深藍都有。

meaning: 某物被遮蔽的行為或結果。
sentences: The artist added shading under the apple. 畫家在蘋果下方加上陰影。
Good shading makes the drawing look deeper. 好的明暗處理讓圖畫看起來更有深度。
The long shadows cast by the setting sun stretched across the garden. 落日投下的長長陰影橫跨了整個花園。
The mountain was shrouded in shadow as the moon rose in the sky. 當月亮升起時，大山籠罩在陰影之中。

meaning: 被遮蔽的效果（在阻擋的意義上），如來自光源或無線電傳輸。
sentences: Shadowing a nurse helped the student learn hospital routines. 跟隨護士見習幫助學生了解醫院流程。
The tall building caused shadowing on the solar panels. 高樓遮住陽光，影響了太陽能板。
He sat in a shadowy corner. 他坐在陰暗的角落。
Something described as shadowy is in shadow; darkened by shadows. 被描述為陰暗的東西是在陰影中；被陰影變暗。

meaning: 陰涼的、可疑的、不正當的
sentences: They enjoyed a pleasant walk along the shady paths of the park. 他們在公園陰涼的小徑上愉快地散步。
I wouldn't trust him; he's involved in some shady business deals lately. 我不會信任他，他最近參與了一些不正當（可疑）的商業交易。

meaning: 他媽的；造成傷害，特別是透過欺騙或背叛。
sentences: Your boss really shafted you by stealing your idea like that. 你的老闆這樣竊取你的想法確實是在欺騙你。
To shaft means to fuck over; to cause harm to, especially through deceit or treachery. To shake 的意思是操弄；造成傷害，特別是透過欺騙或背叛。
The old rug had a thick shag. 那張舊地毯有厚厚的長毛。
His hair fell in a messy shag over his eyes. 他的亂髮垂到眼前。
The shah ruled from a grand palace. 那位波斯王從宏偉宮殿中統治。
The coin showed the face of a shah. 那枚硬幣上有一位國王的肖像。
Please shake the bottle before you drink it. 喝之前請先搖一搖瓶子。
Her hands shake when she is cold. 她冷的時候手會發抖。

meaning: 主要指一個人的：一個人的鎮靜或信心被打亂或心煩意亂；處於休克或創傷狀態。
sentences: We were left shaken by the revelations of abuse. 我們對虐待行為的揭露感到震驚。
Something described as shaken is chiefly of a person: having had one's composure or confidence disrupted or upset; in a state of shock or trauma. 被描述為動搖的東西主要是針對一個人的：一個人的鎮靜或信心被破壞或不安；處於休克或創傷狀態。

meaning: 搖動的人或物，或透過其搖動某物。
sentences: Pass me the salt shaker, please. 請把鹽罐遞給我。
The bartender filled the shaker with ice. 調酒師把搖酒器裝滿冰塊。
The old ladder feels shaky on the grass. 那把舊梯子放在草地上感覺搖搖晃晃。
My memory of that night is still shaky. 我對那晚的記憶還是很不穩定。

meaning: 殼、鱗片或外殼；鱈魚或豆莢。
sentences: The cliff was made of dark shale. 那面峭壁由深色頁岩構成。
Workers found shale while digging the road. 工人挖路時發現了頁岩。
Shall we go for a walk in the park after dinner? 我們晚餐後去公園散散步好嗎？
The company shall be responsible for any damages incurred. 公司應對所產生的任何損害負責。
The stream is shallow near the rocks. 溪水在岩石旁很淺。
His apology sounded shallow to me. 他的道歉聽起來很敷衍膚淺。
Tiny fish hid in the shallows by the reeds. 小魚躲在蘆葦旁的淺水處。
We stopped the kayak before the shallows. 我們在淺灘前把獨木舟停下來。
The stone tablet says thou shalt keep the gate closed. 石碑上寫著你應當把大門關好。
In old prayers, shalt sounds formal and solemn. 在古老祈禱文裡，這個字聽起來莊重正式。

meaning: 假貨；聲稱是正品的仿製品。
sentences: His apology sounded like a sham. 他的道歉聽起來像假的。
The charity event was a sham to collect money for himself. 那場慈善活動是假象，其實是為他自己斂財。
The village shaman led the healing ceremony. 村裡的薩滿主持了療癒儀式。
People asked the shaman for help during the drought. 旱災期間，人們向薩滿求助。
It's a great shame that the historical building was destroyed. 那棟歷史建築被摧毀真是太可惜了。
He felt a deep sense of shame for his dishonest behavior. 他對自己不誠實的行為感到深深的羞愧。
It is shameful that so many children in the world are still suffering from hunger. 世界上仍有這麼多孩子在遭受飢餓之苦，這真是可恥（丟臉）。
He felt that his behavior at the party last night was truly shameful and apologized. 他覺得自己昨晚在派對上的行為真的很丟臉，並道了歉。
I ran out of shampoo this morning. 我今天早上把洗髮精用完了。
This shampoo smells like green tea. 這瓶洗髮精聞起來像綠茶。

meaning: 幾種小型三葉草狀植物的任何一種，具有三葉形葉子，尤其是白三葉草。
sentences: She wore a shamrock pin on her coat. 她在外套上別了一枚三葉草別針。
The card was decorated with a green shamrock. 卡片上裝飾著綠色三葉草。
The coach made a shan call on the last play. 教練在最後一球做了個不公平的判斷。
Her boss was shan about a five-minute delay. 她老闆對五分鐘的遲到很苛刻。

meaning: 徵用、劫持或以其他方式（通常是錯誤地）侵占某個地方或事物。
sentences: Let's see if we can shanghai a room for a couple of hours. 我們看看能否在上海租房間幾個小時。
To shanghai means to commandeer, hijack, or otherwise (usually wrongfully) appropriate a place or thing. 到上海意味著徵用、劫持或以其他方式（通常是錯誤地）侵占某個地方或事物。

meaning: 物體的突出部分，可以透過它來附著。
sentences: The shank of the tool was made of steel. 工具的柄部是鋼製的。
The butcher cut a lamb shank for the soup. 肉販切了一塊羊腿肉做湯。
They lived in a small shanty near the river. 他們住在河邊一間簡陋小屋裡。
The storm damaged several shanty homes along the coast. 暴風雨損壞了海岸邊幾間簡陋屋舍。
The cloud has a very strange shape, almost like a dragon. 那朵雲的形狀非常奇怪，幾乎像一條龍。
Regular exercise is a great way to stay in good shape. 定期運動是保持良好體態的好方法。
The dough is shaped like a star. 那塊麵團被做成星形。
The vase has a shaped rim that catches the light. 那個花瓶有個成形的瓶口，會反光。
It's important to learn how to share your toys with others. 學習如何與他人分享玩具是很重要的。
They decided to share the cost of the trip equally. 他們決定平均分擔旅行費用。
The company's annual general meeting was attended by hundreds of shareholders. 公司的年度股東大會有數百名股東參加。
The shareholders voted in favor of the proposed merger with the competitor. 股東們投票贊成擬議中的與競爭對手的合併。
The great white shark is one of the most powerful ocean predators. 大白鯊是海洋中最強大的捕食者之一。
We saw several small sharks swimming in the tropical aquarium. 我們在熱帶水族館看到幾隻小鯊魚在游動。
Be careful with that knife; it has a very sharp blade. 小心那把刀，它的刀刃非常鋒利。
The meeting will start at 9:00 a.m. sharp tomorrow morning. 會議將在明天早上九點準時開始。
I need to sharpen my pencil before I can start drawing the building model. 我得先削尖鉛筆，然後才能開始畫建築模型。
Traveling and learning about other cultures can help to sharpen your mind. 旅遊和了解其他文化有助於提高（磨練）你的思維。
The sharper tricked tourists with a card game. 那個騙子用紙牌遊戲欺騙遊客。
Police warned people about a sharper near the station. 警方提醒民眾小心車站附近的騙子。

meaning: 以強烈區分或區分的方式；敏銳地。
sentences: The wealth of this small country contrasts sharply with that of its neighbours. 這個小國的財富與其鄰國形成鮮明對比。
If someone acts sharply, they do so in a way that is in a strongly distinguishing or differentiating manner; acutely. 如果某人行為尖銳，那麼他們會以一種強烈區分或差異化的方式這樣做；尖銳地。
The glass window shattered into a thousand pieces when hit by the ball. 玻璃窗被球擊中後碎成（粉碎）了無數碎片。
Her dreams of becoming a professional dancer were shattered by the injury. 她成為專業舞者的夢想因傷破滅了。
He usually shaves every morning before going to work to look neat. 他通常每天早上上班前都會刮鬍子，讓自己看起來整潔。
The car nearly hit the cyclist, but luckily it only gave him a close shave. 那輛車差點撞上騎自行車的人，幸運的是只是擦身而過（虛驚一場）。
He bought a new electric shaver at the local department store yesterday. 他昨天在當地百貨公司買了一個新的電動刮鬍刀。
The store sells a variety of high-quality shavers and accessories for men. 商店出售各式各樣的高品質男性刮鬍刀及其配件。
A narrow path led into the shaw. 一條小路通往灌木叢。
The children found berries near the shaw. 孩子們在小樹林旁找到莓果。
She wore a warm wool shawl over her shoulders. 她肩上披著一條暖和的羊毛披肩。
My grandmother knitted this beautiful silk shawl for me. 我祖母為我織了這條漂亮的絲綢披肩。
She left her umbrella by the door. 她把雨傘放在門邊。
I called Mia because she forgot her notebook. 我打電話給米亞，因為她忘了筆記本。
The note says she (her, hers, herself) on the pronoun chart. 那張代名詞表上寫著女性單數那一組。
I practiced she (her, hers, herself) before the quiz. 我在小考前練習了女性單數代名詞那一組。

meaning: 這種樹的果實，有一層薄薄的、酸的、營養豐富的果肉，包裹著相對較大、富含油的種子。
sentences: Shea butter keeps my hands soft in winter. 乳木果油讓我的手在冬天保持柔軟。
The cream contains shea and coconut oil. 這款乳霜含有乳木果和椰子油。
Farmers shear the sheep every spring. 農夫每年春天都會替羊剪毛。
The crash caused the bolt to shear off. 那次撞擊讓螺栓直接斷掉。
Shearing sheep is common in spring. 春天常會剪羊毛。
The factory uses shearing to cut metal sheets. 工廠用剪切方式切割金屬板。
The gardener used a pair of garden shears to trim the hedge. 園丁用一把大剪刀修剪樹籬。
He is using the shears to cut the thick cardboard. 他正用大剪刀裁剪厚紙板。
He pulled the knife from its leather sheath. 他把刀從皮革刀鞘中拔出。
The sword hung in a decorated sheath. 那把劍掛在裝飾精美的劍鞘裡。
He keeps all his gardening tools and equipment in a small wooden shed. 他把所有的園藝工具和設備都放在一個小木棚裡。
The snake began to shed its skin as it grew larger during the spring. 春天蛇長大時開始脫（蛻）皮。
The polished floor had a beautiful golden sheen. 拋光過的地板有著漂亮的金色光澤。
Her hair had a healthy sheen after using the new shampoo. 使用新洗髮精後，她的頭髮有著健康的光彩。
The sheep were peacefully grazing in the green fields. 羊群正在綠油油的田野裡平靜地吃草。
Australia is famous for its large number of sheep and wool. 澳洲以其大量的羊和羊毛聞名。
Winning the championship was a moment of sheer joy and excitement for the team. 贏得冠軍對全隊來說是純粹的快樂與興奮時刻。
The mountain climbers had to scale a sheer cliff to reach the top. 登山者必須攀登陡峭的懸崖才能到達山頂。
She put a clean white cotton sheet on the guest bed. 她在客房床上鋪了一條乾淨的白色棉質床單。
Please write your answers on the separate sheet of paper provided. 請將答案寫在提供的另一張紙上。

meaning: 阿拉伯村莊、家族或部落領袖；酋長
sentences: The sheik welcomed visitors to the village. 酋長歡迎訪客來到村莊。
A local sheik helped settle the dispute. 當地酋長協助解決爭端。
He placed the new book on the top shelf of the bookcase. 他把新書放在書架的最頂層。
There are several bottles of fresh milk on the refrigerator shelf. 冰箱架上有幾瓶鮮奶。
I found a pink shell near the pier. 我在碼頭附近找到一個粉紅色貝殼。
The egg shell cracked in the pan. 蛋殼在鍋邊裂開了。
We shelled peas on the porch after lunch. 午飯後我們坐在門廊剝豌豆。
Dad shelled the walnuts with a small hammer. 爸爸用小槌子把胡桃敲開取仁。
The shelling kept families inside their homes. 砲擊讓許多家庭不敢出門。
The village was damaged by heavy shelling. 村莊受到猛烈砲擊而受損。
The path gets shelly near the shore. 靠近海邊的小路滿是碎貝殼。
We skipped that shelly patch and sat on the sand. 我們避開那片佈滿貝殼的地方，改坐在沙地上。
The homeless people found shelter in a nearby church during the snowstorm. 在暴風雪期間，無家可歸的人在附近的教堂找到了避難所。
They used large leaves to provide shelter from the sudden heavy rain. 他們用大葉子來遮擋突如其來的暴雨。
We ate lunch in a sheltered corner of the park. 我們在公園一個避風角落吃午餐。
He grew up sheltered from city life. 他從小受到保護，很少接觸城市生活。
We bought new shelving for the pantry. 我們為食品儲藏室買了新的層架。
The library added more shelving for children's books. 圖書館為童書增加了更多書架。
The dedicated shepherd guided his flock of sheep to the green meadow. 盡責的牧羊人帶領他的羊群前往綠色草地。
In the past, many young men in this region worked as shepherds. 在過去，這個地區的許多青年男子擔任牧羊人。
The local sheriff is responsible for law enforcement in the small community. 當地警長負責小社區的執法工作。
He was appointed as the sheriff of the county earlier this year. 他在今年年初被任命為該縣的治安官（警長）。
My cousin can sherlock any mystery from old photos. 我表哥光靠舊照片就能把謎團查個八九不離十。
We tried to sherlock where the stray cat came from. 我們試著查出那隻流浪貓是從哪裡來的。
Would you like a glass of dry sherry before dinner? 你想來杯餐前乾雪莉酒嗎？
She added a splash of sherry to the soup for extra flavor. 她在湯裡加了一點雪莉酒以增加風味。
The knight carried a heavy iron shield to protect himself in battle. 騎士提著沈重的鐵盾在戰鬥中保護自己。
Parents always try to shield their children from unnecessary stress and harm. 父母總是試圖保護（遮擋）孩子免受不必要的壓力和傷害。
The night shift starts at ten. 大夜班十點開始。
A sudden shift in wind closed the beach. 風向突然轉變，海灘因此關閉。
The bike shifter is hard to move in cold weather. 天冷時，腳踏車變速器很難轉動。
She replaced the broken shifter in her car. 她更換了車上壞掉的排檔桿。

meaning: 肯尼亞 、 索馬利亞 、 烏幹達 。
sentences: He found an old shilling in his grandfather's drawer. 他在祖父的抽屜裡找到一枚舊先令。
The guide showed us a Kenyan shilling at the market. 導遊在市場裡拿肯亞先令給我們看。
He kicked the ball and accidentally hurt his shin. 他踢球時不小心弄傷了脛部。
The player was wearing shin guards for protection. 球員佩戴著護脛以進行保護。
The floor will shine after one more wipe. 再擦一次地板就會發亮。
He used wax to shine his shoes. 他用鞋蠟把皮鞋擦亮。
He polished his leather shoes until they were clean and shiny. 他把皮鞋擦得乾乾淨淨、閃閃發亮。
The little girl was delighted with her new pair of shiny red shoes. 小女孩對她的新亮紅鞋感到非常高興。
The huge cruise ship sailed across the Atlantic Ocean. 巨大的郵輪航行橫跨了大西洋。
We need to ship these products to our customers by Friday. 我們需要在週五前將這些產品運送給客戶。

meaning: 透過任何方式運輸的貨物（不僅僅是透過船舶）。
sentences: The shipment arrived two days late. 這批貨晚了兩天到。
Please check the shipment before signing the form. 簽表格前請先檢查貨物。
The store shipped my charger yesterday. 那家店昨天把我的充電器寄出了。
We shipped the gift before noon. 我們中午前就把禮物寄出了。

meaning: 運送（發送）某物的個人或組織。
sentences: The shipper sent the package to the wrong address. 托運人把包裹寄到錯誤地址。
A local shipper handles our weekend deliveries. 一家本地貨運商負責我們週末的配送。

meaning: 使用郵政或承運服務發送物品或包裹的費用。
sentences: Shipping is free if you spend more than five hundred dollars. 消費超過五百元免運費。
The store raised its shipping fee this month. 這家店這個月調高了運費。

meaning: 沉沒或擱淺而不再適合航行的船舶；毀壞的船隻或其遺骸。
sentences: Divers explored the old shipwreck near the island. 潛水員探索了島附近的古老沉船。
A storm caused the shipwreck many years ago. 多年前一場暴風雨造成了那起船難。

meaning: 建造和修理船舶的地方。
sentences: The shipyard repairs fishing boats in winter. 造船廠冬天修理漁船。
My uncle works as a welder at the shipyard. 我叔叔在造船廠當焊工。

meaning: 一個人來自或居住的一般區域。
sentences: He grew up in a quiet shire in the countryside. 他在鄉下一個安靜郡區長大。
The shire council repaired the old bridge. 郡議會修好了那座老橋。
He wore a clean white shirt and a blue tie for the interview. 他穿了一件乾淨的白襯衫並繫上藍領帶去面試。
The buttons on my shirt are loose; I need to sew them on. 我襯衫上的扣子鬆了，我需要把它們縫好。
The guard found a hidden shiv under the mattress. 警衛在床墊下發現一把藏起來的自製刀。
A shiv can be made from ordinary objects, so the search was strict. 臨時刀可能由普通物品製成，所以搜查很嚴格。
She began to shiver with cold after being outside in the snow for hours. 在雪地待了幾小時後，她開始因冷而發抖（打冷顫）。
The ghost story sent a shiver down his spine and filled him with fear. 鬼故事讓他感到背脊發涼（打冷顫），充滿恐懼。
We saw a large shoal of colorful fish in the ocean. 我們在海洋中看到一大群色彩繽紛的魚。
The boat got stuck on a sandy shoal in the river. 船卡在了河裡的沙洲淺灘上。
The sudden news of his resignation was a big shock to everyone. 他突然辭職的消息對每個人來說都是個巨大的震驚。
I received a mild electric shock when I touched the faulty wire. 當我碰到故障的電線時，受到了輕微的電擊。

meaning: 一個令人震驚或震驚的人或物。
sentences: The final score was a shocker to everyone. 最後比分讓所有人都大吃一驚。
That plot twist was a real shocker. 那個劇情轉折真的很令人震驚。
He had thinned shockingly, losing 100 pounds in the last month of his illness. 他瘦得驚人，在生病的最後一個月裡體重減輕了 100 磅。
If someone acts shockingly, they do so in a way that is in a shocking manner. 如果某人的行為令人震驚，那麼他們會以令人震驚的方式這樣做。
The zipper broke because the bag was shoddy. 那個包包的拉鍊會壞，是因為做工太差。
We returned the shoddy chair the same day. 我們當天就把那張劣質椅子退掉了。
She bought a beautiful pair of black shoes at the mall. 她在購物中心買了一雙漂亮的黑鞋。
Please take off your shoes before entering the house. 進屋前請脫鞋。
I left my shoe(s) by the front door. 我把鞋子放在前門旁。
These shoe(s) still hurt my heels. 這雙鞋還是會磨腳跟。
The shoemaker repaired my leather boots. 鞋匠修好了我的皮靴。
A shoemaker in the market makes shoes by hand. 市場裡有位鞋匠手工做鞋。
Don't just shoo away mosquitoes, kill them! 不僅要趕走蚊子，還要殺死它們！
See if you can shoo off the insurance salesmen. 看看你能不能趕走保險推銷員。

meaning: 情緒不安或不安；害怕的。
sentences: Crystal was shook when Mr. Wu discovered she was shopping online for panties and bras to pass the time in class. 當吳先生發現她在網上購買內褲和胸罩以打發課堂時間時，克里斯特爾感到震驚。
Something described as shook is emotionally upset or disturbed; scared. 被描述為震動的事物表示情緒上的不安或不安；害怕的。
The photographer managed to shoot some amazing photos of wildlife. 攝影師設法拍攝了一些精彩的野生動物照片。
He decided to shoot for his dreams and apply for the job. 他決定追求夢想，申請那份工作。

meaning: 射擊某物的人；槍手、弓箭手等。
sentences: The shooter aimed carefully at the target. 射手小心瞄準目標。
The police arrested the shooter near the station. 警方在車站附近逮捕了槍手。
The shooting shocked the whole town. 那起槍擊震驚了整個小鎮。
We finished the shooting before sunset. 我們在日落前完成拍攝。
I'm going to the grocery shop to buy some milk and eggs. 我要去雜貨店買些牛奶和雞蛋。
She likes to window shop at the mall during the weekend. 她喜歡週末在購物中心逛街（只看不買）。
The local shopkeeper was very friendly and helpful to everyone. 當地店主對每個人都非常友善且熱心。
My grandfather worked as a shopkeeper in a small village for years. 我祖父在一個小村莊當了多年的店主。

meaning: 包含當地商店等廣告的免費當地報紙；有時包括折扣券。
sentences: A careful shopper compares prices before buying. 謹慎的購物者購買前會比價。
The mall was full of shoppers on Saturday. 星期六商場裡擠滿了購物者。

meaning: 購買商品或服務，或尋找適合購買的商品或服務的過程。
sentences: We went shopping for winter coats. 我們去買冬天外套。
Online shopping saves her a lot of time. 網路購物替她省下很多時間。
We took a pleasant walk along the rocky shore at low tide. 我們在退潮時沿著岩石海岸愉快地散步。
The waves were gently lapping against the sandy shore. 海浪輕輕拍打著沙灘。
The movie was quite short but very interesting and moving. 這部電影挺短的，但非常有趣且感人。
He is a short and stout man with a friendly smile. 他是一個矮壯的男人，帶著友善的笑容。
The region is facing a severe shortage of clean drinking water this year. 該地區今年正面臨嚴重的清潔飲用水短缺。
There is a significant shortage of skilled medical staff in rural areas. 農村地區存在嚴重的醫護專業人員短缺（不足）。
Despite its many shortcomings, the new project was a successful endeavor. 儘管有許多缺點，這個新專案仍是一項成功的事業。
She was praised for being honest about her own shortcomings and mistakes. 她因能誠實面對自己的短處（缺點）和錯誤而受到稱讚。
We need to shorten the meeting because the manager has another appointment. 我們需要縮短會議，因為經理還有另一個預約。
She decided to shorten her long hair for a more modern look. 她決定剪短長髮，讓造型更具現代感。

meaning: 空頭、賣空者：從事賣空活動的人。
sentences: The shorter route goes through the park. 較短的路線會穿過公園。
My haircut is much shorter than before. 我的頭髮剪得比以前短多了。

meaning: 未達到配額、義務或更普遍的任何預期目標的實例。
sentences: The school faced a budget shortfall this year. 學校今年面臨預算缺口。
A shortfall in staff delayed the project. 人手不足讓專案延誤。

meaning: 任何簡短或簡短的說話或做某事的方式。
sentences: The nurse used shorthand while taking notes. 護士記筆記時用了速記。
The phrase became shorthand for a larger problem. 這個片語成了更大問題的簡稱。
The manager will be with you shortly; please take a seat. 經理很快（不久）就來；請坐。
The airplane took off and reached its cruising altitude shortly after. 飛機起飛後不久便達到了巡航高度。
The doctor asked about her shortness of breath. 醫生問起她呼吸急促的情況。
I noticed the shortness of the curtains right away. 我立刻注意到窗簾太短。
I like to wear comfortable shorts and a T-shirt in the summer. 我夏天喜歡穿舒服的短褲和 T 恤。
He was wearing a pair of blue denim shorts at the beach. 他在海邊穿著一條藍色牛仔短褲。
She is shortsighted and must wear glasses to see the blackboard clearly. 她近視（短視），必須戴眼鏡才能看清黑板。
The company's shortsighted strategy led to a decrease in long-term profits. 公司眼光短淺的戰略導致了長期利潤的下降。

meaning: 站在二壘手和三壘手之間的內場防守球員。
sentences: The shortstop caught the ball and threw to first base. 游擊手接住球後傳向一壘。
My cousin plays shortstop on the school team. 我表弟在校隊守游擊。
The doctor gave him a flu shot to protect him during the winter. 醫生為他打了一劑流感疫苗，以在冬天保護他。
He took a great shot of the sunset with his new digital camera. 他用新數位相機拍了一張很棒的日落照片。

meaning: 一種從彈藥筒中發射通常由小金屬球（稱為彈丸）組成的彈藥的槍。
sentences: The farmer kept a shotgun in the shed. 農夫把獵槍放在棚子裡。
They heard a shotgun in the distance. 他們聽見遠處有獵槍聲。
You should see a doctor if your symptoms persist. 如果症狀持續，你應該去看醫生。
What should we do now? 我們現在該怎麼辦？
He carried his young daughter on his shoulders. 他把年幼的女兒扛在肩上。
She tapped me on the shoulder to get my attention. 她拍了拍我的肩膀以引起我的注意。
He shouldered the rice bag and walked home. 他把米袋扛上肩走回家。
She shouldered most of the moving work alone. 搬家時大部分工作都是她一個人扛下來的。
Don't shout; I can hear you perfectly well. 別喊，我聽得很清楚。
The fans started to shout with excitement when the goal was scored. 當進球時，球迷們興奮地大喊起來。
He tried to shove his way through the crowded subway station. 他試圖在擁擠的地鐵站裡擠出一條路來。
She shoved all her old books into a large box and put it in the attic. 她把所有的舊書都塞（亂放）進一個大箱子，放在了閣樓裡。
The construction worker used a heavy shovel to clear the loose dirt. 建築工人用一把重鏟子清理鬆散的泥土。
They spent the whole morning shoveling snow from the driveway. 他們花了一整早上清理車道上的積雪。
Could you please show me the way to the train station? 你可以指給我看去火車站的路嗎？
The magic show was absolutely amazing and everyone loved it. 魔術表演簡直太精彩了，每個人都喜歡。
I think the demonstration really showcases the strengths of the software. 我認為該演示確實展示了該軟體的優勢。
To showcase means to display, demonstrate, show, or present. 展示的意思是展示、示範、展示或展示。

meaning: 撲克比賽的最後一輪，所有剩餘玩家的牌都必須放在桌上並展示。
sentences: The two teams prepared for a final showdown. 兩隊準備迎接最後對決。
The card game ended with a tense showdown. 那場牌局在緊張的攤牌中結束。
She showed me the way to the station. 她帶我看去車站的路。
The test showed that the water was clean. 檢測顯示水是乾淨的。
I always take a quick shower in the morning to wake up. 我早上總會快速洗個澡以提神。
The sudden rain shower lasted for only ten minutes. 突如其來的陣雨只持續了十分鐘。
The house has a showing at two o'clock. 這棟房子兩點開放看屋。
The film had its first showing last Friday. 這部電影上週五首次放映。

meaning: 在實體店檢查商品，然後從網上商家購買相同的產品；使用實體店作為在線商家的陳列室。
sentences: This new phone looks good, but I want to go to the mall and showroom it before buying. 這款新手機看起來不錯，但我想在購買之前先去商場和陳列室看看。

To showroom means to inspect merchandise in a physical store, then purchase the identical product from an online merchant; to use a physical store as a showroom for an online merchant. 陳列室是指在實體店檢驗商品，然後從網上商家購買相同的產品；使用實體店作為在線商家的陳列室。
The theater has three shows this weekend. 這家劇院本週末有三場表演。
My sister likes cooking shows. 我妹妹喜歡烹飪節目。

meaning: 上述類型砲彈的子彈或彈丸。
sentences: Shrapnel broke the window during the explosion. 爆炸時，彈片打破了窗戶。
The doctor removed a small piece of shrapnel from his arm. 醫師從他手臂取出一小片彈片。
There was not a single shred of evidence to support his claims in court. 沒有一絲一毫（碎片）的證據支持他在法庭上的說法。
She used a special machine to shred all the important legal documents. 她用一台特殊機器切碎（撕碎）了所有重要的法律文件。
She made a shrewd decision to wait before investing. 她精明地決定先觀望再投資。
A shrewd buyer notices hidden costs. 精明的買家會注意隱藏成本。
The little girl began to shriek with excitement when she saw the gift. 當小女孩看到禮物時，興奮地大聲尖叫起來。
We heard a loud shriek coming from the backyard earlier this morning. 今天清晨我們聽到後院傳來一聲響亮的尖叫。
The restaurant is famous for its fresh and delicious spicy grilled shrimp. 這家餐廳以其新鮮美味的辣烤蝦聞名。
She added some fresh peeled shrimp to the traditional garden salad. 她在新鮮的花園沙拉中加入了一些去殼鮮蝦。
They went shrimping before sunrise. 他們日出前去捕蝦。
Shrimping is hard work on cold mornings. 寒冷早晨捕蝦很辛苦。

meaning: 因其歷史或關聯而神聖的地方或物體。
sentences: They visited a mountain shrine before sunrise. 他們在日出前參拜了山上的神社。
People left flowers at the small shrine. 人們在小神龕前獻花。
The wool sweater will shrink if you wash it in very hot water. 如果妳用很熱的水洗，這件羊毛衣會縮水。
The local population managed to shrink due to the economic crisis. 由於經濟危機，當地人口竟然減少了。

meaning: 隱藏或隱藏在視線之外，就像用裹屍布一樣。
sentences: The details of the plot were shrouded in mystery. 劇情的細節籠罩在神秘之中。
The truth behind their weekend retreat was shrouded in obscurity. 他們週末靜修背後的真相籠罩在晦澀難懂之中。
The garden features a wide variety of exotic shrubs and colorful flowers. 花園裡種滿了各式各樣異國情調的灌木和繽紛的花朵。
She spent the morning planting some new shrubs along the stone path. 她整個上午都在沿著石路種植一些新灌木。
When I asked him if he knew the answer, he just shrugged his shoulders. 當我問他是否知道答案時，他只是聳了聳肩。
She shrugged off the criticism and continued to focus on her own work. 她對批評置之不理（聳聳肩），繼續專注於自己的工作。
I felt a shudder when the door slammed. 門砰一聲關上時，我嚇得一抖。
The old bridge gave a shudder as the truck passed. 卡車經過時，舊橋震了一下。
The old man began to shuffle slowly down the hallway to the kitchen. 老人開始拖著腳慢慢地穿過走廊走向廚房。
Please shuffle the cards thoroughly before we start the game of poker. 在我們開始玩撲克牌之前，請徹底洗牌。
He tries to shun gossip at work. 他在工作中盡量避開八卦。
Many people shun that road at night. 許多人晚上會避開那條路。
Please shut the door quietly so you don't wake up the baby. 請輕輕關門，以免吵醒寶寶。
The entire office will be shut down for the upcoming holidays. 整個辦公室將在即將到來的假期期間關閉。
The factory shutdown lasted three days. 工廠停工持續了三天。
Save your files before the computer shutdown. 電腦關機前請先儲存檔案。
The pitcher threw a shutout in the final game. 投手在決賽投出完封。
Our team suffered a shutout and lost by three goals. 我們隊被零封，輸了三球。
He closed the wooden shutters to block out the bright morning sun. 他關上了木製百葉窗以擋住明亮的晨光。
The photographer clicked the shutter and captured a beautiful sunset view. 攝影師按下了快門，拍下了一張美麗的日落景色。
Shutting the windows kept out the rain. 關上窗戶擋住了雨。
The shop is shutting early tonight. 這家店今晚提早打烊。
The hotel shuttle leaves every hour. 飯店接駁車每小時一班。
We missed the airport shuttle by two minutes. 我們只差兩分鐘就錯過機場接駁車。
She was a shy and quiet girl who didn't like to speak in public. 她是一個害羞文靜、不喜歡在公共場合說話的女孩。
Don't be shy; please feel free to ask me any questions. 別害羞；請隨時問我任何問題。
Her shyness makes it hard for her to speak in class. 她的害羞讓她很難在課堂上發言。
He slowly overcame his shyness by joining a club. 他參加社團後慢慢克服了羞怯。
Sia appears on the map as a short place label. 西亞在地圖上以簡短地名標示出來。
The report compared trade routes across Sia. 報告比較了穿越西亞的貿易路線。
The invoice lists sia corporation as the buyer. 發票把買方列成那家公司。
We called sia corporation about the late delivery. 我們打給那家公司詢問延遲送貨。
The label says sia driftwood on the reclaimed wood lamp. 那盞再生木燈的標籤寫著漂流木款式。
We found a piece of sia driftwood near the seawall. 我們在海堤旁找到一塊漂流木。
The boss called him a siacker for hiding in the storeroom. 老闆罵他是個偷懶的人，因為他躲在儲藏室。
No one wants a siacker on a busy lunch shift. 忙碌的午餐班裡沒人想遇到偷懶的人。
She has three siblings: two older brothers and one younger sister. 她有三個兄弟姊妹：兩個哥哥和一個妹妹。
The researchers studied the influence of siblings on child development. 研究人員研究了兄弟姊妹對兒童發展的影響。
I'm feeling a bit sick today, so I'm staying home. 我今天感覺有點不舒服，所以待在家裡。
The cat looks sick; we should take it to the vet. 那隻貓看起來病了，我們應該帶牠去看獸醫。
He took sick leave because he had a fever. 他因為發燒請了病假。
The company allows three days of paid sick leave. 公司提供三天有薪病假。
Her grandmother rested on the sickbed all morning. 她奶奶整個早上都躺在病床上休息。
Friends sent flowers to his sickbed. 朋友把花送到他的病榻旁。
The farmer cut the grass with a sickle. 農夫用鐮刀割草。
An old sickle hung on the barn wall. 一把舊鐮刀掛在穀倉牆上。
The plant looked sickly after a week without water. 一週沒澆水後，那株植物看起來很虛弱。
A sickly child stayed home from school. 一個體弱的孩子請假在家。
Sickness kept him away from work for three days. 疾病讓他三天無法上班。
Wash your hands often to prevent sickness. 勤洗手可以預防生病。
The nurse opened the window in the sickroom. 護士打開病房的窗戶。
Only family members could enter the sickroom. 只有家屬可以進入病房。
I saw sid waiting by the mailbox. 我看見席德站在信箱旁等人。
The cookies were for sid, not for us. 那些餅乾是給席德的，不是給我們的。
Please sit on this side of the table where there's more light. 請坐在桌子的這一邊，這裡光線比較足。
The restaurant is located on the other side of the river. 餐廳位於河流的另一邊。
Sleepiness is a common side effect of this medicine. 嗜睡是這種藥常見的副作用。
Call the clinic if you notice any side effect. 如果你發現任何副作用，請打電話給診所。
The driver checked the side mirror before changing lanes. 駕駛變換車道前看了側照鏡。
A passing truck broke my side mirror. 一輛經過的卡車撞壞了我的側照鏡。
We turned onto a quiet side road. 我們轉進一條安靜的支路。
The side road was too narrow for two trucks. 那條小岔路窄到無法讓兩輛卡車會車。
She parked her scooter on a side street. 她把機車停在小巷裡。
The cafe is hidden on a quiet side street. 那家咖啡館藏在一條安靜的小街上。
Grandma keeps plates in the sideboard. 阿嬤把盤子收在餐邊櫃裡。
The cat slept under the sideboard all afternoon. 那隻貓整個下午都睡在餐具櫃下。
A knee injury could sideline him for weeks. 膝傷可能讓他好幾週都不能上場。
The budget cut will sideline our art club trip. 預算刪減會讓我們美術社的行程被迫取消。
A square has four equal sides. 正方形有四條等長的邊。
Please write your name on both sides of the card. 請在卡片兩面都寫上名字。
Please walk on the sidewalk and stay away from the busy road. 請走人行道，遠離繁忙的馬路。
The children were drawing colorful pictures on the sidewalk with chalk. 孩子們正用粉筆在人行道上畫著繽紛的畫。

meaning: 向一側移動或指向一側。
sentences: Giving Mary a sideways glance, he said, […]. 他斜眼看了瑪莉一眼，說道，[……]。
He gave the ball a sideways kick. 他把球踢向一邊。

meaning: 覆蓋和保護房屋或其他建築物側面的建築材料。
sentences: The storm damaged the wooden siding. 暴風雨損壞了木製外牆板。
They chose white siding for the new house. 他們為新房子選了白色外牆板。
The old family kept a sie style of dress for ceremonies. 那個老家族在儀式中保留貴族式穿著。
Her sie manners made the dinner feel formal. 她尊貴的舉止讓晚餐顯得很正式。
The ancient city was under siege for several months before finally falling. 這座古城在最終陷落前被圍攻了幾個月。
The company has been under a siege of criticism following the financial scandal. 該公司在金融醜聞後一直遭受著（被包圍）批評的折磨。
Clouds hung over the sierra at sunset. 日落時雲層罩著那片山脈。
We drove along the sierra for two hours. 我們沿著那片山脈開了兩個小時。
He takes a short siesta after lunch. 他午餐後會小睡一下。
The town grows quiet during the afternoon siesta. 午休時間，小鎮變得很安靜。
Use a sieve to remove lumps from the flour. 用篩子把麵粉中的結塊篩掉。
She washed the rice in a metal sieve. 她用金屬篩子洗米。
Please sift the flour before you bake. 烘焙前請先把麵粉過篩。
The police had to sift through hours of video. 警方得仔細查看好幾小時的影片。
I keep a small sifter in the baking drawer. 我把小篩子放在烘焙抽屜裡。
The flour looked lighter after the sifter. 麵粉經過篩子後看起來更鬆。
Our design sig meets every Thursday online. 我們的設計興趣小組每週四線上聚會。
She joined a writing sig at the library. 她在圖書館加入了寫作興趣小組。
His face went sig indifferent when the argument started. 吵起來時，他的表情立刻變得很冷淡。
The clerk sounded sig indifferent on the phone. 那位店員在電話裡聽起來很漠不關心。
We ordered sig noodle with beef broth. 我們點了一碗麵配牛肉湯。
The stall sells fresh sig noodle every morning. 那個攤子每天早上都賣新鮮麵條。
A sig pigeon landed on the window rail. 一隻鴿子停在窗邊欄杆上。
The child dropped crumbs for a sig pigeon in the square. 那個孩子在廣場餵一隻鴿子吃麵包屑。
The old warehouse had a siga fire last winter. 那座老倉庫去年冬天發生過火災。
Smoke alarms helped us catch the siga fire early. 煙霧警報器讓我們及早發現那場失火。
She took a sige job at the flower shop. 她在花店接了一份工作。
A weekend sige job helped him pay rent. 一份週末兼職幫他付了房租。
She gave a long and heavy sigh of relief when the exam was over. 考試結束後，她長長地、如釋重負地嘆了一口氣。
He could only sigh in disappointment after hearing the bad news. 聽到不幸的消息後，他只能失望地嘆氣。
She kept sighing while reading the bill. 她看帳單時一直嘆氣。
The sound of sighing came from the back row. 後排傳來嘆氣聲。
The sunset over the ocean was a truly magnificent sight. 海上的日落是一幕真正壯麗的景象。
He lost his sight in a tragic accident when he was young. 他在年輕時的一場悲劇意外中失去了視力。

meaning: 捕捉 視線 某物（尤其是搜尋到的東西）的行為。
sentences: There was a whale sighting near the harbor. 港口附近有人目擊鯨魚。
The rare bird sighting excited the group. 罕見鳥類的目擊紀錄讓大家很興奮。
We spent the whole day sightseeing in Kyoto and visited many beautiful temples. 我們花了一整天的時間在京都觀光，參觀了許多美麗的寺廟。
The city tour includes some sightseeing at the major landmarks and museums. 市區導覽包括參觀一些主要地標和博物館。

meaning: 希臘字母西格瑪；總和符號
sentences: The math teacher used sigma to show a long sum. 數學老師用西格瑪表示一長串加總。
Lowercase sigma appears often in statistics. 小寫西格瑪常出現在統計學中。
The sign on the door says that the shop is closed for lunch. 門上的告示說這家店中午休息吃午餐。
Please sign your name at the bottom of the contract. 請在合約底部簽名。
The red light is a clear signal that you must stop your car. 紅燈是一個妳必須停車的明確訊號。
The radio receiver was able to catch signals from far away. 廣播接收器能捕捉到遠處的訊號。

meaning: 簽署或已經簽署某物的人。
sentences: Each signatory must write a full name on the form. 每位簽署人都必須在表格上寫全名。
Taiwan was not a signatory to that agreement. 台灣不是那份協議的簽署方。
Please put your signature at the bottom of the contract to make it official. 請在合約底部簽名，使其正式生效。
The chef's signature dish is a delicious seafood pasta with a spicy sauce. 這位主廚的招牌菜（特徵菜）是配上辛辣醬汁的美味海鮮義大利麵。
The historical significance of this ancient temple cannot be overstated. 這座古老寺廟的歷史意義怎麼強調都不為過。
They are still trying to understand the full significance of the new scientific discovery. 他們仍在試圖理解這項新科學發現的全部意義。
The repair cost was significant for our budget. 那筆維修費對我們的預算影響很大。
Her help made a significant difference at home. 她的幫忙讓家裡情況有了明顯改善。

meaning: 以顯著的方式或在顯著的程度上。
sentences: Irene's English significantly improved after taking a year out in Ireland. 在愛爾蘭待了一年後，艾琳的英語有了顯著提升。
The quality of life is significantly higher than it was twenty years ago. 生活品質比二十年前明顯提升。

meaning: 用標誌等表明自己的意圖；指示、宣告或預兆。
sentences: To signify means to show one’s intentions with a sign etc.; to indicate, announce, or portend. 表示是指用符號等表明自己的意圖；表示、宣告或預示。
People may signify in different situations depending on the context. 人們可能會根據上下文在不同的情況下表示不同的意思。
Turn left at the blue signpost. 在藍色路標處左轉。
A wooden signpost points toward the beach. 一根木製路標指向海灘。
The nurse guided the sigt patient to a chair. 護士帶那位病人到椅子上坐下。
We brought soup to the sigt patient next door. 我們送湯給隔壁那位病人。
The teacher asked for silence so everyone could hear the news. 老師要求安靜，以便每個人都能聽到消息。
The silence of the forest was only broken by the singing of birds. 森林的寂靜只被鳥鳴聲打破。
The students remained silent as the teacher entered the classroom. 老師進入教室時，學生們保持沉默。
She gave a silent prayer of gratitude before she started her meal. 她在開飯前進行了無聲的感恩祈禱。
If someone acts silently, they do so in a way that is in a silent manner; making no noise. 如果某人默默地行動，那麼他們就是以一種沉默的方式這樣做；不發出任何噪音。
The speaker responded silently during the discussion. 發言者在討論過程中默默地回應。

meaning: 服裝在穿著者身上的輪廓。
sentences: I saw her silhouette against the sunset. 我看見她的身影映在夕陽前。
The lamp made a clear silhouette on the wall. 那盞燈在牆上照出清楚的輪廓。

meaning: 任何矽酸鹽礦物的二氧化矽族。
sentences: Silica is used to make glass. 二氧化矽可用來製造玻璃。
The packet contains silica gel to keep the box dry. 包裝裡有矽膠乾燥劑讓盒子保持乾燥。

meaning: 原子序數為14、原子量為28.0855的非金屬元素（符號Si）。
sentences: Silicon chips are used in many computers. 許多電腦都使用矽晶片。
The factory produces silicon wafers for electronics. 這家工廠生產電子產品用的矽晶圓。
We need to silicone the edge of the sink. 我們得在水槽邊緣打上矽膠。
He used a steady hand to silicone the bathtub seam. 他穩穩地在浴缸接縫處上矽膠。
The dress is made of high-quality soft and lightweight silk. 這件洋裝是由高品質、柔軟輕巧的絲綢製成的。
China has a long and rich history of producing beautiful silk fabrics. 中國生產美麗絲織品的歷史悠久且豐富。
The club will silk-screen the logo onto T-shirts. 社團會把標誌網印到衣服上。
We learned to silk-screen simple designs in art class. 我們在美術課學會網印簡單圖案。

meaning: 四 絲綢一樣的,柔軟光潔的
sentences: She wore a silken scarf to the dinner. 她戴著一條絲質圍巾去晚餐。
The cat had a silken coat. 那隻貓有柔滑的毛。
The lotion made her skin feel silky. 乳液讓她的皮膚摸起來很絲滑。
The cat had silky black fur. 那隻貓有柔滑的黑色毛。
She put a small plant on the window sill. 她在窗台上放了一盆小植物。
Workers repaired the damaged sill at the canal lock. 工人修理了運河閘門受損的底檻。
He felt very silly after making such a simple and stupid mistake. 犯了這麼簡單愚蠢的錯誤後，他覺得自己好傻。
Don't be silly; there's no such thing as a ghost in the house. 別傻了；家裡沒鬼這種東西。

meaning: 資訊系統中的一種結構，與其他結構的聯網程度較差，資料交換受到阻礙。
sentences: The farmer stored corn in a tall silo. 農夫把玉米存放在高高的筒倉裡。
Different teams worked in a silo and rarely shared data. 不同團隊各自封閉作業，很少分享資料。
The old survey described the silva of the valley. 舊調查描述了山谷裡的森林樹木。
Fires changed the silva in the mountain area. 火災改變了山區的林木分布。
She wore a beautiful silver necklace that matched her dress perfectly. 她戴了一條漂亮的銀項鍊，與她的洋裝完美搭配。
Every cloud has a silver lining, so never lose hope. 黑暗中總有一線曙光，所以永遠不要失去希望。

meaning: 銀器；餐桌上使用的刀叉匙等餐具。
sentences: Please polish the silverware before the guests arrive for dinner. 晚餐客人到來前，請先把銀器擦亮。
The restaurant keeps its silverware in a drawer beside the plates. 那家餐廳把餐具放在盤子旁邊的抽屜裡。
Moonlight gave the river a silvery shine. 月光讓河面泛起銀色光澤。
Her silvery laugh carried across the yard. 她清亮如銀鈴的笑聲傳過整個院子。
The flight sim helped him practice landing. 飛行模擬程式幫助他練習降落。
The teacher wrote the main sim at the top of the page. 老師把主題寫在頁面上方。
Sime ordered tea while waiting for the bus. 西梅等公車時點了茶。
The note was signed by Sime at the bottom. 便條底下署名是西梅。

meaning: 西米亞；猿猴類名或名稱
sentences: The old chart used simia for an ape-like animal. 舊圖表用西米亞指一種像猿的動物。
The student copied simia from the zoology list. 學生從動物學清單中抄下西米亞這個名稱。
The two brothers look very similar, especially around the eyes. 這兩兄弟長得很像，尤其是眼睛周圍。
We share very similar opinions on various social and political issues. 我們對各種社會與政治議題有著非常相似的看法。
The similarity between their voices fooled me. 他們聲音的相似性讓我聽錯了。
We noticed a similarity in the two recipes. 我們發現這兩份食譜有相似之處。
The sisters dressed similarly. 姐妹倆穿著相似。
If someone acts similarly, they do so in a way that is in a like style or manner. 如果某人的行為相似，他們會以相似的風格或方式這樣做。

meaning: 導致烹飪或導致緩慢加熱到沸點或低於沸點。
sentences: Simmer the soup for five minutes, then serve. 將湯煮五分鐘即可食用。
To simmer means to cause to cook or to cause to undergo heating slowly at or below the boiling point. 煨意味著導致烹飪或導致在沸點或沸點以下緩慢加熱。
Simon called his mother after work. 西蒙下班後打電話給母親。
The red backpack belongs to Simon. 那個紅色背包是西蒙的。

meaning: 傻瓜；過度討好喜歡對象的人
sentences: His friends joked that he was acting like a simp. 朋友開玩笑說他表現得太討好對方了。
Don't be a simp just to get attention. 不要為了得到注意就一味討好別人。
He would simper whenever the boss walked by. 老闆走過時他就會露出討好的傻笑。
She did not simper for compliments at the party. 她在派對上沒有為了稱讚而裝出討好的笑。
The instructions were so simple that even a child could follow them. 說明非常簡單，連小孩都能看懂。
I'm looking for a simple and effective solution to this problem. 我正在尋找一個簡單且有效的解決問題方法。
One half is a simple fraction. 二分之一是一個普通分數。
The worksheet asks students to reduce each simple fraction. 學習單要求學生約分每個普通分數。
The loan uses simple interest, not compound interest. 這筆貸款採用單利，而不是複利。
We learned how to calculate simple interest in math class. 我們在數學課學會計算單利。

meaning: 四 愚蠢的,頭腦簡單的
sentences: Do not treat him as simple-minded just because he asks questions. 不要因為他問問題就把他當成頭腦簡單的人。
The movie gives a simple-minded answer to a hard problem. 這部電影對難題給出過度簡化的答案。
The village simpler dried herbs by the window. 村裡的採藥草者把草藥晾在窗邊。
A simpler taught the children which leaves could heal a cut. 那位採藥草者教孩子哪些葉子能處理割傷。

meaning: 四 傻瓜,易上當受騙的人
sentences: The cruel boys called him a simpleton. 那些刻薄的男孩叫他傻瓜。
He is kind, but he is not a simpleton. 他很善良，但不是傻子。
The critics praised the design of the building for its modern simplicity. 評論家稱讚這座建築的設計具有現代的簡約（簡單）感。
She was known for her simple lifestyle and natural beauty and simplicity. 她以簡單的生活方式和自然的純樸（樸素）美而聞名。

meaning: 簡化 的行為或已經 簡化 的行為。
sentences: The chart is a simplification of a complex process. 這張圖是複雜流程的簡化版。
Too much simplification can hide important details. 過度簡化可能會掩蓋重要細節。
The simplified map helped us find the station quickly. 簡化過的地圖幫我們很快找到車站。
I prefer the simplified instructions on the box. 我比較喜歡盒子上簡化過的說明。
The teacher asked the students to simplify the complex math equations. 老師要求學生簡化那些複雜的數學方程式。
The new software is designed to simplify the process of data analysis. 這款新軟體旨在簡化數據分析的流程。

meaning: 以簡化概念或問題的方式，從而失去其細微差別和複雜性或忽略重要細節。
sentences: That answer is too simplistic for such a hard issue. 對這麼困難的問題來說，那個答案太過簡化。
The movie gives a simplistic view of city life. 這部電影對城市生活的描寫過於簡單。
I simply don't have enough time to finish all the work today. 我純粹是今天沒有足夠的時間完成所有工作。
The solution to the problem is simply to work harder and smarter. 解決問題的方法純粹就是更努力、更聰明地工作。

meaning: 建模、複製、複製行為、外觀或屬性。
sentences: We will use a smoke machine to simulate the fog you will actually encounter. 我們將使用煙霧機來模擬您實際遇到的霧。
This video game simulates a pinball machine. 該視頻遊戲模擬彈珠機。

meaning: 模擬系統或環境以預測實際行為的東西。
sentences: This exercise is a simulation of actual battle conditions. 此次演習是模擬實戰情況。
The most reliable simulation predicts that the hurricane will turn north. 最可靠的模擬預測颶風將轉向北方。

meaning: 一款嘗試真實再現體驗的遊戲。
sentences: The flight simulator helped him practice landing. 飛行模擬器幫助他練習降落。
Students used a driving simulator before going on the road. 學生上路前先使用駕駛模擬器。
The movie reached millions of people through its simultaneous world premiere. 這部電影透過全球同步首映傳達給了數百萬人。
The scientists observed several simultaneous changes in the research data. 科學家們觀察到研究數據中出現了幾項同時發生的變化。
In many major religions, lying is considered a very serious sin. 在許多主要宗教中，撒謊被認為是一項非常嚴重的罪過。
He confessed his sins and sought forgiveness from his community. 他懺悔了自己的罪過，並尋求社群的原諒。
Sina appeared as the company name on the sign. 招牌上出現新浪這個公司名稱。
She saved the contact under the name Sina. 她把聯絡人存成新浪這個名稱。
I have been living in this city since I was a small child. 我從小就住在這座城市。
Since it is raining outside, we should stay at home. 既然外面在下雨，我們就待在家裡吧。
Please accept my sincere apologies for my earlier rude behavior. 請接受我為早前粗魯行為所做的真誠道歉。
She has a very sincere personality and always tells the truth. 她性格非常真誠，總是說實話。

meaning: 以真誠或認真的方式；誠實地。
sentences: I sincerely hope they make it home safely. 我衷心希望他們能夠平安回家。
If someone acts sincerely, they do so in a way that is in a sincere or earnest manner; honestly. 如果一個人真誠地行事，他會以真誠或認真的方式這樣做；誠實地。
She spoke with such sincerity that everyone in the room believed her. 她說話非常真誠，房間裡的每個人都相信她。
We should always treat others with sincerity and respect if we want to build trust. 如果我們想建立信任，就應該始終以真誠和尊重的態度對待他人。
The old map marked Sind near the river. 舊地圖把信德標在河流附近。
The story begins in Sind during a dry summer. 故事從乾燥夏季的信德開始。
We used sine to find the height of the triangle. 我們用正弦求三角形的高度。
The calculator has a key for sine. 計算機上有正弦按鍵。
The injury damaged a sinew in his hand. 那次受傷傷到他手上的一條肌腱。
Trust is the sinew of a strong team. 信任是強大團隊的力量來源。
The climber had sinewy arms from years of training. 那位攀岩者多年訓練後手臂結實。
A sinewy branch held the heavy fruit. 強韌的樹枝撐住沉重果實。
He felt sinful after lying to his friend. 他對朋友說謊後覺得有罪惡感。
The dessert tasted almost sinful. 那道甜點好吃到像是一種罪過。
She has a beautiful voice and loves to sing in the choir. 她有一副好嗓音，喜歡在合唱團唱歌。
The birds were singing happily in the trees this morning. 鳥兒今早正在樹上開心地唱歌。
He is a world-famous opera singer with a powerful voice. 他是一位世界聞名的歌劇演唱家，擁有強而有力的嗓音。
The leading singer gave a brilliant performance at the concert. 主唱在音樂會上展現了精湛的演出。
He is currently single and focusing on his professional career. 他目前單身，專注於他的職業生涯。
There was not a single cloud in the clear blue sky this morning. 今天早上晴朗的藍天中連一朵雲都沒有。
Cars moved slowly in a single line. 車子排成單行慢慢前進。
Please stand in a single line outside the classroom. 請在教室外排成一列。
I bought a single ticket to Tainan. 我買了一張到台南的單程票。
A single ticket is cheaper than a return ticket. 單程票比來回票便宜。
She plays singles better than doubles. 她單打比雙打打得好。
The tennis club holds a singles match every Friday. 網球社每週五舉辦單打比賽。

meaning: 單獨出生的兒童或動物，而不是雙胞胎或其他多胞胎。
sentences: The baby was a singleton, not a twin. 那個嬰兒是單胞胎，不是雙胞胎。
The list stores each singleton only once. 清單中每個單一項目只儲存一次。
She has a singular talent for music. 她在音樂上有非凡天分。
Use a singular verb with this subject. 這個主詞要搭配單數動詞。

meaning: 獨特、獨特、奇特、不尋常或不尋常的狀態。
sentences: His style has a strange singularity. 他的風格有一種奇特的獨特性。
The physics class discussed a black hole singularity. 物理課討論了黑洞奇點。
The alley looked sinister after the lights went out. 燈熄後那條巷子看起來很陰森。
His sinister grin made everyone step back. 他那陰險的笑讓大家都後退了一步。
The ship hit an iceberg and began to sink in the cold ocean. 船撞上冰山，開始在冰冷的大海中下沉。
Please put the dirty dishes in the kitchen sink after you finish. 用餐後請將髒盤子放進廚房水槽。
Food scraps blocked the sink drain. 食物碎屑堵住了水槽排水孔。
He cleaned the sink drain with hot water. 他用熱水清理水槽排水管。
I had a sinking feeling when the phone rang at midnight. 半夜電話響時我有一種不祥的預感。
The sinking boat drifted toward the rocks. 那艘正在下沉的船漂向岩石。

meaning: 具有消極品質的人；做壞事的人。過著享樂主義生活的人；一個自我放縱的人。
sentences: The sermon said every sinner can change. 講道說每個罪人都能改變。
He called himself a sinner after hurting his family. 他傷害家人後稱自己是罪人。
The graph of the sound wave looked like a sinusoid. 那個聲波圖看起來像正弦曲線。
Students drew a sinusoid on the board. 學生在黑板上畫了一條正弦曲線。
She took a slow sip of her hot coffee and stared out of the window. 她慢慢啜飲了一口熱咖啡，望向窗外。
Would you like to have a sip of my refreshing fruit juice? 你想嚐一口（啜飲）我的清爽果汁嗎？

meaning: 非標準字串，疑為拼寫或辨識錯誤
sentences: I found siportj in the damaged scan. 我在損壞的掃描檔裡看到一串疑似錯字。
The label showed siportj instead of a real word. 那張標籤出現了一串不像正式單字的字母。
Excuse me, Sir, could you please tell me the time? 先生，請問現在幾點？
Yes, Sir, I will finish the task as soon as possible. 是的，長官，我會儘快完成任務。
The farmer kept the sire in a separate field. 農夫把那隻公種畜養在另一塊田裡。
That colt has a famous sire from Ireland. 那匹小馬的父系種馬來自愛爾蘭且很有名。

meaning: 一群引誘水手死在岩石上的仙女之一。
sentences: The ambulance siren woke us up. 救護車警笛聲把我們吵醒。
In the myth, the siren sang to passing sailors. 神話中，海妖對路過的水手歌唱。
I ordered sirloin steak for dinner. 我晚餐點了沙朗牛排。
The butcher sliced the sirloin into thick pieces. 肉販把牛里脊切成厚片。
The rug is made from strong sisal fibers. 這張地毯由堅韌的劍麻纖維製成。
Sisal rope is useful in the garden. 劍麻繩在花園裡很好用。

meaning: 對女性的禮貌稱呼（南非英語）
sentences: The cashier said sisi and smiled at the customer. 收銀員用禮貌稱呼招呼那位女顧客並微笑。
In the market, people called her sisi out of respect. 在市場裡，人們出於尊重這樣稱呼她。

meaning: 疑似專名，指某種儀式名稱
sentences: The poster mentioned a sisi ceremony on Saturday. 海報提到週六有一場以這名稱舉行的儀式。
We heard drums before the sisi ceremony began. 那場以這名稱舉行的儀式開始前，我們先聽見鼓聲。

meaning: 疑似專名，指某款油類產品
