meaning: 經過一段時間後取得意想不到的成功的事情。
sentences: The sofa can turn into a sleeper for guests. 這張沙發可以變成客人睡的沙發床。
That quiet player became the sleeper of the tournament. 那位低調選手成了比賽中的黑馬。
I had a sleepless night before the exam. 考試前一晚我幾乎沒睡。
The new parents looked sleepless at breakfast. 那對新手父母吃早餐時看起來很沒睡飽。
I always feel a bit sleepy in the middle of the afternoon. 我通常在下午三四點時會感到有點小睏。
The warm milk made the little child feel very sleepy and relaxed. 熱牛奶讓那個小孩感到非常睏倦且放鬆。
The top button of his shirt sleeve was loose and needed fixing. 他襯衫袖口的扣子鬆了，需要修補。
She rolled up her sleeves and started working on the garden. 她捲起袖子，開始在花園裡忙活。
She has a slender and elegant figure like a professional dancer. 她身材纖細優雅，就像一位職業舞者。
The beautiful vase stood on a slender glass pedestal. 漂亮的噴花瓶放在一個細長的玻璃基座上。

meaning: 向側面移動某物（通常是鐵路線）。
sentences: The single line was slewed onto the disused up formation to make way for the future redoubling. 單線被轉向廢棄的隊形，為未來的加倍讓路。
To slew means to move something (usually a railway line) sideways. 迴轉意味著橫向移動某物（通常是鐵路線）。
Would you like another slice of delicious homemade apple pie? 妳想再要一片美味的手作蘋果派嗎？
She used a sharp knife to slice the fresh bread into pieces. 她用一把利刀將新鮮麵包切成片。

meaning: 因液體覆蓋而導致滑溜或光滑；常用於形容外貌。
sentences: This rain is making the roads slick. 這場雨使道路變得濕滑。
The top coating of lacquer gives this finish a slick look. 面漆使表面看起來光滑。
The glass can slide off the tray easily. 那個玻璃杯很容易從托盤上滑下去。
The kids love to slide down the hill on cardboard. 孩子們很愛坐著紙板從山坡滑下來。

meaning: 一個小 三明治 ，通常放在溫暖的 小圓麵包 。
sentences: Move the slider to adjust the volume. 移動滑桿調整音量。
We ordered small beef sliders for lunch. 我們午餐點了迷你牛肉堡。
The closet has a sliding door that saves space. 那個衣櫃有一道節省空間的拉門。
We fixed the sliding window before the rain came. 我們在下雨前修好了滑動窗。
There is a slight tear in my jacket sleeve. 我的外套袖子有一點小裂口。
We noticed a slight change in her voice. 我們聽出她聲音有細微變化。

meaning: 在很小的程度上或程度上。
sentences: He weighed slightly less than his wife who was a foot shorter. 他的體重比他矮一英尺的妻子略輕。
If someone acts slightly, they do so in a way that is to a small extent or degree. 如果某人的行為輕微，則他們以較小程度或程度的方式這樣做。
She has a slim and athletic figure because she exercises regularly. 她身材苗條且健美，因為她定期運動。
The new laptop is very slim and lightweight, making it easy to carry. 這台新筆電非常薄且輕巧，方便攜帶。

meaning: 任何粘液物质；或从某些动物（例如蜗牛或蛞蝓）的身体中渗出的粘液状物质。
sentences: The kids made green slime in science class. 孩子們在自然課做了綠色黏液。
Slime covered the rocks near the pond. 池塘旁的石頭覆滿黏滑物。

meaning: 性質相似、覆蓋或塗抹或富含黏液。
sentences: The frog's body was all slimy. 青蛙的全身都是黏糊糊的。
Something described as slimy is resembling, of the nature of, covered or daubed with, or abounding in slime. 被描述為黏液的東西類似於黏液的性質，被黏液覆蓋或塗抹，或富含黏液。
Be careful or you will slip on the wet floor. 小心，不然你會在濕地板上滑倒。
I watched the key slip from his pocket. 我看見鑰匙從他口袋滑了出來。
The box says slipper(s) are sold near the back door. 盒子上寫著拖鞋在後門附近販售。
We keep our slipper(s) on the mat by the stairs. 我們把拖鞋放在樓梯旁的墊子上。
These bathroom tiles get slippery after a shower. 這些浴室磁磚洗完澡後會很滑。
The fish was so slippery that it jumped from my hand. 那條魚太滑，從我手裡跳了出去。

meaning: 某物滑倒的行為；一張紙條；打滑或突然鬆動。
sentences: She caught the cup before it finished slipping off the table. 杯子快從桌上滑落前，她把它接住了。
His grades were slipping because he missed too many classes. 他缺太多課，成績開始下滑。
He slit the bag open and the rice began pouring out. 他把袋子打開，米開始倒出來。
To slit means to cut a narrow opening. 切縫的意思是切出一個狹窄的開口。
She cut a thin sliver of cheese for her crackers. 她切了一小薄片起司配餅乾。
A sliver of light streamed through the gap in the curtains. 一束光線從窗簾縫隙中射入。
He is such a slob that he leaves dirty clothes all over the floor. 他很邋遢，總是把髒衣服丟得滿地都是。
Don't call your brother a slob just because his desk is messy. 不要只因為你哥哥的桌子很亂就叫他邋遢鬼。
The company's marketing slogan is very catchy and easy to remember. 這家公司的行銷標語（口號）非常響亮且容易記住。
The protesters were shouting slogans demanding better working conditions. 抗議者高喊口號，要求更好的工作條件。
The skiers were racing down the steep and snowy mountain slope. 滑雪者正從陡峭多雪的山坡上衝下來。
Our house is located on a gentle slope overlooking the entire bay. 我們的房子位於一個俯瞰整個海灣的緩坡上。
The manager criticized him for his sloppy work and lack of attention. 經理批評他工作馬虎（草率）且不專心。
The playground was very sloppy after the heavy rain last night. 大雨過後，操場變得非常泥濘。
Please insert the coin into the narrow slot to start the machine. 請將硬幣插入窄槽以啟動機器。
I have a ten-minute time slot available for a quick meeting tomorrow. 我明天有一個十分鐘的時段（位置）可以進行簡短會議。

meaning: 懶惰；思維遲緩；不願採取行動或勞動。
sentences: Sloth kept him on the sofa all weekend. 懶惰讓他整個週末都待在沙發上。
The teacher warned that sloth would hurt his progress. 老師提醒他懶散會影響進步。

meaning: 頭垂下來；下垂的姿勢；跛行的樣子
sentences: Do not slouch while you sit at the desk. 坐在書桌前不要駝背。
He walked in with a tired slouch. 他帶著疲倦的垂肩姿勢走進來。

meaning: 蛇或其他爬行動物脫落的皮膚。
sentences: The snake left its slough under the rock. 蛇把蛻下的皮留在石頭下。
The wound began to slough off dead skin. 傷口開始脫落死皮。
The traffic was very slow this morning because of the heavy rain. 由於大雨，今天早上的交通非常緩慢。
He is a slow but steady worker who never makes mistakes. 他是一個動作慢但穩健、從不犯錯的員工。

meaning: 速度降低，或生產水準、經濟活動等下降。
sentences: Traffic had a slowdown near the tunnel. 隧道附近交通變慢。
The factory reported a slowdown in production. 工廠回報生產速度下降。

meaning: 從液體懸浮液中分離出固體。
sentences: Workers removed sludge from the bottom of the tank. 工人清除了槽底的污泥。
The river smelled bad because of the dark sludge. 河水因深色污泥而發臭。
A fat slug crawled across the garden path. 一隻肥蛞蝓爬過花園小路。
We moved the pot because a slug was hiding under it. 我們移開花盆，因為下面躲著一隻蛞蝓。

meaning: 額外安打率較高的擊球手。
sentences: The slugger hit the ball over the fence. 強打者把球打過圍牆。
Fans cheered when the slugger came to bat. 強打者上場打擊時，球迷歡呼。
I feel sluggish after a very heavy lunch. 我午餐吃太飽後會覺得昏沉沒勁。
The old laptop stayed sluggish all morning. 那台舊筆電整個早上都跑得很慢。
Many people in the city live in crowded and unsanitary slums. 市內許多人住在擁擠且不衛生的貧民窟裡。
The project aims to improve the living conditions in the local slums. 該專案旨在改善當地貧民窟的生活條件。

meaning: 睡眠狀態非常淺，幾乎是清醒的。非常沉重的睡眠狀態。
sentences: The baby fell into a peaceful slumber. 嬰兒進入安穩的睡眠。
A loud noise woke him from his slumber. 一聲巨響把他從睡夢中吵醒。
Stock prices began to slump following the news of the financial crisis. 隨著金融危機的消息傳出，股價開始驟降（暴跌）。
The company's profits have slumped significantly over the past year. 公司的利潤在過去一年中顯著衰落。

meaning: 不名譽的標記；枯萎病或污點。
sentences: Do not use a slur against any group. 不要用歧視性字眼攻擊任何群體。
The comment sounded like a slur. 那句評論聽起來像侮辱。

meaning: 半融化的雪或冰，通常位於地面上。
sentences: Cars splashed slush onto the sidewalk. 車子把融雪泥濺到人行道上。
Her boots were wet from the street slush. 她的靴子被街上的雪泥弄濕了。
The actor apologized for using slut in the scene. 那位演員為在那場戲裡使用侮辱字眼道歉。
She was hurt when classmates threw around slut as a joke. 同學拿這種侮辱字眼開玩笑時，她很受傷。
The makeup, high heels and short skirt made her look so slutty. 妝容、高跟鞋和短裙讓她看起來很放蕩。
Something described as slutty is of, resembling, or suitable for, a slut. 被描述為放蕩的東西是屬於、類似或適合蕩婦的。
He gave her a sly smile as he planned the surprise party. 他在計畫驚喜派對時對她露出了狡猾的（淘氣的）微笑。
The sly fox managed to escape from the hunters through the woods. 狡猾的狐狸成功地穿過森林逃離了獵人。
The mother gave her child a quick smack on the hand. 母親迅速拍了一下孩子的手。
He smacked his lips after tasting the delicious food. 他嚐了美味的食物後咂了咂嘴。

meaning: 一連串的巴掌聲；打某人的行為。
sentences: The smacking sound came from the kitchen. 啪啪聲從廚房傳來。
He got a smacking for breaking the vase. 他因打破花瓶而挨了一巴掌。
They live in a small but cozy house in the countryside. 他們住在鄉下一間雖小但溫馨的房子裡。
Every small effort counts toward achieving a big goal. 每一份微小的努力對於達成大目標都至關重要。
We need a smaller bag for the short trip. 這趟短行程我們需要一個更小的包。
Her dog chose the smaller bed by the window. 她的狗選了窗邊那張較小的床。

meaning: 由痘病毒科天花病毒引起的一種急性、高度傳染性的、常常致命的疾病。它在 20 世紀 70 年代被徹底消滅，但實驗室中仍然存在。倖存下來的人都留下了麻子。
sentences: Smallpox was once a deadly disease. 天花曾經是一種致命疾病。
Vaccination helped eliminate smallpox. 疫苗接種幫助消滅天花。
He is a very smart student who always gets the highest marks. 他是一個非常聰明的學生，總是拿到最高分。
Modern smartphones are much more than just communication devices. 現代智慧型手機不僅僅是通訊設備。
The ball smashed the glass vase into a thousand tiny pieces. 球把玻璃花瓶砸得粉碎（打碎）。
His debut album was a smash hit and topped the charts for weeks. 他的首張專輯獲得了重大成功（轟動一時），連續數週蟬聯榜首。
That blue dress looks smashing on you. 那件藍洋裝穿在你身上非常好看。
We had a smashing time at the beach. 我們在海邊玩得非常開心。

meaning: 透過摩擦將（一種物質，尤其是有顏色或髒的物質）散佈在表面上。
sentences: The artist smeared paint over the canvas in broad strokes. 藝術家用粗筆畫在畫布上塗抹顏料。
To smear means to spread (a substance, especially one that colours or is dirty) across a surface by rubbing. 塗抹意味著透過摩擦將（一種物質，尤其是著色或骯髒的物質）塗抹在表面上。
I love the smell of fresh coffee in the morning. 我喜歡早晨新鮮咖啡的味道。
Can you smell something burning? I think the toast is ready. 你聞到燒焦味了嗎？我想吐司好了。
I caught the dog smelling my lunch box. 我撞見狗在聞我的便當盒。
She stood in the shop smelling each candle. 她站在店裡逐一聞每根蠟燭。

meaning: 有表明存在設計問題的跡象；有代碼味道。
sentences: That smelly code needs to be refactored. 那些臭程式碼需要重構。
Something described as smelly is having signs that suggest a design problem; having a code smell. 被描述為“有臭味”的東西是指有跡象表明存在設計問題；有代碼味道。
The smelter processed metal from the mine. 冶煉廠處理礦場來的金屬。
My grandfather worked as a smelter for many years. 我祖父當了多年冶煉工。
She had a warm and friendly smile that made me feel welcome. 她帶著溫暖友善的笑容，讓我感到賓至如歸。
He smiled at me and waved his hand. 他對我微笑並揮了揮手。
The smiling child waved at the camera. 微笑的孩子向鏡頭揮手。
She kept smiling even after a long day. 忙了一整天後，她仍保持微笑。
He had a smirk on his face after winning the game. 獲勝後，他臉上帶著得意的笑。
Don't smirk at me; it's not funny! 別對我傻笑；這一點也不好笑！
The storm seemed to smite every tree on the hill. 暴風雨像是狠狠打擊了山上的每棵樹。
In the legend, the gods smite liars without warning. 傳說裡諸神會突然懲罰說謊的人。
The city is covered in a thick blanket of smog during the winter months. 冬天這座城市被一層厚厚的霧霾所覆蓋。
The government is trying to reduce air pollution and eliminate smog. 政府正試圖減少空氣污染並消除煙霧（霧霾）。
Thick smoke filled the kitchen when the oil got too hot. 油太熱時，廚房裡滿是煙。
We saw black smoke rising over the garage. 我們看到黑煙從車庫上方竄起。
The only smoker in my family quit last year. 我家唯一的吸菸者去年戒菸了。
The restaurant asked every smoker to use the patio. 那家餐廳請所有吸菸者到露台區。
A smoking pan set off the alarm. 一只冒煙的平底鍋觸發了警報。
The hotel has no smoking rooms on this floor. 這一層的飯店客房都禁菸。
The bar felt smoky even with the windows open. 就算開著窗，那間酒吧還是煙霧瀰漫。
This sauce has a smoky taste from the grill. 這個醬汁有來自烤架的煙燻味。
The surface of the lake was perfectly smooth and calm at dawn. 日出時分，湖面非常平滑且平靜。
The transition to the new system went very smooth without issues. 向新系統的過渡進展得非常順利，沒有問題。

meaning: 使平滑的人或工具；更平順的
sentences: The carpenter used a smoother on the wooden board. 木匠用刨平工具處理木板。
This route is a smoother for heavy traffic. 這條路線能讓繁忙交通更順暢。
The meeting went smoothly once the slides loaded. 投影片載入後，會議就順利進行了。
She backed the car smoothly into the narrow space. 她平穩地把車倒進狹窄車位。

meaning: 給定域上的最高階導數（可微性類別）。
sentences: The smoothness of the table made it easy to clean. 桌面的平滑讓它很容易清潔。
This cream improves the smoothness of dry skin. 這款乳霜能改善乾燥肌膚的柔滑度。
Too many blankets can smother a baby. 太多毛毯可能會悶到嬰兒。
Please do not smother the fire with plastic. 請不要用塑膠去蓋熄火源。

meaning: 污點 或 塗抹 ，特別是 ）>Wiki* //~ href="/wiki/sooty" title="sooty">烏黑 一個。
sentences: There is a black smudge on your sleeve. 你的袖子上有一塊黑污痕。
She wiped the smudge from the mirror. 她擦掉鏡子上的污跡。
He looked smug after solving the puzzle first. 他第一個解開謎題後看起來很得意。
Her smug smile faded when the answer was checked. 答案一核對，她那副得意的笑就消失了。
The police arrested the suspect for trying to smuggle illegal drugs. 警方逮捕了企圖走私非法毒品的嫌疑人。
They tried to smuggle the rare artifacts out of the country in a truck. 他們試圖用卡車將稀有文物偷運出境。
I packed a snack for the train ride. 我為火車行程帶了一份點心。
An apple is my usual afternoon snack. 蘋果是我下午常吃的點心。
We hit a snag while installing the software. 安裝軟體時我們遇到一個小問題。
A small snag in the fabric caught her ring. 布料上的小勾線勾住了她的戒指。
A small snail was slowly crawling across the garden path. 一隻小蝸牛正緩慢地在花園小路上爬行。
The traffic was moving at a snail's pace because of the accident. 由於事故，交通正以蝸牛般緩慢的速度移動。
Many people are naturally afraid of snakes and other reptiles. 許多人天生害怕蛇和其他爬行類動物。
The path snakes through the dense forest and up the mountain. 這條路蜿蜒穿過茂密的森林，直達山上。
The dry branch managing to snap under the weight of the snow. 枯枝在積雪的重量下竟然折斷了。
He managed to snap a beautiful photo of the rare exotic bird. 他設法拍到了一張那種稀有外來鳥類的漂亮照片。
The market sold fresh snapper by the kilo. 市場裡按公斤賣新鮮鯛魚。
We grilled a whole snapper for dinner. 我們晚餐烤了一整條鯛魚。
That jacket gives him a snappy look. 那件外套讓他看起來很俐落。
Her snappy reply ended the argument fast. 她一句尖銳的回話很快結束了爭執。

meaning: 瞥見某事；某一時刻某事物的描繪。
sentences: He took a snapshot of the sunset. 他拍了一張夕陽快照。
The report gives a snapshot of the housing market. 報告呈現了房市的概況。
The hunter set a snare to catch the animal. 獵人設下陷阱來捕捉動物。
She was snared by his lies and empty promises. 她被他的謊言與空頭支票所誘捕（受騙）。
The dog began to snarl at the stranger. 這隻狗開始對陌生人咆哮。
The traffic snarl caused a long delay on the highway. 交通混亂（糾結）導致公路嚴重延誤。
The thief tried to snatch her bag while she was waiting for the bus. 小偷在她等公車時試圖奪走她的包。
The team managed to snatch victory in the final minutes of the match. 該隊在比賽最後幾分鐘奪得了勝利。
My hat was snatched by the wind at the corner. 我的帽子在街角被風吹走了。
The bag looked snatched from the seat in seconds. 那個包包看起來幾秒內就被從座位上搶走了。
We decided to sneak into the movie theater through the back door. 我們決定偷偷溜進（潛行）電影院後門。
The little boy tried to sneak a cookie from the kitchen before dinner. 小男孩試圖從廚房偷拿（偷偷地做）一塊餅乾。
The sign says sneaker(s) are not allowed on the court today. 標示說今天球場上不准穿運動鞋。
I left my sneaker(s) by the front bench. 我把運動鞋放在前門的長凳旁。
I found his sneaky behavior to be rather suspicious and annoying. 我發現他鬼鬼祟祟的行為相當可疑且令人討厭。
It was a sneaky trick to try and win the match unfairly. 試圖透過不公平的卑鄙手段贏得比賽。
He tried to hide his sneer during the speech. 演講時，他試著掩飾自己的冷笑。
Do not sneer at people who are still learning. 不要嘲笑還在學習的人。
The dust in the empty room made him sneeze several times. 房間裡的灰塵讓他打了好幾個噴嚏。
Please cover your mouth when you sneeze to prevent spreading germs. 打噴嚏時請捂住嘴，以防傳播細菌。
The dog began to sniff around the tree, looking for the ball. 狗開始在樹周圍聞來聞去，尋找球。
She sniffed with disapproval when she heard his ridiculous proposal. 當她聽到他那荒謬的提案時，不屑地哼了一聲（蔑視）。
Please snip this loose thread for me. 你可以幫我把這條鬆線剪掉嗎。
She used tiny scissors to snip the herbs. 她用小剪刀把香草剪碎。

meaning: 煙蒂；鷸；狙擊或惡意批評
sentences: He picked up a snipe from the sidewalk. 他從人行道上撿起一個煙蒂。
A snipe flew low over the wet field. 一隻鷸低低飛過濕地。

meaning: 使用遠程小型武器從隱蔽位置進行精確攻擊的人。
sentences: A sniper hid on the roof. 狙擊手藏在屋頂上。
The soldiers searched the hill for a sniper. 士兵在山丘上搜索狙擊手。

meaning: 某物的一小部分，例如歌曲或織物；樣本。
sentences: She played a short snippet of the song. 她播放了那首歌的一小段。
The article included a snippet from the interview. 文章收錄了訪談中的一小段。
Don't snoop around in my private room! 別在我的私人房間裡到處窺探！
She caught him snooping through her emails. 她抓到他正在偷看她的電子郵件。
I like to snooze for ten minutes after lunch. 我喜歡午飯後小睡十分鐘。
He hit snooze twice and missed the bus. 他按了兩次貪睡，結果錯過公車。
My uncle tends to snore on long car rides. 我叔叔長途搭車時很容易打呼。
The puppy began to snore beside the heater. 那隻小狗在暖爐旁開始打呼。

meaning: 哼鼻子；噴鼻息；嗤之以鼻
sentences: The horse will snort when a stranger gets close. 陌生人靠近時，那匹馬會噴鼻息。
She gave a short snort at the silly rumor. 她對那個蠢謠言哼了一聲。

meaning: 野獸（如豬）的長而突出的鼻子、嘴巴和下巴。
sentences: The pig pushed its snout into the mud. 豬把鼻子拱進泥裡。
The dog rested its snout on my knee. 那隻狗把鼻口靠在我膝上。
The ground was covered with a thick layer of white snow. 地面覆蓋著一層厚厚的白雪。
It hasn't snowed in this area for more than ten years. 這個地區已經十多年沒下過雪了。

meaning: 一種小蛋糕，通常是奶油餡的，上面覆蓋著巧克力糖霜和椰絲。
sentences: He threw a snowball at his brother. 他朝哥哥丟了一顆雪球。
The joke began to snowball online. 那個笑話開始在網路上越傳越大。
Heavy snowfall closed the mountain road. 大雪封閉了山路。
The first snowfall made the town look quiet. 第一場雪讓小鎮看起來很寧靜。

meaning: 雪晶體，具有近似六角對稱性。
sentences: A snowflake landed on her glove. 一片雪花落在她的手套上。
Every paper snowflake on the window had a different shape. 窗上的每片紙雪花形狀都不同。
The mountain peak looked beautiful with its white snowy cap. 山頂覆蓋著白雪，看起來非常漂亮。
We stayed at home and drank hot chocolate on a cold snowy day. 在寒冷的下雪天，我們待在家裡喝熱巧克力。
She felt the invitation snub was intentional. 她覺得沒有收到邀請是故意冷落。
Do not snub your teammates after a mistake. 隊友犯錯後不要冷落他們。

meaning: 用鼻子快速吸氣的動作；吸一口氣，吸一口氣。
sentences: He used snuff instead of smoking cigarettes. 他使用鼻煙，而不是抽菸。
The old box was full of dry snuff. 舊盒子裡裝滿乾鼻煙。
The cabin felt snug during the storm. 暴風雨時那間小木屋感覺很溫暖舒適。
These gloves are snug but not too tight. 這雙手套很合手，但不會太緊。

meaning: 靠近另一個人或物體躺下，擁抱或感到舒適。
sentences: My girlfriend and I love to snuggle. 我和女朋友喜歡依偎在一起。
The last drop of jager snuggled the corner of the pint. 最後一滴雅格啤酒緊貼在品脫啤酒的一角。
I was very tired, so I decided to go to bed early. 我很累，所以我決定早點睡覺。
She speaks English so well that people think she's a native speaker. 她英語說得非常好，人們以為她是母語人士。
The heavy rain began to soak through his clothes after just a few minutes. 幾分鐘後，大雨就開始滲透（浸透）他的衣服。
You should soak the beans in water overnight before cooking them. 烹飪豆子前應將其在水中浸泡一夜。
Please wash your hands thoroughly with warm water and soap. 請用溫水和肥皂徹底洗手。
She bought a bar of organic soap with a relaxing lavender scent. 她買了一塊帶有放鬆薰衣草香味的有機肥皂。
The eagle began to soar high above the mountains in the clear sky. 老鷹在清朗的天空中向著高山翱翔。
Stock prices began to soar following the news of the company's success. 隨著公司成功的消息傳出，股價開始激增。
The little girl began to sob quietly after she lost her favorite toy. 小女孩在弄丟心愛的玩具後開始輕聲啜泣。
She couldn't help but sob with joy when she heard the good news. 聽到好消息時，她禁不住喜極而泣（啜泣）。
He stayed sober and drove us home. 他保持清醒，開車送我們回家。
Her sober voice calmed the room. 她沉著的聲音讓整個房間安定下來。

meaning: 令人警醒的；令人清醒的
sentences: The empty reservoir was a sobering sight. 見到空掉的水庫令人警醒。
Her hospital visit had a sobering effect on him. 她去醫院探病這件事讓他清醒不少。

meaning: 不慌不忙的狀態或品質；平靜的狀態。
sentences: Sobriety helped him rebuild trust with his family. 戒酒清醒讓他重新建立家人的信任。
The driver had to prove his sobriety after the accident. 事故後，駕駛必須證明自己沒有酒醉。
Soccer is a very popular sport that attracts millions of fans. 足球是一項受歡迎的運動，吸引了數百萬名粉絲。
The kids are playing soccer in the park every Saturday morning. 孩子們每週六早上都在公園踢足球。
She is a very sociable person who enjoys meeting new people. 她是一個非常熱衷社交（好交際）的人，喜歡結識新朋友。
He became more sociable after joining the local community center. 加入當地社區中心後，他變得更加友善（好交際）。
She leads a very active social life and has many close friends. 她過著非常積極的社交生活，有很多親密的朋友。
Social media has changed the way we communicate with each other. 社交媒體改變了我們彼此溝通的方式。
The political scientist wrote a book about the history of socialism. 這位政治科學家寫了一本關於社會主義歷史的書。
Socialism is an ideology based on the principle of collective ownership. 社會主義是一種基於集體所有制原則的意識形態。
He has been an active member of the local socialist party for years. 他多年來一直是當地社會主義政黨的活躍成員。
The country was ruled by a socialist government for several decades. 該國由一個社會主義政府統治了幾十年。

meaning: 與他人互動、社交的行為。
sentences: Preschool helps children with socialization. 幼兒園幫助孩子學習社交。
Workplace socialization can make new employees feel welcome. 職場社交能讓新員工感到被接納。
My cat hides when guests socialize in the living room. 客人在客廳社交時，我的貓會躲起來。
It takes her time to socialize with new coworkers. 她需要一點時間和新同事熟絡。
She felt socially awkward at the first meeting. 第一次見面時，她在社交上覺得尷尬。
Children learn socially by playing with others. 孩子透過和別人玩耍來學習社交。

meaning: 屬於或關於社會或社會團體，或他們的活動、習俗等。
sentences: Housing costs are a societal problem. 住房成本是社會問題。
The report looks at societal changes after the pandemic. 報告探討疫情後的社會變化。
Education plays a vital role in the development of a modern society. 教育在現代社會的發展中扮演著至關重要的角色。
We must work together to solve the various problems in our society. 我們必須共同努力解決社會中的各種問題。

meaning: 社會學的或關於社會學的。
sentences: The book offers a sociological view of family life. 這本書從社會學角度看家庭生活。
She collected sociological data from interviews. 她從訪談中收集社會學資料。

meaning: 研究社會學領域的科學家；社會科學家。
sentences: A sociologist studied how families use public parks. 一位社會學家研究家庭如何使用公園。
The sociologist interviewed workers in three cities. 那位社會學家訪問了三座城市的工人。
She decided to major in sociology because she is interested in human behavior. 她決定主修社會學，因為她對人類行為感興趣。
Modern sociology explores the complex structures and dynamics of society. 現代社會學探索社會的複雜結構和動態。
She bought a new pair of warm wool socks for the winter. 她買了一雙新的暖和羊毛襪過冬。
He gave the punching bag a strong sock. 他用力擊打（猛擊）了沙袋。
The drawer label says sock(s) go on the top shelf. 抽屜標籤寫著短襪放在最上層。
I bought thick sock(s) for the winter trip. 我為冬季旅行買了厚短襪。
Please make sure you pull the plug out of the socket before cleaning the machine. 清潔機器前，請確保將插頭從插座中拔出。
The light bulb was not screwed properly into the socket, so it wouldn't turn on. 燈泡沒有正確旋入燈座（插座），所以打不開。
Would you like a glass of cold soda with your meal? 你想用餐時喝杯冷汽水嗎？
Drinking too much soda can be bad for your health and teeth. 喝太多汽水對你的健康和牙齒都不好。
We spent the whole evening lying on the sofa and watching movies. 我們整個晚上都躺在沙發上看電影。
The new sofa is very soft and comfortable. 這張新沙發非常柔軟舒適。
The new couch is very soft and comfortable to lie on. 這張新沙發非常柔軟，躺起來很舒服。
She spoke in a soft and gentle voice that made me feel at ease. 她用溫柔和緩的聲音說話，讓我感到安心。
My daughter plays softball after school. 我女兒放學後打壘球。
The interviewer started with a softball question. 面試官先問了一個簡單問題。
The butter will soften if you leave it at room temperature for an hour. 如果在室溫下放一小時，奶油會變軟。
The manager's voice began to soften as he realized she was telling the truth. 當經理意識到她在說實話時，語氣開始變得溫和。
The masseuse was rubbing my back too softly for my liking, so I asked her to go harder. 按摩師按摩我的背部的力道太輕了，我不喜歡，所以我讓她用力一點。
If someone acts softly, they do so in a way that is in a soft manner; gently. 如果某人的行為很溫和，那麼他們會以溫和的方式行事；輕輕地。
The new software allows users to edit photos and videos more easily. 這款新軟體允許使用者更輕鬆地編輯照片和影片。
We need to update the system software to ensure better security and performance. 我們需要更新系統軟體，以確保更好的安全性和性能。
The fries turned soggy before we got home. 我們回到家前薯條就變軟爛了。
My shoes felt soggy after the sudden rain. 突來的大雨讓我的鞋子濕透了。
She runs a soho from the spare bedroom. 她在空房間經營小型居家辦公業務。
Many designers start with a soho before renting a studio. 很多設計師在租工作室前會先用小型居家辦公模式起步。
The soil in this area is very rich and fertile for farming crops. 這個地區的土壤非常肥沃，適合耕種作物。
The children were playing happily with the soil in the garden. 孩子們正在花園裡開心地玩泥土。

meaning: 孤獨或痛苦時的安慰或安慰。
sentences: Music gave her solace after a hard day. 辛苦一天後，音樂給了她安慰。
He found solace in long walks by the river. 他在河邊長時間散步中找到慰藉。
Solar energy is a clean and renewable source of power for our homes. 太陽能是我們家庭的一種清潔且可再生的能源來源。
The solar system consists of the Sun and all the planets that orbit around it. 太陽系由太陽及其周圍運行的所有行星組成。

meaning: 任何各種易熔化的合金，通常是錫和鉛，用於修補、塗覆或連接金屬物體（通常很小）。
sentences: Use solder to join the two wires. 用焊料把兩條電線接起來。
The repairman heated the solder with a small tool. 修理師用小工具加熱焊料。
The brave soldiers fought for their country's freedom and peace. 勇敢的士兵為國家的自由與和平而戰。
My grandfather was a soldier in the army during the war. 我祖父在戰爭期間是一名軍人。
She is the sole survivor of the tragic plane crash last year. 她是那次慘烈空難中唯一的倖存者。
The sharp stone caused a small cut on the sole of his foot. 鋒利的石頭在他腳掌上劃了一個小口子。
The new chef was solely responsible for attending the grill. 新廚師全權負責參加燒烤活動。
If someone acts solely, they do so in a way that is alone; exclusively. 如果某人單獨行動，那麼他就是以單獨的方式行事；只。
The graduation ceremony was a very solemn and moving occasion. 畢業典禮是一個非常莊嚴且動人的場合。
He made a solemn promise never to reveal the secret to anyone. 他鄭重（嚴肅）地承諾絕不向任何人透露這個秘密。
The organization is soliciting donations for the refugees. 該組織正在為難民招募（請求）捐款。
Don't solicit for business in this residential area. 別在住宅區招攬生意。

meaning: 招攬行為或實例；請願;提議。
sentences: The sign says no solicitation at the door. 標示寫著門口禁止推銷。
The charity sent a polite solicitation for donations. 慈善機構寄出一封禮貌的募款請求。

meaning: 在美國部分地區，城市、城鎮或其他司法管轄區的首席法律官。
sentences: The solicitor prepared the contract for the buyer. 律師為買方準備合約。
She called a solicitor before signing the papers. 她簽文件前先打電話給律師。
He is very solicitous about his elderly mother's health. 他非常掛念他年邁母親的健康。
The doctor provided a solicitous care for the patient. 醫生為病人提供了熱切周到的照護。
I appreciate your solicitude for my well-being. 我感謝你對我福祉的掛念。
She expressed her solicitude about the future of the project. 她表達了對專案未來的憂慮。
The table is made of high-quality solid oak wood from local sources. 餐桌是由當地高品質的實心橡木製成的。
Water turns into solid ice when the temperature drops below zero. 當氣溫降到零度以下時，水會變成固態的冰。
The workers showed great solidarity during the national strike yesterday. 工人們在全國大罷工中展現了極大的團結。
The international community expressed solidarity with the victims of the crisis. 國際社會表達了對危機受害者的團結與支持。
If someone acts solidly, they do so in a way that is in a solid or firm manner. 如果一個人行事紮實，他就會以紮實或堅定的方式行事。
The speaker responded solidly during the discussion. 演講者在討論中做出了積極的回應。
He led a solitary life in a small wooden cottage in the mountains. 他獨自（孤獨地）生活在山間的一座小木屋裡。
The eagle is a solitary bird that hunts alone in the wilderness. 老鷹是一種獨自（單獨）在荒野中狩獵的鳥類。
She enjoyed the solitude of the quiet mountain village during her trip. 她在旅行期間享受著寧靜山村的孤獨（寂靜）。
Many writers seek solitude to focus on their work and creativity. 許多作家尋求獨處（隱居）以便專注於寫作和創意。
The young musician performed a brilliant violin solo at the concert. 這位年輕音樂家在音樂會上進行了精彩的小提琴獨奏。
He decided to go on a solo road trip across the country last summer. 他去年夏天決定獨自進行一場跨國公路旅行。
That mystery should be easily soluble. 這個謎團應該很容易解開。
Something described as soluble is able to be solved or explained. 被描述為可溶的事物能夠被解決或解釋。
We are working together to find an effective solution to the problem. 我們正共同努力為這個問題尋找一個有效的解決方案。
The scientific solution was based on years of dedicated research. 該科學解決方案是基於多年專注研究的成果。
He is a very smart student who can solve difficult math problems. 他是一個非常聰明的學生，能解決困難的數學題。
We need to find a way to solve this technical issue as soon as possible. 我們需要儘快找到解決這個技術問題的方法。

meaning: 具有溶解能力；造成解決方案。
sentences: Water is not a good solvent for oil. 水不是油的好溶劑。
The company is solvent again after selling land. 公司賣掉土地後又恢復償付能力。
She is a patient problem solver. 她是很有耐心的問題解決者。
The puzzle solver found the answer in ten minutes. 解謎者十分鐘內找到了答案。

meaning: 動物的整個軸向部分，包括頭、頸、軀幹和尾部。
sentences: The soma contains the main body of the nerve cell. 細胞體包含神經細胞的主要部分。
The diagram labels the soma beside the long axon. 圖中在長軸突旁標出細胞體。
The doctor asked whether the pain was somatic or emotional. 醫生問那種疼痛是身體上的還是情緒上的。
The therapist explained how stress can show up as somatic symptoms. 治療師解釋壓力如何表現在身體症狀上。
The room had a somber mood after the news. 消息傳來後，房間氣氛很沉重。
He wore a somber gray suit to the funeral. 他穿著深灰色西裝參加葬禮。
The room stayed sombre even at noon. 那個房間即使到了中午仍然很昏暗。
He wore a sombre coat to the memorial. 他穿著一件色調沉鬱的外套去追思會。
I still have some apples in the basket. 籃子裡還有一些蘋果。
I need some time before I answer. 我回答前需要一些時間。
Somebody is waiting for you at the reception. 有人在接待處等你。
He felt like somebody after winning the award. 獲獎後他覺得自己成了個大人物。
Someday I hope to travel around the world and see different cultures. 有一天我希望能環遊世界，看看不同的文化。
I'm sure that we will find a solution to this problem someday. 我確定我們有一天會找到解決這個問題的方法。
We managed to finish the project on time somehow, despite the delay. 儘管延誤了，我們還是不知何故設法準時完成了專案。
I'll find a way to help you somehow; don't worry too much. 我會不知何故（設法）找到幫妳的方法；別太擔心。
Someone left their umbrella on the bus. 有人把傘忘在了公車上。
I need to talk to someone about the problem. 我需要找人談談這個問題。
I think someone/somebody left a wet umbrella by my desk. 有人把一把濕雨傘留在我的桌邊。
I hope someone/somebody remembers the cake. 我希望有人記得帶蛋糕。
We can't find the damned thing, but it must be someplace. 我們找不到那該死的東西，但它一定在某個地方。
The team responded someplace to the change. 團隊在某個地方對這一變化做出了反應。
The old book spells somersault as somerset. 那本舊書以這個古老拼法表示翻筋斗。
A child tried a somerset on the grass. 一個孩子試著在草地上翻筋斗。
I have something important to tell you after the meeting. 會議結束後我有件重要的事要告訴妳。
Something strange happened in the office yesterday afternoon. 辦公室昨天下午發生了一些奇怪的事。
Let's meet for a coffee and a chat sometime next week. 我們下週某個時候見面喝杯咖啡聊聊天吧。
I would love to visit the historical museum sometime soon. 我很想在近期某個時候參觀那座歷史博物館。
Sometimes I like to go for a long walk alone to clear my mind. 有時我喜歡獨自長距離散步以清醒頭腦。
She sometimes forgets her umbrella and gets wet in the rain. 她有時會忘記帶傘，結果被雨淋濕。
The test results were somewhat better than we had expected. 測試結果比我們預想的要好一些。
I was somewhat surprised to hear the sudden news of his resignation. 聽到他突然辭職的消息，我感到有些驚訝。
I left my car keys somewhere, but I can't remember where. 我把車鑰匙丟在某個地方了，但記不起來在哪裡。
Let's go somewhere quiet where we can talk in peace. 我們去個安靜的地方，可以安靜地談談。
My son is currently studying engineering at university. 我的兒子目前正在大學攻讀工程學。
They have two daughters and one young son. 他們有兩個女兒和一個小兒子。

meaning: 提供這種迴聲定位的設備。
sentences: The boat used sonar to find fish. 船用聲納尋找魚群。
Sonar helped the team map the sea floor. 聲納幫助團隊繪製海底地形。
She sang a beautiful traditional song at the talent show. 她在才藝表演中唱了一首優美的傳統歌曲。
What is the name of that catchy song on the radio? 收音機裡那首好聽的歌叫什麼名字？
The lab tested a sonic cleaner for glasses. 實驗室測試了一台眼鏡用的超音波清洗機。
The jet crossed the sonic barrier before noon. 那架噴射機在中午前突破音障。

meaning: 小子；對男孩或年輕男子的稱呼
sentences: Listen carefully, sonny, and stay near the path. 小子，仔細聽，待在小路附近。
The old man called the boy sonny with a warning tone. 老人用警告的語氣叫那男孩小子。
I hope you get well soon and come back to work. 我希望你早日康復並回到工作崗位。
The train should arrive soon; it's already 10:00 a.m. 火車應該快到了，現在已經上午十點了。
I would sooner die than marry you! 我 寧願死 也不願嫁給你 ！ 我寧願死也不願意嫁給你！ 我寧願死也不願意嫁給你！
Sooner than have a problem later, I made sure the policy was in order. 早於 出現問題，我就確保政策是正確的。 早在出現問題之前，我就確保政策是正確的。 早在出現問題時，我就確保政策是正確的。

meaning: 由煤、石油等不完全燃燒產生的無定形碳和焦油的細黑色或深棕色顆粒。
sentences: Black soot covered the old chimney. 黑色煤灰覆蓋了舊煙囪。
The candle left soot on the glass. 蠟燭在玻璃上留下了煙灰。
The mother sang a beautiful lullaby to soothe the crying baby. 母親唱了一首優美的搖籃曲來安撫（安慰）哭泣的寶寶。
The cool drink of water helped to soothe her dry and sore throat. 涼爽的水有助於緩解（減輕）她乾燥疼痛的喉嚨。
Modern medical equipment is becoming increasingly sophisticated and accurate. 現代醫療設備正變得越來越精密且準確。
She is a sophisticated woman who has traveled all over the world. 她是一位見多識廣（老練）的女性，足跡遍佈世界各地。
The restaurant has an air of quiet sophistication. 這家餐廳帶著低調精緻感。
Her answer showed great sophistication. 她的回答展現出很高的成熟度。
As a sophomore at university, she is starting to focus on her major. 作為一名大二學生，她開始專注於自己的專業。
The college provides various resources to help sophomores with their studies. 學院提供多種資源來幫助大二（或高二）學生學習。

meaning: 執行女高音部分的人或樂器。
sentences: The soprano sang the highest part beautifully. 女高音把最高聲部唱得很美。
My sister is a soprano in the school choir. 我妹妹是學校合唱團的女高音。

meaning: 魔術師或巫師。有時特別是男性。
sentences: The story is about a young sorcerer. 這個故事講的是一位年輕巫師。
A powerful sorcerer guarded the hidden tower. 一位強大的巫師守護著隱藏的塔。

meaning: 神奇的力量；使用巫術或魔法。
sentences: The tale is full of magic and sorcery. 這個故事充滿了魔法和巫術。
In the Middle Ages, people were often accused of practicing sorcery. 在中世紀，人們常被指控施行巫術。
The article exposed a sordid gambling ring. 那篇報導揭露了一個骯髒的賭博圈。
They left the hotel after seeing the sordid room. 他們看到那間骯髒不堪的房間後就離開了。
I have a sore throat and a slight fever today. 我今天喉嚨痛且有點發燒。
His muscles were sore after the intense workout yesterday. 激烈運動後，他的肌肉今天很酸痛。

meaning: 疼痛的性質、狀態或狀況；痛苦。
sentences: I felt soreness in my legs after running. 跑步後我覺得腿很痠痛。
Stretching can reduce muscle soreness. 伸展可以減少肌肉痠痛。

meaning: 學院或大學女學生的社會組織；通常由希臘字母標識。
sentences: She joined a sorority during her first year at college. 她大一時加入了女學生聯誼會。
The sorority organized a food drive for the community. 女學生聯誼會為社區辦了食物募集活動。
Everyone expressed their deep sorrow at the news of the accident. 每個人都對事故的消息表達了深深的悲哀。
Her eyes were full of sorrow after hearing the tragic story. 聽到那個悲慘的故事後，她的眼中充滿了悲傷。
The mournful music filled the quiet room with a sorrowful atmosphere. 憂傷的音樂讓安靜的房間充滿了悲傷的氣氛。
She gave a sorrowful look at the old photographs of her childhood home. 她悲傷地看著童年舊家的老照片。
I'm very sorry for being late; the traffic was terrible. 很抱歉我遲到了，交通太糟糕了。
She said she was sorry for hurting your feelings. 她說她很抱歉傷了妳的感情。
What sort of music do you like to listen to in your free time? 你空閒時間喜歡聽哪種音樂？
The machine can automatically sort the mail by zip code. 這台機器可以根據郵遞區號自動分類郵件。
My travel papers are finally sorted. 我的旅行文件終於整理好了。
Once the seating was sorted, dinner started. 座位安排妥當後，晚餐就開始了。
Listening to classical music always brings peace to my soul. 聽古典音樂總能帶給我的靈魂平靜。
She is a kind and generous soul who is always helping others. 她是一位善良慷慨的人，總是樂於助人。
The sound of the ocean waves was very relaxing and peaceful. 海浪的聲音讓人感到非常放鬆且平靜。
That sounds like a great idea! Let's do it. 聽起來是個好主意！我們就這麼辦吧。

meaning: 聲音的現在分詞和動名詞
sentences: Little Mary was sounding very sleepy, so I tucked her in bed. 小瑪莉聽起來很睏，所以我把她抱到床上。
"Assist"'s sense ‘to be present (at a ceremony, entertainment, etc.)’, now uncommon and sounding affected, is a Gallicism. “協助”的意思是“在場（儀式、娛樂等）”，現在已經不常見了，而且聽起來很做作，是一種法國語。

meaning: 徹底地；以沒有缺陷或不足的方式。
sentences: He was soundly thrashed by the semi-professional boxer. 他被半職業拳擊手狠狠地打了一頓。
The team responded soundly to the change. 團隊對這項變化反應良好。
The soup is too hot to sip now. 這碗湯現在太燙，還不能喝。
We made chicken soup for her cold. 我們煮了雞湯給她補身體。
The lemon juice has a very sharp and sour taste that I like. 檸檬汁有一種我喜愛的強烈酸味。
The milk has gone sour because it was left out of the refrigerator. 牛奶因為沒放進冰箱而變酸了。
The internet is a vast source of information on various topics. 互聯網是關於各種主題的龐大資訊來源。
Solar and wind power are important sources of renewable energy. 太陽能與風能是可再生能源的重要來源。
Kenting is located in the south of Taiwan and has beautiful beaches. 墾丁位於台灣南部，擁有美麗的海灘。
The birds are flying south for the winter. 鳥兒正向南飛去度冬。
We took the southbound train to Barcelona. 我們搭乘南行火車前往巴塞隆納。
Something described as southbound is which is (or will be) travelling south. 所謂南行是指正在（或將要）向南行駛的東西。

meaning: 位於東南方向或東南方向；東南;東南方向的。
sentences: A southeast course. 東南方向的球場。
Something described as southeast is situated toward or in the direction of the southeast; southeastward; southeasterly. 被描述為東南的事物位於東南方向或方向；東南;東南方向。
The southeastern part of the country is the most affluent. 該國東南部地區是最富裕的地區。
Something described as southeastern is of or pertaining to the southeast. 被描述為東南部的事物屬於或屬於東南部。
A southerly wind cooled the yard by evening. 傍晚時一陣南風讓院子涼了下來。
The boat took a southerly course after lunch. 午飯後那艘船改走偏南的航線。
Kenting is located in the southern part of Taiwan and has beaches. 墾丁位於台灣南部，擁有美麗的海灘。
Many southern European countries are famous for their history. 許多南歐國家以其悠久的歷史聞名。

meaning: 位於或指向南方；向南移動或面向南。
sentences: The birds flew southward before winter. 鳥兒在冬天前向南飛。
We drove southward along the coast. 我們沿著海岸往南開。

meaning: 位於西南方向或西南方向；向西南;西南風。
sentences: A southwest course. 西南航線。
Something described as southwest is situated toward or in the direction of the southwest; southwestward; southwesterly. 被描述為西南的事物位於西南或朝向西南的方向；向西南;西南風。

meaning: 屬於或關於西南地區的。
sentences: Locals think southwestern sunsets are the most beautiful. 當地人認為西南日落是最美的。
Something described as southwestern is of or pertaining to the southwest. 被描述為西南的事物屬於或屬於西南。
I bought a small model of the Eiffel Tower as a souvenir of my trip to Paris. 我買了一個巴黎鐵塔的小模型，作為巴黎之旅的紀念品。
The shop sells a wide variety of local souvenirs and handmade crafts. 這家商店出售各式各樣的地方紀念品和手工藝品。
The country fought hard to maintain its status as a sovereign state. 該國為了維護其作為主權國家的地位而艱苦奮鬥。
The sovereign ruler of the empire addressed the nation on television. 帝國的君主（最高統治者）在電視上向全國發表了講話。
The country fought hard to maintain its national sovereignty and independence. 這個國家為了維護國家主權和獨立而艱苦奮鬥。
The dispute over the island's sovereignty has lasted for several decades. 關於該島主權的爭端已持續了幾十年。
Spring is the best time to sow seeds in your vegetable garden. 春天是在菜園播種的最佳時機。
His unusual behavior began to sow seeds of doubt among his colleagues. 他反常的行為開始在同事中引起（播下種子）懷疑。

meaning: 播種某物的行為或過程。
sentences: Spring is a good time for sowing seeds. 春天是播種的好時機。
The farmer finished sowing before the rain came. 農夫在下雨前完成播種。
I like to use soy milk in my morning coffee. 我喜歡在晨間咖啡中加入豆漿（大豆奶）。
She added a splash of soy sauce to the stir-fry. 她在熱炒裡加了一點醬油。
Soybeans are a key ingredient in many traditional Asian foods. 大豆是許多傳統亞洲食物的主要食材。
Taiwan is a major producer of high-quality organic soybeans. 台灣是高品質有機大豆的主要產地。
She went to a luxury spa for a relaxing weekend. 她去了一家豪華水療中心過了一個放鬆的週末。
The hotel features an indoor swimming pool and a spa. 飯店設有一個室內游泳池和一個水療中心。
Is there enough space in the car for all of our suitcases? 車裡有足夠空間放我們所有的行李箱嗎？
She is very interested in outer space and astronomy. 她對外太空和天文學非常感興趣。
The museum sign says spacecraft/spaceship models are upstairs. 博物館標示寫著太空船模型在樓上。
My nephew drew a bright spacecraft/spaceship on the wall chart. 我外甥在掛圖上畫了一艘亮色太空船。

meaning: 物體或人被空間分隔開的方式。
sentences: Check the spacing between each line. 檢查每一行之間的間距。
Good spacing makes the poster easier to read. 適當留白讓海報更容易閱讀。
They moved to a spacious apartment in the suburbs with plenty of light. 他們搬到郊區一個採光充足且寬敞的公寓。
The hotel features spacious rooms and a beautiful rooftop garden. 該飯店的特色是寬敞的房間和美麗的頂層花園。

meaning: 鏟子、鐵鍬、（撲克牌中的）黑桃
sentences: He used a sharp spade to dig a hole for the new apple tree in the garden. 他用一把鋒利的鏟子在花園裡為那棵新蘋果樹挖了一個洞。
In the card game, the ace of spades is often considered the most powerful card. 在紙牌遊戲中，黑桃 A 通常被認為是最強大的牌。
My favorite Italian dish is classic spaghetti carbonara with cream. 我最喜歡的義大利菜是經典的奶油培根義大利麵。
She made a batch of delicious spaghetti for the family dinner. 她為家庭晚餐做了一大份美味的義大利麵。
The new bridge has a total span of about five hundred meters. 新橋的總跨度（長度）約為五百公尺。
The study focused on changes in the region over a ten-year span. 該研究聚焦於該地區在十年間（跨度）發生的變化。

meaning: 快速移動或轉動，如機器的齒輪或船帆。
sentences: The ship was really spanking along. 船確實一路顛簸。
To spank means to move or turn rapidly, as the gears of a machine or the sails of a ship. 打屁股意味著快速移動或轉動，就像機器的齒輪或船的帆一樣。
They moved into a spanking new apartment. 他們搬進一間全新的公寓。
Her bike still looks spanking after a year. 她的腳踏車過了一年看起來還是很新。
The mechanic used a spanner to tighten the bolts. 技工利用扳手擰緊螺栓。
Make sure you have a reliable set of spanners in your toolkit. 確保你的工具箱裡有一套可靠的扳手。
The miner found a piece of clear spar. 礦工找到一塊透明晶石。
The sail was tied to a long wooden spar. 船帆綁在一根長木桿上。
Do you have a spare pen that I could borrow for the meeting? 你有備用的筆可以借我開會用嗎？
In my spare time, I enjoy reading books and listening to classical music. 在空閒（多餘的）時間，我喜歡看書和聽古典音樂。

meaning: 以節約的方式；節儉、節制、吝嗇、矜持、克制等；稀疏地。
sentences: If someone acts sparingly, they do so in a way that is in a sparing manner; with frugality, moderation, scantiness, reserve, forbearance, or the like; sparsely. 如果某人行事謹慎，那麼他們會以謹慎的方式行事；節儉、節制、吝嗇、矜持、克制等；稀疏地。
The speaker responded sparingly during the discussion. 發言者在討論期間很少做出回應。
A tiny spark from the fireplace landed on the carpet and caused a small fire. 壁爐裡的一點微小火花掉在地毯上，引發了一場小火。
The new policy sparked a lot of debate among the local community. 這項新政策在當地社區引發（激發）了大量的辯論。
The diamond began to sparkle under the bright lights of the jewelry store. 鑽石在珠寶店明亮的燈光下開始閃耀。
She has a real sparkle in her eyes when she talks about her passion. 當她談論自己的熱情時，眼中閃爍著真正的活力（光芒）。
A small brown sparrow sat on the windowsill and chirped loudly. 一隻褐色的小麻雀停在窗台上，響亮地叫著。
We saw several sparrows feeding on the crumbs in the garden yesterday. 我們昨天看到幾隻麻雀在花園裡啄食麵包屑。
Trees are sparse on that dry hill. 那座乾燥的小山上樹木很稀疏。
The file came with sparse notes and no map. 那份檔案只有零星筆記，沒有地圖。
The cabins were sparsely scattered along the lake. 那些小屋零星地分散在湖邊。
The room was sparsely furnished with just a bed and lamp. 那個房間家具很少，只有一張床和一盞燈。

meaning: 一塊肌肉、一組肌肉或一個中空器官的突然、不自主的收縮。
sentences: A sudden spasm made his back hurt. 突然的痙攣讓他的背很痛。
The medicine helped stop the muscle spasm. 藥物幫助停止肌肉痙攣。
A silly spat ruined their picnic for an hour. 一場小口角讓他們的野餐有一小時都不愉快。
The twins have a spat almost every morning. 那對雙胞胎幾乎每天早上都會拌嘴。
The puzzle tests spatial thinking. 這個拼圖測試空間思考能力。
Architects need strong spatial awareness. 建築師需要很強的空間感。
She used a spatula to flip the pancakes in the pan. 她用抹刀在鍋裡翻轉煎餅。
The pharmacist used a small spatula to measure the medicine. 藥劑師利用小藥鏟測量藥物。
A frog spawns thousands of tadpoles every year. 青蛙每年產下數千隻蝌蚪。
To spawn means to produce or deposit (eggs) in water. 產卵是指在水中產生或沉積（卵）。
We need to spay our pet cat to prevent unwanted litters. 我們需要為寵物貓做結紮手術，以防止不必要的幼崽出生。
The clinic provides services to spay and neuter stray animals. 診所提供為流浪動物結紮的服務。
Could you please speak a bit louder? I can't hear you. 可以請你大聲一點嗎？我聽不見。
How many languages can you speak fluently? 你能流利地說幾種語言？
The guest speaker gave an inspiring speech to the graduates. 客座講師對畢業生們發表了一場激勵人心的演講。
Could you please turn up the volume on the computer speakers? 你能調大電腦揚聲器的音量嗎？

meaning: 一個人用特定語言進行語音溝通的能力。
sentences: Speaking clearly helps people understand you. 說話清楚能幫助別人理解你。
She is nervous about speaking in public. 她對公開演講感到緊張。
The fisherman carried a long spear. 漁夫拿著一支長矛。
She used a fork to spear a piece of fruit. 她用叉子叉起一塊水果。
She will spearhead the library fundraiser this fall. 她今年秋天會主導圖書館募款活動。
The coach asked Mia to spearhead the warm-up drills. 教練請 Mia 帶頭做暖身訓練。
The phone met every spec on our list. 那支手機符合我們清單上的每項規格。
Please read the spec before ordering the part. 下單零件前請先看規格。
We are planning a special surprise party for her birthday. 我們正計劃為她的生日辦一個特別的驚喜派對。
Is there anything special you'd like to do this weekend? 週末你有什麼想做的特別的事嗎？
The doctor decided to refer the patient to a specialist for further tests. 醫生決定將病人轉介給專科醫生進行進一步檢查。
He is a leading specialist in the field of modern computer architecture. 他是現代計算機架構領域的頂尖專家。
Seafood is the restaurant's speciality. 海鮮是這家餐廳的特色菜。
Her speciality is caring for older patients. 她的專長是照顧年長病人。

meaning: 一個證明、公理、問題或定義，其情況完全被另一個更廣泛的概念覆蓋。
sentences: His specialization is heart surgery. 他的專業領域是心臟手術。
Job specialization can make a factory more efficient. 工作專門化可以讓工廠更有效率。
The small law firm specializes in intellectual property and business law. 這家小型律師事務所專門從事（專攻）智慧財產權和商業法。
She decided to specialize in pediatric medicine during her final year. 她決定在大四期間專攻兒科醫學。

meaning: 對於特殊目的、人或場合。
sentences: We had this cake made specially for your birthday. 我們特意為你的生日製作了這個蛋糕。
The train is waiting specially for a high-ranking diplomat. 火車正在專門等待一位高級外交官。
The restaurant's specialty is a delicious seafood pasta with a spicy sauce. 這家餐廳的招牌菜（特產）是配上辛辣醬汁的美味海鮮義大利麵。
International human rights law is her primary specialty and area of research. 國際人權法是她的主要專業（專長）和研究領域。
This species of bird lives near rivers. 這種鳥生活在河邊。
Scientists discovered a new species of frog. 科學家發現了一種新的青蛙。
Could you please provide more specific details about the event? 能請您提供關於該事件更具體的細節嗎？
This medicine is designed to treat a very specific medical condition. 這款藥是專門為治療一種非常特定的疾病而設計的。
I asked specifically for less sugar in my tea. 我特別交代我的茶要少糖。
This coupon applies specifically to school supplies. 這張折價券只特別適用於文具用品。

meaning: 材料、產品或服務要滿足的一組明確的要求。
sentences: The contractor followed the architect’s specifications. 承包商遵循建築師的規格。
Each computer is built to the customer’s exact specification. 每台計算機都是按照客戶的具體規格製造的。
The instructions need more specificity. 這些說明需要更具體。
The test has high specificity for that disease. 這項檢測對那種疾病有很高的特異性。
Please specify your shirt size on the form. 請在表格上註明你的襯衫尺寸。
The recipe does not specify how ripe the bananas should be. 這份食譜沒有明確說明香蕉要多熟。
The scientist studied the blood specimen under a microscope in the lab. 科學家在顯微鏡下研究了實驗室的血液樣本。
The museum has a large collection of botanical specimens from the region. 該博物館收藏了大量來自該地區的植物標本。
The nurse explained the specimen collection steps. 護士說明了採集檢體的步驟。
Specimen collection must be done with clean tools. 樣本採集必須使用乾淨工具。

meaning: 非常少量；一個粒子；一點點。
sentences: He has not a speck of money. 他一分錢都沒有。
not a speck of truth in her story. 她的故事裡沒有一絲真實。
A tiny brown speckle marked the egg. 蛋殼上有一個小小的棕色斑點。
Rain began to speckle the window. 雨開始在窗上點出小斑點。
We found a speckled egg under the porch. 我們在門廊下發現一顆有斑點的蛋。
The artist chose speckled paper for the cards. 那位藝術家選了有斑點紋理的紙來做卡片。
The fireworks display was a magnificent spectacle that lit up the sky. 煙火表演是一場照亮天空的壯麗奇觀（場面）。
He needed a new pair of spectacles to see the blackboard clearly. 他需要一副新眼鏡才能看清黑板。
He cleaned his spectacles with a soft cloth. 他用軟布擦眼鏡。
She cannot read the menu without her spectacles. 沒有眼鏡，她看不清菜單。
The fireworks display last night was truly spectacular and lit up the sky. 昨晚的煙火表演真是壯觀，照亮了整個天空。
The mountain offers a spectacular view of the surrounding countryside. 這座山可以俯瞰周圍鄉間的壯麗景色。
Thousands of spectators gathered at the stadium to watch the final match. 數千名觀眾聚集在體育場觀看決賽。
The small town was filled with spectators for the annual colorful parade. 那座小鎮擠滿了觀看年度精彩遊行的觀眾。
The old house looked like a home for a specter. 那棟老房子看起來像幽靈會住的地方。
The specter of job loss worried the workers. 失業的陰影讓工人們擔心。

meaning: 屬於或關於幽靈的；幽靈般的。
sentences: The spectral chain-rattling and moans gave me the chills. 幽靈般的鏈條嘎嘎聲和呻吟聲讓我渾身發冷。
Something described as spectral is of, or pertaining to, spectres; ghostly. 被描述為幽靈的東西是屬於或屬於幽靈的；幽靈般的。
The lab uses spectroscopy to study the sample. 實驗室使用光譜學研究樣本。
Spectroscopy can show what chemicals are present. 光譜分析可以顯示有哪些化學物質存在。
A rainbow displays the full spectrum of colors from red to violet. 彩虹展現了從紅到紫的完整光譜。
The course covers a wide spectrum of topics, from history to technology. 這門課程涵蓋了從歷史到科技的廣泛領域（範圍）。
It is difficult to speculate on the future of the project without more data. 沒有更多數據，很難推測專案的未來。
He decided to speculate in the stock market and lost all his savings. 他決定在股市投機，結果賠光了所有積蓄。

meaning: 觀看某物的行為；檢視、觀察。
sentences: There was speculation about who would become manager. 大家猜測誰會成為經理。
Do not make decisions based only on speculation. 不要只根據猜測做決定。

meaning: 以投機為特徵；基於猜測、毫無根據的意見或推斷。
sentences: The plan is still speculative and may change. 這項計畫仍屬推測性，可能會改變。
He made a speculative investment in a new company. 他對一家新公司做了投機性投資。
The car sped past us before dawn. 那輛車在天亮前從我們身邊飛馳而過。
Time sped up once the guests arrived. 客人一到，時間好像就過得特別快。
The president addressed the nation in a powerful television speech. 總統在電視上向全國發表了強而有力的演講。
She was chosen to give the opening speech at the conference. 她被選中在會議上發表開幕致詞。
Speech recognition helps the phone type what I say. 語音辨識幫手機打出我說的話。
The app uses speech recognition for hands-free notes. 這個程式用語音辨識做免手持筆記。
The child started speech therapy last month. 那個孩子上個月開始接受語言治療。
Speech therapy helped her speak more clearly. 語言治療幫助她說話更清楚。

meaning: 四 (尤指氣得或驚訝得) 说不出话来的
sentences: The surprise gift left her speechless. 那份驚喜禮物讓她說不出話。
He was speechless with anger. 他氣到說不出話。
The car was traveling at a high speed when the accident occurred. 事故發生時，車子正以高速行駛。
Modern computers are much faster in speed than older models. 現代電腦的速度比舊型號快得多。
The speed limit here is fifty kilometers per hour. 這裡的速限是每小時五十公里。
Drivers must follow the speed limit near schools. 駕駛在學校附近必須遵守速限。
A speedboat crossed the lake in minutes. 一艘快艇幾分鐘內就穿過湖面。
We rented a speedboat for the afternoon. 我們下午租了一艘快艇。
Speeding near a school is dangerous. 在學校附近超速很危險。
He got a ticket for speeding on the highway. 他因在高速公路超速收到罰單。
The speedometer showed eighty kilometers per hour. 車速表顯示每小時八十公里。
My old scooter has a broken speedometer. 我的舊機車車速表壞了。

meaning: 高速交通的道路；高速公路。
sentences: Fans filled the speedway before the race. 比賽前，賽車場坐滿了觀眾。
The city built a new speedway outside town. 城市在郊外建了一座新賽道。
We hope for a speedy recovery after the surgery. 我們希望手術後能迅速康復。
The store offers speedy delivery in the city. 這家店在市區提供快速送貨。
We passed through Speen on the way to Newbury. 我們去紐伯里的路上經過斯平。
A small church stands near Speen. 斯平附近有一座小教堂。
How do you spell your last name? Could you repeat it? 你的姓氏怎麼拼？可以重複一次嗎？
I always use a spell checker when I'm writing emails. 我寫郵件時總是會使用拼字檢查功能。
I made a few spelling errors in my English essay yesterday. 我在昨天的英文作文中犯了幾個拼寫錯誤。
Could you please check the spelling of your last name for me? 能請您幫我檢查一下您姓氏的拼寫嗎？
The bakery uses spelt in its dark bread. 那家麵包店在黑麥麵包裡用了斯佩耳特小麥。
I bought a bag of spelt from the organic shop. 我在有機商店買了一袋斯佩耳特小麥。
She wore a wool spencer over her dress. 她在洋裝外面穿了一件羊毛短外套。
The costume shop rented me a black spencer. 那家戲服店租給我一件黑色短外套。
I like to spend my free time reading books in the park. 我喜歡在公園讀書度過我的空閒時間。
How much money did you spend on your new laptop? 你買新筆電花了多少錢？

meaning: 已支出或計劃支出的金額。
sentences: We need to reduce spending this month. 我們這個月需要減少支出。
Holiday spending rose sharply this year. 今年假期消費大幅增加。
I spent all morning cleaning the kitchen. 我花了一整個早上打掃廚房。
After the long hike, we felt completely spent. 長途健行後，我們覺得精疲力盡。
The biology class studied how sperm reaches an egg. 生物課研究精子如何到達卵子。
Doctors checked the sperm sample in the lab. 醫師在實驗室檢查精子樣本。
The glossary said spet meant spittle in old writing. 詞彙表說這個古字在舊文裡是指唾液。
A note in the margin explained spet for modern readers. 頁邊註解為現代讀者說明了這個古字。
The volcano began to spew ash into the sky. 火山開始向天空噴出火山灰。
The broken pipe can spew water across the floor. 破裂的水管可能把水噴得到處都是。
The Earth is not a perfect sphere but is slightly flattened at the poles. 地球不是完美的球體，而是兩極稍微扁平。
She is a leading expert in her sphere of research and has published many books. 她是其研究領域的頂尖專家。
The toy has a soft spherical shape. 那個玩具有柔軟的球形外觀。
We watched a spherical bubble float past the lamp. 我們看著一顆球形泡泡飄過燈旁。

meaning: 獅身人面像；神祕難解的人
sentences: The guide pointed at the sphinx from the bus window. 導遊從巴士窗邊指向那座獅身人面像。
His quiet face made him seem like a sphinx. 他沉默的表情讓他看起來像個難以捉摸的人。
The chef used various traditional spices to enhance the flavor. 廚師使用各種傳統香料來增進風味。
Variety is the spice of life, so try new things whenever you can. 多樣性是生活的調味品，所以只要可以就嘗試新事物。
The soup was spiced with ginger. 湯用薑調味。
She served spiced tea after dinner. 晚餐後她端上香料茶。
The restaurant's specialty is a delicious seafood pasta with a spicy sauce. 這家餐廳的招牌菜是配上辛辣醬汁的美味海鮮義大利麵。
I prefer mild food, as I find spicy dishes to be too intense for me. 我更喜歡清淡的食物，因為我覺得辛辣料理對我來說太刺激了。
A large black spider was spinning a web in the corner of the room. 一隻黑色大蜘蛛正在房間角落結網。
Many people are naturally afraid of spiders and other insects. 許多人天生害怕蜘蛛和其他昆蟲。
A rusty spike stuck out of the board. 木板上突出一根生鏽長釘。
The city saw a spike in electricity use during the heat wave. 熱浪期間，城市用電量突然上升。
She wore black spike heels to the party. 她穿黑色細高跟鞋去派對。
Spike heels are hard to wear on stone paths. 在石子路上很難穿細高跟鞋。
The fence had a spiked top for security. 那道圍欄頂端有尖刺以增加安全性。
Someone left a spiked punch on the picnic table. 有人把加了酒的賓治放在野餐桌上。
Do not spill the soup on the blanket. 不要把湯灑到毯子上。
I watched the beans spill from the torn bag. 我看著豆子從破袋子裡灑出來。
The spilt juice reached the edge of the table. 灑出的果汁流到了桌邊。
We wiped up the spilt rice before the dog came in. 狗進來前，我們把灑出的米擦乾淨了。
The figure skater managed to spin rapidly on the frozen ice. 花式滑冰選手設法在冰面上快速旋轉。
The sudden news made my head spin with confusion and shock. 突如其來的新聞讓我頭暈目眩，感到困惑與震驚。
Spinach is a healthy green leafy vegetable rich in iron and fiber. 菠菜是一種富含鐵與纖維的健康綠色葉菜。
She added some fresh spinach leaves to her morning fruit smoothie. 她在早晨的果昔中加入了一些新鮮的菠菜葉。
The doctor ordered a spinal scan. 醫師安排了脊椎掃描。
Spinal injuries need careful treatment. 脊椎傷害需要謹慎治療。
The doctor explained the problem with his spinal marrow. 醫師說明了他脊髓的問題。
Damage to the spinal marrow can affect movement. 脊髓受損可能影響行動。

meaning: 一根可以轉動的桿，或是可以轉動某物的桿。
sentences: The spindle on the machine was spinning fast. 機器上的軸轉得很快。
She placed the thread on a wooden spindle. 她把線放在木製紡錘上。
Poor posture while sitting at a computer can lead to problems with your spine. 坐在電腦前姿勢不正確會導致脊椎問題。
The book's title and the author's name are printed clearly on the spine. 書名和作者姓名清晰地印在書脊上。

meaning: 在遊戲中旋轉以選擇數字或符號的裝置。
sentences: The board game uses a spinner instead of dice. 這款桌遊用轉盤代替骰子。
The child flicked the spinner with one finger. 孩子用一根手指撥動轉盤。

meaning: 上四未婚女人， 老处女
sentences: The old novel describes her as a lonely spinster. 那本老小說把她描寫成孤單的未婚女子。
She disliked the word spinster because it sounded unfair. 她不喜歡未婚老女人這個說法，因為聽起來不公平。
The staircase led to the top of the tower in a narrow spiral. 樓梯呈狹窄的螺旋形通向塔頂。
Stock prices entered a downward spiral following the financial crisis. 股市在金融危機後陷入了急劇下降的螺旋。

meaning: 建在屋頂或塔樓上的錐形結構，特別是作為教堂或大教堂屋頂的中心建築特徵之一。
sentences: The church spire can be seen from far away. 遠處就能看見教堂尖塔。
Birds circled above the tall spire. 鳥兒在高高的尖塔上方盤旋。
The team showed great team spirit and worked together effectively. 團隊展現了極佳的團隊精神，並有效地合作。
He is a free spirit who loves to travel and explore new cultures. 他是一個熱愛旅行、探索新文化的自由靈魂。
Meditation is part of her spiritual life. 冥想是她精神生活的一部分。
He went on a spiritual retreat in the mountains. 他到山上參加心靈靜修。

meaning: 專注於看不見的和無形的事物，而不是物質或世俗的事物。
sentences: Yoga helped her explore her spirituality. 瑜伽幫助她探索靈性生活。
His spirituality became important after the illness. 生病後，靈性對他變得很重要。

meaning: 共鳴相同（或相似）；最好透過以下含義來理解。
sentences: Oxford is spiritually London. 牛津在精神上就是倫敦。
If someone acts spiritually, they do so in a way that is identical (or similar) in vibes to; best understood through the connotations of. 如果某人在精神上採取行動，他們的行為方式與共鳴相同（或相似）；最好透過其內涵來理解。
The doctor asked the patient to spit into a small sterile tube. 醫生要求病人吐痰進一個無菌小管子。
It's considered very rude to spit on the ground in public places. 在公共場合往地上吐痰被認為是非常粗魯的。
They managed to finish the project on time in spite of the delay. 儘管延誤了，他們還是設法準時完成了專案。
I'm sure that he didn't do it out of spite; it was just a mistake. 我確定他不是出於惡意才這麼做的；那只是一個錯誤。
Spittle landed on the microphone as he shouted. 他大喊時，口水噴到麥克風上。
The nurse wiped spittle from the baby's chin. 護士擦掉嬰兒下巴上的口水。
The old bar kept a brass spittoon near the door. 那間老酒吧在門邊放了一個黃銅痰盂。
The museum displayed a spittoon from the railway station. 博物館展示了一個來自火車站的痰盂。
The children love to splash in shallow water. 孩子們很愛在淺水裡玩水潑濺。
A bus sped by and made dirty water splash onto my coat. 一輛公車飛馳而過，把髒水濺到我的外套上。
The children were splashing water in the pool. 孩子們在泳池裡潑水。
I heard splashing from the bathroom. 我聽見浴室傳來潑水聲。

meaning: 液體或軟固體撞擊固體表面時發出的尖銳、無調性的聲音。
sentences: The tomato hit the floor with a splat. 番茄啪一聲掉到地上。
Paint landed on the paper with a loud splat. 顏料啪地一聲落在紙上。
The scan showed that his spleen was enlarged. 掃描顯示他的脾臟腫大。
Doctors removed the damaged spleen after the accident. 事故後，醫師切除了受損的脾臟。
The palace gardens looked absolutely splendid in the bright morning sunlight. 在明亮的晨光下，皇宮花園看起來真是壯麗極了。
We had a splendid time at the party last night and met many interesting people. 我們昨晚在派對上過得非常愉快（極好的時光），並結識了許多有趣的人。
The visitors were amazed by the splendor of the ancient imperial palace. 遊客們被古代皇宮的壯麗（輝煌）所震驚。
The movie captures the natural splendor of the mountain scenery. 這部電影捕捉到了山景的自然美景（壯麗）。
The scan showed mild splenomegaly after the fever. 掃描顯示發燒後有輕微脾腫大。
Her later scan confirmed splenomegaly. 她後來的掃描確認是脾臟腫大。
Please splice the two ropes before we pull the boat in. 請先把兩條繩子接起來，再把船拉進來。
We should splice the video here so the music stays smooth. 我們應該在這裡把影片接起來，這樣音樂才會順。

meaning: 分裂成長而鋒利的碎片。
sentences: The tall tree splintered during the storm. 那棵高大的樹在暴風雨中折斷了。
To splinter means to come apart into long sharp fragments. 分裂意味著分裂成長而尖銳的碎片。
The group decided to split the bill evenly among all the members. 團體決定將帳單在所有成員之間平均分配。
The heavy board split in two when he tried to lift it. 當他試圖抬起那塊沉重的木板時，它裂成了兩半。
She decided to splurge on a nice dinner. 她決定大方花錢吃一頓好晚餐。
We rarely splurge, but the concert tickets were worth it. 我們很少揮霍，但那場演唱會門票很值得。
Don't let one small mistake spoil your entire day; stay positive. 不要讓一個小錯誤破壞了妳一整天的心情；保持積極。
The heavy rain managed to spoil our plans for an outdoor picnic. 大雨竟然破壞了我們戶外野餐的計畫。
Keep the milk cold to prevent spoilage. 牛奶要冷藏以防腐敗。
Food spoilage increases during hot weather. 天氣炎熱時，食物腐敗會增加。
The milk smelled spoiled this morning. 今天早上的牛奶聞起來已經壞了。
His spoiled nephew cried over the wrong toy. 他那個被寵壞的姪子因為玩具拿錯就哭了。
That review had a spoiler in the first paragraph. 那篇影評第一段就有劇透。
A spoiler alert helps me enjoy the movie later. 劇透警告能讓我之後安心看電影。

meaning: 食品，已經變質到無法再使用或食用的程度。
sentences: The food went spoilt in the heat and had to be thrown away. 食物在高溫下變質，不得不丟掉。
Something described as spoilt is of food, that has deteriorated to the point of no longer being usable or edible. 被描述為變質的東西是食物，已經變質到無法再使用或食用的程度。

meaning: 說話；speak 的過去式；輪輻
sentences: She spoke clearly during the interview. 她在面試時說得很清楚。
One spoke on the bicycle wheel was broken. 腳踏車輪子上有一根輪輻斷了。
Spoken English can be hard to understand at first. 一開始，英語口語可能很難聽懂。
The promise was spoken clearly in front of everyone. 那個承諾當著大家面前說得很清楚。
The spokesperson/spokesman/spokeswoman answered questions outside the court. 那位發言人在法院外回答問題。
A calm spokesperson/spokesman/spokeswoman can steady a worried crowd. 冷靜的發言人能安撫不安的人群。
She used a soft sponge to wash the windows and remove the dust. 她用柔軟的海綿擦窗戶並清除灰塵。
The cake has a light and airy texture, similar to a soft sponge. 這款蛋糕質地輕盈蓬鬆，像海綿一樣。
The international technology firm is the primary sponsor of the event. 這家國際科技公司是該活動的主要贊助商。
The organization is looking for new sponsors to support its programs. 該組織正在尋找新的贊助者來支持其計畫。
The team received a generous sponsorship from a local business group. 該團隊收到了當地一家企業集團的慷慨贊助。
He is seeking corporate sponsorship to fund his expedition to the Arctic. 他正在尋求企業資助來為他的北極探險提供資金。
The audience erupted into spontaneous applause at the end of the show. 演出結束時，觀眾爆發出陣陣自發的掌聲。
Our decision to travel to the mountains was completely spontaneous. 我們去山區旅行的決定完全是心血來潮（自發的）。
The kids laughed spontaneously when the dog stole the towel. 狗叼走毛巾時，孩子們忍不住笑了。
She spontaneously offered her seat to the old man. 她主動把座位讓給老人。

meaning: 涉及透過冒充身分進行欺騙的網路攻擊；用於此類攻擊的數位資產。
sentences: The video is a spoof of famous action movies. 這支影片是在惡搞知名動作片。
Someone used spoof messages to trick customers. 有人用偽造訊息欺騙顧客。
A sudden noise can spook the horses. 突然的聲響可能嚇到馬。
The dark hallway began to spook the children. 昏暗的走廊開始讓孩子們害怕。

meaning: 難以預料的興奮；易受驚嚇的（尤指馬）。
sentences: The empty school felt spooky at night. 夜晚的空學校感覺很陰森。
She told a spooky story by the campfire. 她在營火旁講了一個恐怖故事。
She put a new spool of thread in the sewing machine. 她在縫紉機裡放入新的線軸。
The cable wrapped neatly around the spool. 電線整齊地繞在線軸上。
I need a spool of thread to fix this button. 我需要一卷線來修這顆扣子。
Grandma keeps every spool of thread in a tin box. 奶奶把每卷線都收在鐵盒裡。
Could you please bring me a spoon for my vegetable soup? 你能幫我拿把湯匙來喝蔬菜湯嗎？
She used a silver spoon to measure the amount of sugar. 她用一把銀匙來測量糖的量。

meaning: （疾病）在孤立的情況下發生；不是流行病。
sentences: We had sporadic rain throughout the afternoon. 整個下午斷斷續續下雨。
The internet connection was sporadic during the storm. 暴風雨期間網路連線時有時無。
What is your favorite sport? Mine is basketball and tennis. 你最喜歡什麼運動？我的是籃球與網球。
Playing sports is a great way to stay healthy and reduce stress. 做運動是保持健康與減輕壓力的好方法。
He watches sports with his friends every weekend. 他每週末和朋友一起看運動比賽。
The school added more sports after class. 學校增加了更多課後體育活動。
He saved for years to buy a red sports car. 他存了多年錢買一輛紅色跑車。
The sports car turned heads on the street. 那輛跑車在街上吸引了大家目光。
The sportsman/sportswoman checked the track before the race. 那位運動員在比賽前檢查跑道。
A good sportsman/sportswoman thanks the referee after the game. 有風度的運動員會在賽後向裁判致謝。
The two players showed great sportsmanship after the difficult match. 兩位球員在艱苦的比賽後展現了極佳的運動家精神。
The award was given to the team that demonstrated the best sportsmanship. 該獎項頒給了展現出最佳體育精神的團隊。
She picked a sporty jacket for the bike ride. 她為騎車挑了一件有運動感的外套。
Those sporty shoes matched his striped shorts. 那雙運動風的鞋子很配他的條紋短褲。
This is a perfect spot for a picnic, with a great view of the lake. 這裡是野餐的絕佳地點，可以看到優美的湖景。
She noticed a small red spot on her arm and was worried. 她注意到手臂上有個小紅點，感到很擔心。
The young actress was thrust into the spotlight following her success. 這位年輕女演員在成功後成為了公眾關注的焦點（聚光燈下）。
The news story helped to put the spotlight on environmental issues. 這篇新聞報導有助於將焦點放在環保問題上。
She wore a spotted dress to the picnic. 她穿著有斑點的洋裝去野餐。
We spotted a deer near the trail. 我們在小徑附近看見一頭鹿。
The Wi-Fi was spotty on the mountain bus. 山路巴士上的無線網路斷斷續續。
The bowl held spotty brown eggs. 碗裡放著有斑點的褐色雞蛋。
The form asks for spousal income. 表格要求填寫配偶收入。
Spousal support can be part of a divorce agreement. 配偶扶養費可以是離婚協議的一部分。
The invitation is for you and your spouse to attend the wedding party. 邀請函是請您和您的配偶參加婚禮派對。
It is important to discuss your future plans and goals with your spouse. 與配偶討論未來的計畫和目標非常重要。
Hot water began to spout from the broken pipe. 熱水開始從破掉的水管噴出。
Oil can spout from that pan if it gets too hot. 那個平底鍋太熱時，油可能會噴出來。

meaning: 噴出某事的過程或結果；噴出的東西。
sentences: Spoutings of lava shot from the crest of the volcano. 熔岩從火山頂噴出。
The spoutings of a large whale can be seen from a great distance. 從很遠的地方就能看到大鯨魚噴出的水柱。

meaning: 四肢攤開躺著；無規劃擴展
sentences: The dog likes to sprawl across the cool floor. 那隻狗喜歡四肢攤開躺在涼地板上。
New houses began to sprawl beyond the town. 新房子開始無規劃地向鎮外擴展。
She used a moisturizing spray to keep her skin hydrated all day. 她使用保濕噴霧來保持皮膚整天水潤。
The farmer sprayed the crops with organic pesticides yesterday. 農夫昨天在農作物上噴灑了有機農藥。
The spray head on the hose is broken. 水管上的噴頭壞了。
Turn the spray head to make a fine mist. 轉動噴頭可以噴出細霧。
Jam spread quickly across the warm toast. 果醬很快抹滿了熱吐司。
Rumors spread fast in our small office. 流言在我們的小辦公室傳得很快。
They went on a coffee spree after payday. 他們發薪日後瘋狂買了一輪咖啡。
Her online spree ended with three new lamps. 她一陣網購後買了三盞新燈。
Spring is the season when flowers start to bloom and trees turn green. 春天是鮮花盛開、樹木變綠的季節。
The warm spring weather is perfect for a picnic. 溫暖的春天氣候非常適合野餐。

meaning: 充當開始或加速行動或成長的催化劑的東西。
sentences: The internship became a springboard for her career. 那份實習成了她職涯的跳板。
He jumped from the springboard into the pool. 他從跳板跳進泳池。
The mason reset the springer before lifting the arch stones. 泥瓦匠在吊起拱石前重新放好拱腳石。
A cracked springer can weaken the whole arch. 裂開的拱腳石會削弱整座拱。

meaning: 春天，冬天和夏天之間的季節。
sentences: The garden is full of flowers in springtime. 春天時花園開滿花。
We visit my grandparents every springtime. 每年春天我們都去看祖父母。
She like to sprinkle some cinnamon on top of her hot chocolate. 她喜歡在熱巧克力上面灑一點肉桂粉。
There was a light sprinkle of rain this morning, but it didn't last long. 今天早上下一點點小雨（灑了一點水），但沒持續多久。
The sprinkler soaked my socks before sunrise. 灑水器在日出前把我的襪子噴濕了。
One sprinkler near the roses stopped turning. 玫瑰旁的一個噴頭不再轉動。

meaning: 以最高速度進行短距離比賽。
sentences: She won the hundred-meter sprint. 她贏得一百公尺短跑。
We had to sprint to catch the bus. 我們得衝刺去趕公車。
The artist redrew the hero sprite for the phone game. 美術重畫了手機遊戲裡主角的角色貼圖。
That tiny sprite jumps higher after the update. 那個小小的角色貼圖更新後跳得更高。
The bicycle chain slipped off the sprocket. 腳踏車鏈條從鏈輪上滑落。
The mechanic replaced the worn sprocket. 技師更換了磨損的鏈輪。
The beans began to sprout after two days. 豆子兩天後開始發芽。
She added fresh sprouts to the sandwich. 她在三明治裡加了新鮮嫩芽。
They planted a spruce beside the cabin. 他們在小屋旁種了一棵雲杉。
Spruce wood is often used for guitars. 雲杉木常用來製作吉他。
The old mattress felt sprung and uneven. 那張舊床墊彈簧凸起又不平。
These sprung doors close too fast for small kids. 這些裝有彈簧的門對小孩來說關得太快。
The tailor replaced the torn sps'lebj on the parade coat. 裁縫把禮服外套上破掉的肩章換掉了。
The captain's sps'lebj had silver braid. 上尉的肩章有銀色織帶。

meaning: 紡成的；spin 的過去分詞
sentences: The scarf was made from finely spun wool. 這條圍巾是用細紡羊毛做成的。
He felt dizzy after being spun around. 他被轉了一圈後覺得頭暈。
The success of the first project helped to spur the team to work harder. 第一個專案的成功激勵（刺激）了團隊更加努力工作。
He used his spurs to encourage the horse to run faster during the race. 他用馬刺驅使馬在比賽中跑得更快。
The email looked spurious, so I did not click it. 那封電子郵件看起來是假的，所以我沒點。
Those spurious excuses will not fix the missed deadline. 那些站不住腳的藉口無法補救錯過的期限。

meaning: 短時間內做出巨大的努力。
sentences: The bullion market spurted on Thursday. 週四金銀市場大幅上漲。
The runners spurted to the last lap as if they had extracted new energy from the applauds of the audience. 跑到最後一圈的選手們彷彿從觀眾的掌聲中汲取了新的能量。
The movie tells a thrilling story about an international secret spy. 這部電影講述了一個關於國際秘密間諜的驚悚故事。
He was accused of working as a spy for a foreign government. 他被指控為外國政府擔任間諜。
The rescue squad was sent to the mountains to search for the missing hikers. 救援小隊被派往山區搜尋失蹤的登山者。
The police drug squad conducted a series of raids in the city center. 警方緝毒小組在市中心進行了一系列突擊搜查。
The squadron returned to base before dark. 那個中隊在天黑前返回基地。
A rescue squadron searched the coast all night. 一支救援中隊整晚搜尋海岸。
Do not squander your refund on random gadgets. 別把退稅金浪費在亂買的小玩意上。
He may squander a free afternoon by scrolling in bed. 他可能躺在床上滑手機，白白耗掉一個空閒下午。
The town square was crowded with people during the festival. 鎮上的廣場在節日期間擠滿了人。
Please draw a square on the piece of paper. 請在紙上畫一個正方形。
The square root of nine is three. 九的平方根是三。
Use a calculator to find the square root. 用計算機找平方根。
The napkins were folded into squared stacks. 餐巾被折成一疊疊方整的方塊。
The patio looked neat with squared tiles. 露台鋪上方形磁磚後看起來很整齊。
If someone acts squarely, they do so in a way that is in the shape of a square; at right angles. 如果一個人的行為是正直的，那麼他就會以正方形的方式行事；呈直角。
The speaker responded squarely during the discussion. 發言者在討論中做出了正面回應。
I did not mean to squash the tomatoes in the bag. 我不是故意把袋裡的番茄壓爛。
Please squash the can before you toss it out. 丟掉前請先把鋁罐壓扁。
The little boy squatted down to look at the tiny beetle on the ground. 小男孩蹲下身去看地面上的那隻小甲蟲。
They were discovered squatting in an empty warehouse in the city center. 他們被發現在市中心的一個空倉庫裡擅自居住。
The wet brakes began to squeal at the red light. 濕掉的煞車在紅燈前開始尖叫。
The little girl will squeal if she sees the puppy. 小女孩看到那隻小狗就會尖叫。
Could you please help me squeeze some fresh lemon into the tea? 能請妳幫我在茶裡擠點新鮮檸檬嗎？
She managed to squeeze all her clothes into the small suitcase. 她設法將所有的衣服都塞（擠）進了那個小行李箱。
This metal squeezer works better for lemons. 這個金屬榨汁器榨檸檬比較好用。
I left the garlic squeezer beside the sink. 我把蒜泥壓器放在水槽旁。
We grilled fresh squid at the night market. 我們在夜市烤了新鮮魷魚。
The diver filmed a squid near the reef. 潛水員在礁石附近拍到一隻魷魚。
I have to squint when the noon sun hits the road. 正午陽光照到路面時，我得瞇著眼看。
Please squint through the peephole and tell me who is there. 請從門上的小孔瞇眼看看是誰。
The old squire owned most of the fields nearby. 那位老鄉紳擁有附近大部分田地。
At the fair, the young squire rode beside the mayor. 在市集上，那位年輕鄉紳騎在市長旁邊。
A small brown squirrel was scurrying across the garden path. 一隻褐色小松鼠正從花園小路上竄過。
Squirrels are known for gathering and hiding nuts for the winter. 松鼠以收集並儲藏堅果過冬而聞名。

meaning: 從狹窄的孔口以急流的形式被拋出或噴射。
sentences: The toothpaste squirted from the tube. 牙膏從管子裡噴了出來。
To squirt means to be thrown out, or ejected, in a rapid stream, from a narrow orifice. 噴出的意思是從狹窄的孔口以快速的水流被拋出或噴射。
Do not squish the cake box under the groceries. 不要把蛋糕盒壓在雜貨下面。
Ripe peaches squish too easily in this bag. 熟桃子在這個袋子裡太容易被壓爛。

meaning: 容易屈服於壓力；非常柔軟。
sentences: The toy was soft and squishy, making it fun to squeeze. 這個玩具又軟又濕，擠壓起來很有趣。
The mud was squishy underfoot after the rainstorm. 暴雨過後，腳下的泥巴濕軟的。
Engineers inspected the cracked ssi under the bridge. 工程師檢查了橋下龜裂的橋臺。
The stone ssi supports the first arch. 那座石製拱座支撐著第一道拱。
He felt a sharp stab of pain in his chest and decided to see a doctor. 他感到胸口有一陣劇痛，決定去看醫生。
I've never played chess before, but I'm willing to have a stab at it. 我以前沒玩過象棋，但我願意嘗試一下（刺一下）。
A stabbing took place in the alley last night. 昨晚，巷子裡發生了一起持刀傷人事件。
The hospital receives many victims of stabbings. 醫院收治了許多持刀傷者。
The new policy aims to ensure economic stability and promote growth. 新政策旨在確保經濟穩定並促進增長。
The bridge's structural stability was checked following the earthquake. 地震後檢查了橋樑的結構穩定性。
The government is introducing new measures to stabilize the economy. 政府正在推出新措施以穩定經濟。
The patient's condition began to stabilize after several days of treatment. 病人的情況在治療幾天後開始穩定下來。
Her pulse stayed stable through the night. 她的脈搏整晚都很穩定。
A stable table matters when you frost a cake. 抹蛋糕奶油時，穩固的桌子很重要。
There was a large stack of old newspapers and magazines in the corner. 角落裡有一大疊舊報紙和雜誌。
She carefully stacked the clean dishes in the kitchen cupboard. 她把洗淨的盤子整齊地堆放在廚房櫥櫃裡。
The new stadium has a seating capacity of over fifty thousand. 這座新體育場擁有超過五萬個座位。
The stadium was packed with excited fans watching the final match. 體育場擠滿了觀看決賽的興奮粉絲。
The hotel staff were very polite and provided excellent service. 飯店員工非常有禮貌且提供了優質服務。
The company is planning to hire additional staff for the project. 公司正計劃為該專案雇用額外的人員。
A museum staffer helped us find the locker room. 一位博物館工作人員幫我們找到置物間。
That new staffer already knows every printer code. 那位新進員工已經知道所有印表機代碼。
A stag stepped onto the road at dusk. 黃昏時一頭雄鹿走上了馬路。
We watched a stag drink from the stream. 我們看著一頭雄鹿在溪邊喝水。
The actor felt very nervous before he walked onto the stage. 演員走上舞台前感到非常緊張。
The project is currently in its final stage of development. 專案目前正處於開發的最後階段。
The heavy box made him stagger down the stairs. 那個重箱子讓他下樓時踉蹌。
The final price may stagger first-time buyers. 最後價格可能讓第一次買房的人大吃一驚。
The repair bill was staggering for such a small leak. 這麼小的漏水卻開出驚人的修繕費。
The couple left downtown because of staggering rent. 那對夫妻因為高得嚇人的房租離開市中心。
The water turned stagnant after a week of heat. 熱了一週後，那池水變得不流動又發臭。
Business felt stagnant all winter in that lane. 那條巷子的生意整個冬天都很停滯。
Months of stagnation made the shop owner anxious. 幾個月的停滯讓店主很焦慮。
Both sides grew tired of stagnation in the talks. 雙方都受夠了談判停滯。
His apology sounded stagy and false. 他的道歉聽起來做作又不真誠。
The room had a stagy look with red curtains and bright lights. 這個房間有紅窗簾和亮燈，看起來很像舞台。
The staid office needed a brighter color. 那間古板的辦公室需要更明亮的顏色。
He gave a staid speech at the ceremony. 他在典禮上發表了一段一本正經的演說。
I accidentally spilled some red wine and left a nasty stain on the rug. 我不小心灑了些紅酒，在地毯上留下了難看的污漬。
The scandal left a permanent stain on the politician's reputation. 醜聞在那位政治家的聲譽上留下了永久的污點。
The kitchen sink is made of stainless metal. 廚房水槽是防鏽金屬做的。
Choose stainless screws for outdoor use. 戶外使用請選防鏽螺絲。
The pot is made of stainless steel. 這個鍋子是不鏽鋼做的。
Stainless steel is easy to clean. 不鏽鋼很容易清潔。
She sat on the bottom stair to tie her laces. 她坐在最下面那級樓梯綁鞋帶。
One loose stair squeaks every morning. 有一級鬆動的樓梯每天早上都會嘎吱作響。
The old staircase creaked under his feet. 舊樓梯在他腳下嘎吱作響。
A narrow staircase leads to the roof. 一座狹窄樓梯通往屋頂。
The stairway was dark after the power went out. 停電後，樓梯間一片昏暗。
Please keep the stairway clear during the move. 搬家時請保持樓梯通道暢通。
He has a significant financial stake in the new technology startup. 他在那家新科技初創公司擁有重大股份（經濟利益）。
The stakes are high in this international competition, so we must be careful. 在這場國際比賽中，賭注（利害關係）很大，所以我們必須小心。
The bread had gone stale because it was left out for two days. 麵包因為放了兩天而變味（陳舊）了。
The air in the crowded room felt very stale and stuffy tonight. 擁擠房間裡的空氣今晚感到非常污濁且悶熱。

meaning: 任何一種比賽，雙方均未聲稱獲勝； 抽獎 。
sentences: The talks ended in a stalemate. 談判陷入僵局。
Neither side could win, so the game became a stalemate. 雙方都無法取勝，因此比賽成了平局。
Cut the broccoli stalk into thin slices. 把花椰菜的莖切成薄片。
The rose stalk scratched my wrist. 玫瑰的莖刮到了我的手腕。

meaning: 從事追蹤活動的人，即悄悄接近待獵殺的動物；狩獵遊戲中的追蹤器或嚮導。
sentences: The police warned her about the stalker. 警方提醒她注意跟蹤者。
A wildlife stalker moved quietly through the forest. 野生動物追蹤者安靜地穿過森林。
We visited several interesting stalls at the annual community festival. 我們參觀了年度社區節慶上幾個有趣的攤位。
The engine began to stall when the car was climbing the steep hill. 當汽車爬陡坡時，引擎開始熄火。
The driver's stalling held up the line at the gate. 司機一再拖延，讓大門口排起長隊。
Repeated stalling during takeoff worried the pilot. 起飛時反覆失速讓飛行員很擔心。

meaning: 一匹成年雄性馬。具體來說，就是未閹割的。主要作為種馬飼養的公馬。
sentences: The black stallion ran across the field. 黑色種馬跑過田野。
The farm keeps one stallion for breeding. 農場養了一匹公馬作為種馬。
She is a stalwart of the neighborhood cleanup team. 她是社區清掃隊的中堅人物。
