His angry steven echoed across the yard. 他憤怒的喊聲在院子裡迴盪。
A rough steven rose from the crowd when the gate opened. 大門打開時，人群裡冒出一陣粗啞的喊聲。
My mother prepared a delicious beef and vegetable stew for dinner. 我媽媽準備了美味的燉牛肉和蔬菜當晚餐。
Don't just sit there and stew about your problems; try to find a solution. 不要只是坐在那裡為你的問題煩惱；試著找個解決方案。
A flight steward brought us water during the delay. 班機延誤時，一位空服員替我們送來水。
The event steward checked every wristband at the gate. 活動工作人員在門口檢查每條手環。
Good forest stewardship protects streams and soil. 良好的森林管理能保護溪流與土壤。
The club praised her stewardship of the old library. 社團稱讚她把老圖書室照顧得很好。
He used a long wooden stick to reach the fruit on the high branch. 他用一根長木棍去勾高枝上的水果。
It's important to stick to your principles, even when it's hard. 即使困難，堅持自己的原則也很重要。
My niece put a cat sticker on my notebook. 我姪女把一張貓咪貼紙貼在我的筆記本上。
The sale price was hidden under another sticker. 特價標籤被另一張貼紙蓋住了。
My aunt loves living out in the sticks. 我阿姨很喜歡住在偏遠鄉間。
Bus service in the sticks ends before sunset. 偏遠鄉間的公車在日落前就停駛。
The little child had sticky hands after eating the fruit candy. 吃完水果糖後，小孩的手黏答答的。
The weather today is very hot and humid, making me feel sticky. 今天天氣又熱又濕，讓我感到全身黏糊糊的。
My muscles felt very stiff after the intense workout yesterday. 昨天激烈運動後，我的肌肉感到非常僵硬。
The new leather shoes are a bit stiff and need to be worn in. 這雙新皮鞋有點硬，需要穿一段時間來適應。
Morning stiffness makes his knees slow at first. 早晨的僵硬感一開始會讓他的膝蓋很慢。
After the long flight, neck stiffness ruined my nap. 長途飛行後，脖子僵硬讓我沒睡好。
Do not stifle a sneeze so hard. 不要把噴嚏硬憋回去。
Fear can stifle good ideas in a new team. 恐懼會壓抑新團隊裡的好點子。

meaning: 悶熱難受的；令人窒息的
sentences: The bus was stifling with all the windows shut. 所有窗戶都關著，公車裡悶得難受。
The office felt stifling under those rules. 那些規定讓辦公室氣氛悶得讓人難受。

meaning: 烙印、切割或紋身在皮膚上的永久身份標記，通常給予奴隸、罪犯和叛徒。
sentences: There is still stigma around mental illness. 心理疾病仍然帶有污名。
She spoke openly to reduce the stigma. 她公開發聲以減少污名。
Her black stiletto kept sinking into the grass. 她的黑色細高跟鞋一直陷進草地裡。
The detective bagged a steel stiletto from the drawer. 偵探從抽屜裡取出一把細長匕首裝袋。
I am still waiting for his reply to my email. 我還在等待他對我郵件的回覆。
Is it still raining outside? I forgot to bring my umbrella. 外面還在下雨嗎？我忘了帶傘。

meaning: 一種能夠增加體內生理或神經活動的物質。
sentences: Caffeine is a common stimulant. 咖啡因是常見的興奮劑。
The medicine acts as a mild stimulant. 這種藥有輕微興奮作用。
The government is introducing new measures to stimulate economic growth. 政府正在推出新措施以刺激經濟增長。
The teacher used various activities to stimulate interest in history. 老師利用各種活動來激發（刺激）學生對歷史的興趣。
The project provided a lot of intellectual stimulation for the students. 該專案為學生提供了很多智力上的刺激（啟發）。
The baby needs constant stimulation from toys and activities to learn. 寶寶需要玩具和活動的不斷刺激來學習。
The sudden increase in sales provided a major stimulus for the company. 銷售額的突然增加為公司提供了一個重大的刺激。
Plants grow towards the light, which is a natural stimulus for them. 植物向光生長，光對它們來說是一種自然刺激。
The bee sting hurt for an hour. 蜜蜂螫傷痛了一個小時。
His joke had a sting that I did not expect. 他的玩笑帶著我沒想到的刺痛感。
He is so stingy that he never leaves a tip for the waiters at restaurants. 他太小氣（吝嗇）了，在餐廳從來不給服務生小費。
The company was criticized for being stingy with its employee benefits. 該公司因對員工福利過於吝嗇而受到批評。
These onions stink after a day in the car. 這些洋蔥放在車裡一天後很臭。
Cheap lies stink worse than bad news. 廉價的謊言比壞消息更惹人厭。
There was a stinking puddle behind the market. 市場後面有一灘發臭的積水。
That stinking attitude ruins group projects. 那種爛透的態度會毀掉小組作業。
Don't stint on the food; we have plenty for everyone! 別在食物上省（吝嗇）；我們有足夠每個人吃的！
He served a short stint in the army before going to university. 他在上大學前在軍隊服役了一段短暫的任期。

meaning: 作為協議條件而陳述或規定的事物。
sentences: The stipulations of the contract won't allow you to do that. 合約的規定不允許你這樣做。
If I lend you my car, my only stipulation is that you fill up the gas tank before returning it. 如果我把車借給你，我唯一的規定就是你在還車之前把油箱加滿。
Please stir the soup before you taste it. 喝之前請先攪一攪湯。
The song can still stir old memories. 那首歌仍然能喚起舊回憶。
The doctor had to put several stitches in the deep wound. 醫生不得不在深傷口上縫了好幾針。
She is learning how to do basic embroidery stitches in class. 她正在課堂上學習如何做基礎的刺繡針法。
The store has a large stock of high-quality products at competitive prices. 該商店備有大量物美價廉的優質產品存貨。
He decided to invest all his savings in the company's stocks and bonds. 他決定將所有積蓄投資於該公司的股票（股份）和債券。
She bought a pair of warm wool stockings for the winter. 她買了一雙新的暖和羊毛長襪過冬。
Children hang their Christmas stockings by the fireplace. 孩子們把聖誕襪掛在壁爐旁。
She bought sheer stocking(s) for the wedding. 她買了透明長襪搭配婚禮穿著。
A green stocking(s) hung by the fireplace. 一只綠色聖誕襪掛在壁爐旁。

meaning: 一個國家擁有的核武供應；核子儲備。
sentences: The town keeps a stockpile of emergency food. 鎮上儲備了一批緊急糧食。
They began to stockpile batteries before the storm. 暴風雨前，他們開始儲備電池。

meaning: 對快樂或痛苦漠不關心的人。
sentences: He stayed stoic during the bad news. 聽到壞消息時，他仍保持堅忍。
A stoic patient rarely complained about pain. 一位堅忍的病人很少抱怨疼痛。

meaning: 照看爐子或為爐子供應燃料；充當司爐或消防員。
sentences: To stoke means to attend to or supply a furnace with fuel; to act as a stoker or fireman. 添火是指為爐子提供燃料或照顧；充當司爐或消防員。
People may stoke in different situations depending on the context. 人們可能會根據具體情況在不同的情況下進行刺激。
The stoker fed coal into the ship's boiler. 司爐工把煤加入船上的鍋爐。
A tired stoker rested beside the engine room. 疲累的加煤工在引擎室旁休息。

meaning: 類似圍巾的衣服，通常由毛皮製成。
sentences: She wore a fur stole over her dress. 她在洋裝外披了一條毛皮披肩。
The dancer wrapped a red stole around her shoulders. 舞者把紅色披肩圍在肩上。
The stolen bike was found near the station. 被偷的腳踏車在車站附近找到了。
She reported her stolen wallet to the police. 她向警方通報錢包被偷。
Eating too much spicy food can often cause a stomach upset. 吃太多辛辣食物常會引起胃部不適。
The doctor examined his stomach to check for any abnormalities. 醫生檢查了他的胃部，看看是否有任何異常。
I have a terrible stomachache; I think I ate something bad. 我肚子痛得很厲害；我想我吃了什麼壞東西。
Eating too much spicy food can often cause a stomachache. 吃太多辛辣食物常會引起肚子痛。
Kids love to stomp in puddles after rain. 小孩很愛在雨後的水窪裡重踩。
Please do not stomp upstairs after midnight. 半夜過後不要在樓上重踩。
The old castle was built from large blocks of local stone. 這座舊城堡是由當地的巨石塊建造而成的。
The little boy was happily skipping stones across the calm lake. 小男孩正開心地在平靜的湖面上玩打水漂。
He sounded stoned and forgetful on the call. 他在電話裡聽起來恍恍惚惚又健忘。
Two stoned teens slept through the movie. 兩個嗑茫的青少年整場電影都在睡。

meaning: 去核機；去果核的人或工具
sentences: The kitchen used a stoner to prepare cherries for pies. 廚房用去核機處理櫻桃做派。
A good stoner saves time during jam making. 好用的去核工具能在做果醬時省時間。
The company tried to stonewall every refund request. 那家公司試圖拖住每一筆退款申請。
Do not stonewall when your partner asks a direct question. 伴侶直接發問時，不要拒不回應。
The hikers crossed a stony beach at noon. 健行的人在中午穿過一片多石的海灘。
Her stony face gave us no clue. 她冷硬的表情沒有給我們任何線索。
He sat on a small wooden stool and started peeling potatoes. 他坐在一個小木凳上，開始削馬鈴薯皮。
She used a step stool to reach the books on the high shelf. 她用一個踏板凳去夠高架上的書。
He had to stoop to enter the low shed. 他得彎腰才能走進那間低矮的小棚子。
Please stoop a little, or you will hit the pipe. 請稍微彎一下身，不然你會撞到管子。
Please stop talking and listen to the instructions. 請停止說話，聽好說明。
The bus stops right in front of the supermarket. 公車就停在超市正門口。

meaning: 對持續活動構成障礙的事物；阻塞或阻礙。
sentences: A power stoppage delayed the show. 停電讓表演延誤。
The referee called a stoppage after the injury. 裁判在有人受傷後暫停比賽。

meaning: 沒有移動，但沒有正確停放或停泊；也談到了此類車輛的乘員。
sentences: We were stopped for more than three hours! 我們被攔了三個多小時！
They passed a stopped car on the side of the road, but realized there was nothing they could do to help. 他們經過路邊一輛停著的汽車，但意識到自己無能為力。
The rubber stopper fell into the sink. 橡膠塞子掉進水槽裡了。
A loose stopper made the bottle leak. 鬆掉的瓶塞讓瓶子漏了。
The sudden stopping threw coffee onto my lap. 突然煞停把咖啡灑到我腿上。
Frequent stopping makes this bus route slow. 一直停停走走讓這條公車路線很慢。
The new house has ample storage space for all their belongings. 這座新房子有充足的儲藏空間來存放他們的所有物品。
Most of the files are kept in digital storage to ensure security and accessibility. 大多數文件都保存在數位儲存器中，以確保安全與便捷。
I need to go to the department store to buy some new clothes. 我需要去百貨公司買些新衣服。
You can store your luggage in the hotel's storage room. 你可以把行李存放在飯店的儲藏室裡。
A white stork stood in the wet field. 一隻白鸛站在濕地田裡。
We saw a stork carry twigs to its nest. 我們看到一隻鸛鳥叼樹枝回巢。
The entire city was hit by a massive tropical storm last night. 昨晚整座城市遭受了一場巨大熱帶風暴的襲擊。
We stayed inside and waited for the violent storm to pass. 我們待在室內，等待那場猛烈的暴風雨過去。
The storming of the gate lasted ten minutes. 那場攻門只持續了十分鐘。
News footage showed a storming at dawn. 新聞畫面拍到黎明時分的一次強攻。
The sea was very stormy today, so the boat trip was canceled. 海面今天浪很大（暴風雨般的），所以乘船旅行取消了。
The couple had a very stormy relationship and often argued. 這對情侶關係非常動盪（風暴般的），經常爭吵。
My daughter asked for one more story before bed. 我女兒睡前還想再聽一個故事。
That old house has a story behind every room. 那棟老房子的每個房間背後都有故事。

meaning: 透過一種媒介或另一種媒介向觀眾講述故事的人。
sentences: My grandmother is a wonderful storyteller. 我奶奶很會說故事。
The storyteller kept the children quiet for an hour. 說故事的人讓孩子們安靜了一小時。
He was a man of small stature but a stout build. 他身材矮小但體格粗壯（肥胖）。
The box is made of stout cardboard for protection. 箱子是由結實的厚紙板製成的以進行保護。
My mother is cooking a delicious vegetable soup on the stove. 我媽媽正在爐子上煮美味的蔬菜湯。
Please turn off the gas stove before you leave the kitchen. 離開廚房前請關掉瓦斯爐。
To stow means to cease; to stop doing something. 收起意味著停止；停止做某事。
People may stow in different situations depending on the context. 人們可能會根據具體情況在不同的情況下存放。
Go straight for two blocks and then turn left at the corner. 直走兩個街區，然後在轉角處左轉。
She has long straight hair and beautiful brown eyes. 她留著長長的直髮，有一雙漂亮的棕色眼睛。
She tried to straighten the crooked picture hanging on the wall. 她試圖把牆上掛歪的照片弄直。
He decided to straighten up the office before the important meeting. 他決定在重要會議前整頓（清理）一下辦公室。
The instructions were very straightforward and easy to follow. 說明非常簡單明瞭，很容易遵循。
She is a very straightforward person who always tells the truth. 她是一個非常正直且直爽的人，總是說實話。
Working long hours every day began to put a severe strain on his health. 每天長時間工作開始對他的健康造成嚴重的壓力（過勞）。
The scientist studied a new strain of virus that was highly contagious. 科學家研究了一種具有高度傳染性的新病毒株（品種）。
The narrow strait connects the two major oceans in the northern region. 這條狹窄的海峽連接了北部的兩大洋。
The company is in dire straits following the sudden financial crisis. 金融危機之後，公司陷入了極大的困境。
She brushed a stray strand of hair away from her face and smiled. 她把臉上的一縷亂髮理開，露出了微笑。
Thousands of passengers were stranded at the airport due to the storm. 由於風暴，數千名乘客被困（擱淺/陷於困境）在機場。
I heard a strange noise coming from the attic last night. 我昨晚聽到閣樓傳來一聲怪響。
It's strange that he hasn't arrived yet; he's usually on time. 他還沒到真奇怪，他通常都很準時。

meaning: 以一種奇怪或巧合的方式。
sentences: Though I'd never gone to Boston before, everything looked strangely familiar. 雖然我以前從未去過波士頓，但一切看起來都異常熟悉。
Daniel was walking strangely because he had twisted his ankle. 丹尼爾走路很奇怪，因為他扭傷了腳踝。
You should never talk to strangers or accept gifts from them. 你絕對不應該和陌生人說話或接受他們的禮物。
A complete stranger helped me find my way to the station. 一個完全陌生的人幫我指引了去車站的路。
The police believe that the victim was strangled with a silk scarf. 警方認為受害者是被一條絲巾勒死的。
High taxes can sometimes strangle the growth of small businesses. 高稅收有時會扼殺小企業的成長。

meaning: 勒死的行為或被勒死的狀態。
sentences: The report listed strangulation as the cause of death. 報告列出窒息勒死為死因。
The scarf was loose enough to avoid strangulation. 圍巾夠鬆，不會造成勒住窒息。
Please make sure you fasten the leather strap of your helmet securely. 請務必繫緊頭盔的皮革帶子。
The heavy boxes were strapped to the back of the pickup truck. 沈重的箱子被用帶子綑紮在皮卡車的後部。
The drill exposed three clear strata in the cliff. 鑽探讓懸崖裡三層清楚的地層露了出來。
Different strata of soil held different shells. 不同土層裡埋著不同的貝殼。
The company made a strategic decision to expand into the international market. 公司做出了一項向國際市場擴張的戰略性決策。
The city's location is of great strategic importance for regional trade. 該市的地理位置對於地區貿易具有重大的戰略意義（關鍵性）。
The campaign hired a political strategist. 競選團隊聘請了一位政治策略家。
A good strategist plans several steps ahead. 好的策略家會提前規劃好幾步。
We need to develop a long-term strategy to achieve our goals. 我們需要制定一項長期策略來實現目標。
The company's marketing strategy proved to be highly successful. 公司的行銷策略證明是非常成功的。
The lake stayed stratified through the hot month. 那座湖在炎熱的月份裡一直維持分層。
A stratified sample gave the survey better balance. 分層抽樣讓調查更均衡。
The team logged every stratigraphic change in the trench. 團隊記錄了探溝裡每一次地層變化。
The report used stratigraphic evidence to date the ash layer. 報告利用地層學證據為那層火山灰定年。
The farmer kept a large stack of hay and straw in the barn. 農夫在穀倉裡存了一大堆乾草與稻草。
Would you like a plastic straw for your cold fruit juice? 妳的冷果汁想要一根塑料吸管（稻草）嗎？
She sliced a strawberry onto each pancake. 她在每片鬆餅上都放了一片草莓。
The jam tasted mostly like ripe strawberry. 那罐果醬嚐起來主要是熟草莓的味道。
Please do not stray from the marked trail. 請不要偏離標示好的步道。
One puppy can stray through the open gate in seconds. 小狗幾秒內就可能從開著的門走失。
A streak of paint ran down the white wall. 白牆上流下一道油漆痕。
Her winning streak ended after five games. 她的連勝在第五場後結束了。
The mountain stream was crystal clear and cold as ice. 山間溪流的水清澈見底且冰冷如冰。
You can stream your favorite movies and music online anytime. 你可以在網上隨時串流觀看妳最喜歡的電影和音樂。
A game streamer greeted viewers from a small desk. 一位遊戲實況主在小書桌前跟觀眾打招呼。
That streamer tests every new racing game on Friday night. 那位直播主每週五晚上都會試玩新的賽車遊戲。
Living on a busy street can be very noisy and stressful. 住在繁忙的街道上可能會非常吵鬧且充滿壓力。
The street is lined with beautiful old trees and cafes. 街道兩旁種滿了美麗的老樹，還有咖啡館。
Regular exercise is a great way to build physical strength. 定期運動是增強體力的好方法。
She showed great internal strength and courage during the crisis. 她在危機期間展現了強大的內在力量與勇氣。
The government plans to strengthen the laws against environmental pollution. 政府計畫加強打擊環境污染的法律。
Doing regular exercises can help strengthen your muscles and bones. 定期運動可以幫助加強你的肌肉和骨骼。
Regular exercise is a great way to reduce daily stress and anxiety. 定期運動是減輕日常壓力與焦慮的好方法。
The teacher emphasized the stress on the final syllable of the word. 老師強調了這個單字最後一個音節上的重音。
Something described as stressful is irritating; causing stress. 被描述為有壓力的事情是令人惱火的；造成壓力。
The word stressful is often used to describe a person, thing, or situation. 有壓力這個詞常用來形容人、事或情況。
It's important to stretch your muscles before and after exercise. 運動前後伸展肌肉是很重要的。
The long sandy beach stretches for miles along the coast. 漫長的沙灘沿著海岸延伸了好幾英里。
The paramedics lifted him onto a stretcher. 救護人員把他抬上擔架。
The joke was a stretcher, but everyone laughed. 那個笑話有點誇張，但大家都笑了。

meaning: 被物體覆蓋、分散或散佈。
sentences: Something described as strewn is covered, scattered or overspread with objects. 被描述為散佈的東西是被物體覆蓋、分散或散佈的。
The word strewn is often used to describe a person, thing, or situation. 散佈這個詞常用來形容人、事或情況。
The town was stricken by a devastating earthquake that left many buildings in ruins. 該鎮遭受了毀滅性的地震，許多建築物成為廢墟。
Something described as stricken is struck by something. 被描述為被擊中的東西被某物擊中。
The school has a very strict policy against bullying and fighting. 學校有一項非常嚴格的反霸凌與反鬥毆政策。
My parents were quite strict when I was a small child. 當我還是一個小孩時，我的父母相當嚴格。

meaning: 在狹義或有限的意義上。
sentences: That term refers strictly to smaller birds. 該術語嚴格指較小的鳥類。
If someone acts strictly, they do so in a way that is in a narrow or limited sense. 如果某人行事嚴格，那麼他們的行事方式就是狹隘的或有限的。
He walked down the street with a long and confident stride. 他邁著自信的大步走在街上。
Significant strides have been made in the field of modern medical science. 現代醫學領域已經取得了重大的進步（跨越）。

meaning: 努力；認真努力；努力工作。
sentences: Years of strife divided the family. 多年的衝突讓這個家庭分裂。
The leader tried to end the strife between the groups. 領袖試圖結束兩個團體之間的爭端。
The workers decided to go on strike for better pay and conditions. 工人們決定為了更好的薪資與條件而罷工。
The lightning strike caused a massive fire in the dry pine forest. 雷擊在乾燥的松樹林中引起了一場大火。

meaning: 一個正在罷工的人，一個停止工作以示抗議的人。
sentences: The striker scored in the last minute. 前鋒在最後一分鐘進球。
A striker outside the factory held a sign. 工廠外一名罷工者舉著標語。
There is a striking resemblance between the two sisters, although they are not twins. 這對姐妹之間有著顯著的（引人注目的）相似之處。
She wore a striking red dress that caught everyone's attention at the party. 她穿了一件引人注目的紅洋裝，吸引了派對上所有人的目光。

meaning: 在顯著的程度上或程度。
sentences: He was strikingly deficient in good sense. 他的判斷力明顯不足。
If someone acts strikingly, they do so in a way that is to a remarkable degree or extent. 如果某人的行為引人注目，則他們的行為方式達到了令人矚目的程度或程度。
He tied the heavy package with a strong piece of string. 他用一根結實的繩子捆住了那個沉重的包裹。
She broke a string on her guitar during the concert. 她在音樂會上彈斷了一根吉他弦。

meaning: 嚴格；結合力強；提出嚴格要求；限制性的；死板的;嚴重的。
sentences: They have stringent quality requirements outlining what is acceptable. 他們有嚴格的品質要求，概述了可接受的範圍。
Something described as stringent is strict; binding strongly; making strict requirements; restrictive; rigid; severe. 所謂嚴格，就是嚴格；結合力強；提出嚴格要求；限制性的；死板的;嚴重。

meaning: 穿線的人；製造或提供琴弦（尤其是弓弦）的人。
sentences: The newspaper hired a stringer in the small town. 報社在小鎮聘了一名特約記者。
The old staircase needed a new wooden stringer. 舊樓梯需要一根新的木製側梁。
The beach is a narrow strip of white sand along the coast. 沙灘是沿著海岸的一條狹窄白色沙帶。
He used a strip of adhesive tape to fix the broken box. 他用一條膠帶修好了那個壞掉的盒子。
The zebra is famous for its black and white stripes all over its body. 斑馬以其全身黑白相間的條紋而聞名。
He chose a blue shirt with thin white stripes for the formal dinner. 他選擇了一件帶有白色細條紋的藍色襯衫參加正式晚宴。
That striped towel is mine. 那條有條紋的毛巾是我的。
She bought a striped shirt for the beach trip. 她為海邊旅行買了一件條紋襯衫。

meaning: 以性挑釁的方式脫掉衣服的人，尤其是作為一種付費娛樂形式。
sentences: The club hired a stripper for the late show. 俱樂部為深夜場聘了一名脫衣舞者。
A wire stripper makes electrical work easier. 剝線鉗讓電工工作更容易。
We should always strive to achieve our goals and never give up. 我們應該始終努力實現目標，永不放棄。
The organization strives to provide clean drinking water to remote villages. 該組織力求為偏遠村莊提供清潔的飲用水。
Smoking and high blood pressure significantly increase the risk of a stroke. 吸菸和高血壓會顯著增加中風的風險。
With a few skillful strokes of the brush, the artist completed the painting. 藝術家輕揮幾筆（筆劃），便完成了這幅畫。
We decided to take a relaxing stroll along the beach at sunset. 我們決定在日落時分沿著海灘輕鬆散步。
They enjoyed strolling through the narrow streets of the ancient city. 他們喜歡漫步在古城的狹窄街道上。

meaning: 帶輪子的座椅或椅子，由後面行走的人推動，通常用於運送嬰兒和幼兒。
sentences: She pushed the baby in a stroller. 她推著嬰兒車裡的寶寶。
The stroller folded easily for the bus ride. 嬰兒車很容易折起來搭公車。
He needs strong arms to lift that box. 他需要有力的手臂才能搬起那個箱子。
This coffee is too strong for me. 這杯咖啡對我來說太濃了。
The hilltop castle served as a stronghold for years. 山頂城堡多年來一直是據點。
This district is still a stronghold of local support. 這一區仍然是地方支持者的票倉。

meaning: 以強烈或強有力的方式。
sentences: In the third race, Renowned Blaze finished strongly to win, paying sixteen dollars. 在第三場比賽中，Renknown Blaze 強勢獲勝，支付了 16 美元。
If someone acts strongly, they do so in a way that is in a strong or powerful manner. 如果某人表現強烈，他們會以一種強有力的方式這樣做。
The engineers checked the structural integrity of the bridge after the earthquake. 工程師在地震後檢查了橋樑的結構完整性。
The building underwent several structural changes during the renovation. 該建築在裝修期間進行了幾次結構變動。
After the hurricane, the building was structurally sound but aesthetically displeasing. 颶風過後，這棟建築結構完好，但美觀程度令人不快。
If someone acts structurally, they do so in a way that is in terms of structure. 如果有人按結構行事，他們就會按照結構的方式行事。
The bridge is a magnificent structure that connects two towns. 這座橋是連接兩個小鎮的宏偉建築（結構）。
The researchers are studying the complex structure of the DNA. 研究人員正研究 DNA 的複雜結構。
Many people struggle to balance their work and personal lives. 許多人努力在工作與個人生活之間取得平衡。
The country has faced many challenges in its struggle for freedom. 該國在爭取自由的鬥爭中面臨了許多挑戰。

meaning: 昂首闊步或驕傲地走路。
sentences: He strutted about the yard, thinking himself master of all he surveyed. 他在院子裡大搖大擺地走來走去，認為自己掌控了所見的一切。
To strut means to walk haughtily or proudly with one's head held high. 昂首闊步的意思是昂首闊步或驕傲地走路。

meaning: 一種特定的紙質物品，設計用於撕下並保存用於記錄或識別目的。
sentences: Keep the ticket stub until the show ends. 表演結束前請保留票根。
He hit his toe on the chair stub. 他的腳趾撞到椅腳短端。
He is as stubborn as a mule and never changes his mind easily. 他就像騾子一樣固執，從不輕易改變主意。
We had some trouble removing the stubborn stain from the carpet. 我們在去除地毯上那個頑固的汙漬時遇到了一些困難。
He stubbornly refused to quit trying, even after failing 20 times. 儘管失敗了20次，他仍然頑固地拒絕放棄嘗試。
The team responded stubbornly to the change. 團隊對這項變化做出了頑固的反應。
I’m totally stuck on this question in the test. 我在考試中完全被這個問題困住了。
Something described as stuck is unable to progress with a task. 被描述為卡住的事物無法完成任務。
A silver stud fell off my jacket. 我外套上的一顆銀色飾釘掉了。
The dog wore a collar with brass studs. 那隻狗戴著有黃銅飾釘的項圈。
She is a hardworking student who always gets top marks. 她是一位勤奮的學生，總是拿到最高分。
There are thirty students in my history class this semester. 我的歷史課這學期有三十名學生。
Her smile looked studied in the photo. 她在照片裡的笑容看起來很刻意。
He answered in a studied calm voice. 他用刻意平靜的語氣回答。
She is a talented artist who works in her own private studio. 她是一位在自己私人工作室工作的有才華藝術家。
The television studio was packed with equipment and personnel. 電視攝影棚裡擠滿了設備與工作人員。
I need to study hard for the upcoming final exam. 我需要為即將到來的期末考試努力唸書。
The study shows that regular exercise can improve memory. 研究顯示定期運動可以改善記憶力。
Please put all your school stuff in your bag before you leave. 請在離開前把所有學校用的東西放進書包。
The drawer was filled with all sorts of useless old stuff. 抽屜裡裝滿了各種沒用的舊東西。
A stuffed backpack would not fit under the seat. 塞滿東西的背包放不進座位下。
The child hugged a stuffed bear at bedtime. 那個孩子睡前抱著填充玩具熊。
The pillow lost some stuffing after the wash. 那個枕頭洗過後掉了一些填充物。
Mom spooned bread stuffing into the chicken. 媽媽把麵包餡料舀進雞肚裡。
I can’t smell very well today – I have a stuffy nose. 我今天聞起來不太好——我鼻子不通氣。
Let’s go outside – it’s getting stuffy in here. 我們出去吧——這裡太悶了。
The hikers had to be careful not to stumble over the loose rocks. 登山者必須小心不要被松動的岩石絆倒。
He began to stumble over his words when he was asked a difficult question. 當被問到困難的問題時，他開始結巴（說話打結）。
That last riddle will stump most children. 最後那題謎語會難倒大多數孩子。
The tax form stumped me for an hour. 那張稅表讓我困惑了一個小時。
The news of his sudden resignation managed to stun everyone in the office. 他突然辭職的消息令辦公室裡的每個人都感到震驚。
The powerful blow to his head managed to stun him for several minutes. 頭部的重擊使他昏迷了幾分鐘。
The sunset looked stunning from the ferry. 從渡輪上看到的夕陽非常驚艷。
She wore a stunning blue dress to dinner. 她穿著一件驚艷的藍色洋裝去吃晚餐。
The lake looked stunningly clear after the storm. 暴風雨過後，湖水清澈得驚人。
He played stunningly well in the final set. 他在最後一盤打得異常出色。

meaning: 阻止或阻礙生長或發展。
sentences: Some have said smoking stunts your growth. 有人說抽菸會阻礙你的成長。
The politician timed his announcement to stunt any surge in the polls his opponent might gain from the convention. 這位政治家選擇了宣布這一消息的時機，以阻止他的對手可能從大會中獲得的民意調查激增。
The dry summer left the tomato plants stunted. 乾燥的夏天讓番茄植株長得發育不良。
Years of neglect made the park trees look stunted. 多年的疏於照顧讓公園的樹木看起來矮小瘦弱。
I felt so stupid after making such a silly mistake. 犯了這麼愚蠢的錯誤後，我覺得自己好傻。
It was a stupid decision to quit his job without another one lined up. 在沒找好下一份工作前就辭職是個愚蠢的決定。
His stupidity showed when he left the keys outside. 他把鑰匙留在門外時就顯出了自己的愚蠢。
One moment of stupidity broke the vase. 一時的愚蠢打破了花瓶。
These sturdy boots handle wet trails well. 這雙結實的靴子很適合走濕滑山路。
We bought a sturdy shelf for the heavy books. 我們買了一個堅固的架子來放重書。
He began to stutter when he was asked a very difficult question. 當被問到一個非常困難的問題時，他開始結巴（口吃）。
She managed to overcome her stutter through years of professional therapy. 她透過多年的專業治療成功克服了口吃。
She has a very elegant and sophisticated personal style. 她的個人風格非常優雅且精緻。
Which style of music do you prefer, classical or modern pop? 你比較喜歡哪種風格的音樂，古典還是現代流行？

meaning: 任何形式的裝飾或風格方法。
sentences: The car has modern styling. 這台車有現代感的造型。
She spent an hour on hair styling before the party. 派對前她花了一小時做髮型。
She looked very stylish in her long red silk dress and matching hat. 她穿著長紅絲綢禮服和配套的帽子，看起來非常時髦。
The hotel features modern and stylish rooms with a view of the city. 飯店的特色是能俯瞰城市的現代且優雅的房間。

meaning: 因卓越或風格個性而聞名的作家或演說家；文學風格的培養者，或文學風格的大師或批評家。
sentences: The stylist chose a simple jacket for the photo shoot. 造型師為拍攝挑了一件簡單外套。
She is a careful stylist in both clothing and writing. 她在服裝和寫作上都很講究風格。

meaning: 屬於或關於風格，尤其是語言或文學風格。
sentences: Something described as stylistic is of or pertaining to style, especially to linguistic or literary style. 被描述為文體的東西屬於或屬於風格，尤其是語言或文學風格。
The word stylistic is often used to describe a person, thing, or situation. 文體這個字常用來描述一個人、一件事或一種情況。

meaning: 由現有委員會組成的委員會，由部分成員組成。
sentences: The council formed a subcommittee on traffic safety. 議會成立了交通安全小組委員會。
The subcommittee will meet again next week. 小組委員會下週會再次開會。
A subconscious habit made her tap the table. 一個下意識的習慣讓她一直敲桌子。
The ad works on a subconscious level. 那則廣告在潛意識層面發揮作用。

meaning: 這樣的一塊已經分割了。
sentences: They bought a house in a new subdivision. 他們在新住宅區買了一棟房子。
The map shows each subdivision of the county. 地圖顯示郡內每個分區。
To subdue means to overcome, quieten, or bring under control. 征服意味著克服、平靜或控制。
People may subdue in different situations depending on the context. 人們可能會根據具體情況在不同情況下屈服。
The café used subdued lighting at night. 那家咖啡館晚上使用柔和的燈光。
He sounded subdued after the long argument. 長時間爭執後，他的語氣變得很低沉。
What is your favorite subject at school? Mine is history. 你在學校最喜歡的科目是什麼？我的是歷史。
The professor discussed the subject of artificial intelligence. 教授討論了關於人工智慧的主題。
Beauty is subjective, and what one person likes, another may not. 美是主觀的，一個人喜歡的東西，另一個人可能不喜歡。
The teacher's evaluation of the student's work was rather subjective. 老師對學生作品的評價相當主觀。
The peach tart tasted sublime with cold cream. 那個桃子塔配冰奶油吃起來美妙極了。
We stood still in the sublime mountain silence. 我們靜靜站在崇高壯闊的山中寂靜裡。
The submarine stayed under water for two days. 潛水艇在水下待了兩天。
Children toured a retired submarine at the harbor. 孩子們在港口參觀退役潛水艇。
The village was submerged by the heavy flooding. 村莊被大洪水淹沒了。
The submarine prepared to submerge into the deep ocean. 潛水艇準備潛入深海。
The old road stays submerged after heavy rain. 大雨過後，那條舊路一直淹在水下。
Divers found a submerged statue near the pier. 潛水員在碼頭附近發現一座沉在水中的雕像。
The phone survived brief submersion in clean water. 那支手機短暫泡在清水裡後還能使用。
Divers practiced submersion before the open-water test. 潛水員在開放水域測驗前先練習下潛。
The deadline for submission is Friday. 提交期限是星期五。
Her article submission was accepted by the magazine. 她投稿的文章被雜誌接受了。
The dog became submissive after training. 那隻狗訓練後變得順從。
She did not want to play a submissive role at work. 她不想在工作中扮演順從的角色。
Please submit your completed assignment to the teacher by Friday. 請在週五前將完成的作業提交給老師。
They were eventually forced to submit to the demands of the enemy army. 他們最終被迫屈服於敵軍的要求。
Please send the documents to the suboffice. 請把文件送到分辦事處。
The company opened a small suboffice in Taichung. 公司在台中開了一間小型分辦事處。
The manager's primary role is to coordinate the work of his subordinates. 經理的主要職責是協調下屬（部下）的工作。
Personal interests should be subordinate to the goals of the organization. 個人利益應從屬於組織的目標。
The sentence begins with a subordinate clause. 這個句子以從屬子句開頭。
Students practiced adding a subordinate clause to each sentence. 學生練習在每個句子中加入從屬子句。

meaning: 強迫或召喚（某人或某物）；要求。
sentences: To subpoena means to compel or summon (someone or something); to demand. 傳票是指強迫或傳喚（某人或某物）；要求。
People may subpoena in different situations depending on the context. 人們可能會根據具體情況在不同情況下發出傳票。
You can subscribe to the monthly magazine through the official website. 您可以透過官方網站訂閱這本月刊。
The billionaire decided to subscribe a large sum of money to the charity. 這位億萬富翁決定向該慈善機構認捐一大筆錢。

meaning: 訂閱出版品或服務的人。
sentences: Each subscriber receives a weekly newsletter. 每位訂閱者都會收到每週電子報。
The channel gained a new subscriber today. 這個頻道今天多了一位訂閱者。
He decided to cancel his annual subscription to the national newspaper. 他決定取消他在國家報紙的年度訂閱。
The monthly subscription for the streaming service is about ten dollars. 影音串流服務的月度會費（訂閱費）約為十美元。
Read the safety subsection before using the machine. 使用機器前先閱讀安全小節。
The rule is explained in subsection three. 這條規則在第三小節中說明。
The news was featured in every subsequent edition of the national newspaper. 這則消息刊登在隨後出版的每一份國家報紙上。
Her subsequent behavior suggested that she had changed her mind. 她隨後的行為表明她已經改變了主意。

meaning: 在任何時間或地點之後、之後。
sentences: If someone acts subsequently, they do so in a way that is following, afterwards in either time or place. 如果某人隨後採取行動，那麼他們會在隨後的時間或地點以隨後的方式這樣做。
The speaker responded subsequently during the discussion. 發言人隨後在討論中作出回應。

meaning: 集合 A，其中 A 的每個元素也是 S 的元素。
sentences: Children are a subset of the larger group. 兒童是較大群體中的一個子集合。
The report studies a small subset of customers. 報告研究了一小部分顧客。

meaning: 陷入平靜的狀態；再次平靜；安定下來；變得平靜。
sentences: The tumults of war will subside. 戰爭的喧囂將會平息。
The fever has subsided. 發燒已經退了。
The bank owns a small subsidiary in Japan. 這家銀行在日本有一家小型子公司。
The subsidiary reports its results every quarter. 子公司每季回報業績。
The accountant checked the subsidiary ledger. 會計檢查了分戶帳。
Each customer account appears in the subsidiary ledger. 每個客戶帳戶都列在分戶帳中。
The government decided to subsidize the development of renewable energy. 政府決定資助（補助）再生能源的開發。
The cost of the training course is partially subsidized by the company. 培訓課程的費用由公司部分資助。
The city offers a subsidy for electric scooters. 市政府提供購買電動機車的補助金。
Without the rent subsidy, he could not keep the shop open. 沒有房租津貼，他就無法繼續開店。

meaning: 將自己維持在最低水準的行為。
sentences: The family lived at a subsistence level. 那個家庭只維持最低生活水準。
Subsistence farming provides food for the household. 自給農業為家庭提供食物。
Water is a vital substance that is essential for all life. 水是所有生命必不可少的重要物質。
The researchers identified a mysterious substance in the soil. 研究人員在土壤中鑑定出了一種神秘物質。
The hotel gave us a refund for the substandard room. 那間飯店因房間品質太差而退費給我們。
Cheap substandard wiring can start a fire. 廉價的不合格電線可能引發火災。
The company's profits have shown a substantial increase over the past year. 公司利潤在過去一年中展現了大幅度（大量的）增長。
The report provides substantial evidence to support the new scientific theory. 報告提供了充分的（實質的）證據支持這項新科學理論。

meaning: 透過提供證據來驗證某事；來驗證或證實。
sentences: The lawyer was asked to substantiate her claims. 律師被要求證實她的說法。
He could not substantiate the rumors with evidence. 他無法用證據證實這些謠言。
We had a substantive talk about childcare costs. 我們針對托育費用做了實質討論。
Her draft needs one more substantive change. 她的草稿還需要一項重要的修改。
You can substitute honey for sugar in many different types of recipes. 在許多不同類型的食譜中，你可以用蜂蜜代替糖。
The team had to find a substitute for their star player, who was injured. 該隊不得不為受傷的明星球員尋找一名替補（替代者）。

meaning: 替換行為或被替換狀態。
sentences: The coach made a substitution after halftime. 教練在中場後換人。
Use milk as a substitution for cream. 可以用牛奶代替奶油。

meaning: 外殼底部邊緣內襯的物質。
sentences: The substrate of an aquarium can affect the water's acidity. 水族箱的基質會影響水的酸性。
Stream substrate affects fish longevity. 溪流基質影響魚類壽命。

meaning: 位於表面層之下的東西。
sentences: The road crew found subsurface water under the pavement. 道路工人在路面下發現地下水。
Subsurface pipes carry water to the field. 地下管線把水送到田裡。
The city has a subterranean shopping street. 這座城市有一條地下商店街。
Subterranean roots spread under the garden. 地下根系在花園下方延伸。

meaning: 文本（通常是文學文本、演講或對話）的隱含意義。
sentences: There was anger in the subtext of her polite reply. 她禮貌回覆的言外之意帶著怒氣。
The film has a clear political subtext. 這部電影有明顯的政治潛台詞。

meaning: 標題下方或之後的標題。
sentences: Turn on the subtitle if the sound is unclear. 聲音不清楚時請開啟字幕。
The book has a long subtitle under the main title. 這本書主標題下有一個很長的副標題。
There is a subtle difference in flavor between these two types of tea. 這兩種茶在風味上有著微妙的差別。
She has a subtle sense of humor that is not always easy to understand. 她有一種微妙（纖細）的幽默感，並不總是那麼容易理解。

meaning: 以不明顯或不直接的巧妙方式完成的品質；深思熟慮的品質。
sentences: He missed the subtlety of her joke. 他沒有聽出她笑話中的微妙之處。
The sauce has a subtlety that makes it special. 這醬汁有一種微妙層次，讓它很特別。

meaning: 以微妙的方式，以微妙的方式；用聰明而不是蠻力。
sentences: If someone acts subtly, they do so in a way that is with subtleness, in a subtle manner; with cleverness rather than brute force. 如果一個人的行為是微妙的，那麼他會以微妙的方式、以微妙的方式這樣做。用聰明而不是蠻力。
The speaker responded subtly during the discussion. 演講者在討論中巧妙地做出了回應。
In basic mathematics, you need to learn how to subtract numbers. 在基礎數學中，妳需要學習如何減去數字。
If you subtract five from ten, you get three as the result. 如果妳從十中減去五，結果得到五（誤，應為五）。
Children learned subtraction with blocks. 孩子們用積木學減法。
Check your subtraction before handing in the worksheet. 交學習單前請檢查減法。

meaning: 更大、更一般的群體中的一組特定事物。
sentences: This subtype of the virus spreads quickly. 這種病毒亞型傳播很快。
The form lets you choose a subtype of account. 表格讓你選擇帳戶子類型。
The textbook divides the chapter into each subunit. 教科書把章節分成各個小單元。
A protein can contain more than one subunit. 蛋白質可以包含一個以上的次單元。
They live in a quiet and friendly neighborhood in the city suburb. 他們住在市郊一個安靜友好的社區。
The commute from the suburb to the city center takes an hour. 從郊區通勤到市中心需要一小時。
They moved to a quiet suburban neighborhood to raise their children. 他們搬到了一個安靜的郊區社區來撫養孩子。
The city's suburban areas have expanded significantly over the past decade. 該市的郊區在過去十年中顯著擴大。

meaning: 顛覆行為；傾覆；從下方翻轉。
sentences: The general was accused of subversion. 那名將軍被控顛覆。
The novel uses humor as a form of subversion. 這本小說用幽默作為顛覆形式。
The play hid a subversive joke in a love scene. 那齣戲在愛情場景裡藏了一個顛覆性的笑點。
Teachers removed the subversive pamphlet from the hall. 老師把那份帶有顛覆意味的小冊子從走廊拿走了。
I take the subway to work every morning. 我每天早上搭地鐵上班。
The subway entrance is next to the bookstore. 地鐵入口在書店旁邊。
When I travel, subway/underground/metro signs help me find the trains fast. 我旅行時，這三種標示都能幫我很快找到地鐵。
"subway/underground/metro" all point to city rail systems in different places. 這三個詞在不同地方都指城市軌道交通。
If you work hard and never give up, you will eventually succeed. 如果妳努力工作且永不放棄，妳最終會成功。
He managed to succeed in his career through pure dedication. 他憑藉著純粹的奉獻精神在事業上取得了成功。
She succeeded after years of practice. 她練習多年後成功了。
The son succeeded his father as manager. 兒子接替父親成為經理。
The key to success is perseverance and a positive attitude. 成功的關鍵在於毅力與積極的態度。
The company celebrated the success of its new global project. 公司慶祝了其新全球專案的成功。
The key to a successful career is hard work and dedication. 成功事業的關鍵在於努力和奉獻。
The launch of the new product was a highly successful event. 新產品的發佈是一次非常成功的活動。
She successfully fixed the loose button before work. 她上班前成功把鬆掉的鈕扣縫好了。
The team successfully moved the sofa upstairs. 那組人成功把沙發搬上樓。
"successfully amy" looked like a typo in the worksheet. 講義上的這個詞看起來像誤植。
I left "successfully amy" marked for later review. 我把這個疑似錯字先標記起來，之後再查。
The team won five matches in quick succession and secured the title. 該隊接連（連續）贏得五場比賽，保住了冠軍。
The book explores the complex rules of succession in the royal family. 這本書探討了皇室內部複雜的繼承規則。
The region experienced ten successive days of rain earlier this month. 該地區本月早些時候經歷了接連（連續）十天的降雨。
He won the national competition for three successive years in high school. 他連續三年在高中贏得了全國比賽。

meaning: 以連續或相繼的方式；一個接著一個。
sentences: If someone acts successively, they do so in a way that is in a serial or successive manner; one following another. 如果某人連續行動，則他們以連續或相繼的方式這樣做；一個接一個。
The speaker responded successively during the discussion. 發言者在討論中先後作出回應。
The company is looking for a suitable successor to the retiring CEO. 公司正在為即將退休的執行長尋找合適的繼任者（接班人）。
The new model is a more powerful and efficient successor to the old one. 新型號是舊型號功能更強、效率更高的後續產品（替代品）。
Keep your email succinct so the client reads it. 把郵件寫得簡潔一些，客戶才會看完。
His answer was succinct but complete. 他的回答簡潔但完整。
It was such a beautiful day that we decided to go for a picnic. 那天真是個美好的日子，我們決定去野餐。
I have never heard such an amazing and moving story before. 我從未聽過如此精彩且感人的故事。
The little boy enjoyed managed to suck on a colorful lollipop. 小男孩竟然（很享受地）吮吸著一支繽紛的棒棒糖。
The vacuum cleaner acts to suck up all the dust from the carpet. 吸塵器的作用是吸走地毯上所有的灰塵。

meaning: 容易上當的人；特別迷某物的人
sentences: I am a sucker for warm cinnamon rolls. 我對熱騰騰的肉桂捲完全沒有抵抗力。
That scam targets any sucker who wants easy money. 那種騙局專門鎖定想輕鬆賺錢的易受騙者。
The newborn calf began to suckle. 新生小牛開始吸奶。
The mother cat let her kittens suckle quietly. 母貓讓小貓安靜地吃奶。
The farm kept the suckling beside its mother. 農場把那隻吃奶的小獸留在母獸身邊。
A suckling pig turned slowly over the fire. 一隻乳豬在火上慢慢翻烤。
The suction cup fell off the bathroom wall. 吸盤從浴室牆上掉了下來。
Strong suction helps this vacuum pick up sand. 強大的吸力讓這台吸塵器能吸起沙子。
The sudden news of his resignation was a big shock to everyone. 他突然辭職的消息對每個人來說都是個巨大的震驚。
The weather changed with a sudden rain shower this afternoon. 天氣隨著今天下午突如其來的一場陣雨而改變了。
The lights suddenly went out at dinner. 吃晚飯時燈突然熄了。
I suddenly remembered the keys on the bus. 我突然想起鑰匙忘在公車上。
They plan to sue the company for damages. 他們計畫控告公司求償。
You can sue if the contract is broken. 如果合約被違反，你可以提告。
I brushed the suede shoes after the rain. 下雨後我刷了那雙麂皮鞋。
This brown suede jacket feels soft. 這件棕色麂皮外套摸起來很柔軟。
Millions of people around the world still suffer from hunger. 全球仍有數百萬人遭受飢餓之苦。
She has been suffering from a severe headache all afternoon. 她一整下午都深受嚴重頭痛之苦。
He suffered a knee injury during the game. 他在比賽中膝蓋受傷。
The town suffered from heavy flooding. 小鎮遭受嚴重水災。
The medicine reduced her suffering. 藥物減輕了她的痛苦。
War caused great suffering for many families. 戰爭讓許多家庭承受巨大苦難。

meaning: 足夠或足夠；滿足（任何事物）的需要；足夠；足夠好。
sentences: For this plum cake, two eggs should suffice. 對於這個梅子蛋糕，兩個雞蛋就足夠了。
To suffice means to be enough or sufficient; to meet the need (of anything); to be adequate; to be good enough. 足夠意味著足夠或充分；滿足（任何事物）的需要；足夠；足夠好。
The company has sufficient resources to complete the project. 公司擁有充足的資源來完成專案。
Please ensure that you have sufficient time to finish the test. 請確保妳有充足的時間完成考試。
Once we had eaten and drunk sufficiently, we padded off to sleep. 吃飽喝足後，我們就睡了。
If someone acts sufficiently, they do so in a way that is in a sufficient manner; enough. 如果一個人的行為夠充分，那麼他們就會以足夠的方式這樣做；足夠的。
Add the suffix to change the word into an adjective. 加上字尾可以把名詞變成形容詞。
The teacher circled the suffix in each example. 老師圈出每個例子中的後綴。
The smoke can suffocate a small bird quickly. 濃煙很快就會讓小鳥窒息。
That tight scarf seemed to suffocate him in the heat. 那條太緊的圍巾在悶熱中幾乎讓他喘不過氣。

meaning: 因窒息而導致死亡或殺害的特定行為。
sentences: The smoke created a risk of suffocation. 濃煙造成窒息風險。
Keep plastic bags away from babies to prevent suffocation. 請讓塑膠袋遠離嬰兒以防窒息。

meaning: 投票、表达意见或参与决策的权利或机会，尤其是在民主选举中。
sentences: Women fought for suffrage for many years. 女性為選舉權奮鬥了多年。
Universal suffrage is an important democratic principle. 普選權是重要的民主原則。
I take one spoon of sugar in tea. 我喝茶會加一匙糖。
This recipe needs less sugar than the box says. 這份食譜需要的糖比盒子上寫的少。
She dropped a sugar lump into her tea. 她把一顆方糖放進茶裡。
The child asked for one more sugar lump. 孩子又要了一顆方糖。
The drink was too sugary for me. 這杯飲料對我來說太甜。
Sugary snacks can hurt your teeth. 含糖零食可能傷害牙齒。
Could you please suggest a good Italian restaurant nearby? 您能建議附近一家優質的義大利餐廳嗎？
I suggest that you should study hard for the final math exam. 我建議你應該為期末數學考試努力唸書。
She suggested a cheaper restaurant. 她建議一家比較便宜的餐廳。
The doctor suggested more rest. 醫師建議多休息。
Your suggestion saved us time. 你的建議幫我們省了時間。
He made a helpful suggestion during the meeting. 他在會議中提出有幫助的建議。

meaning: 暗示浪漫、性等；有傷風化的。
sentences: She crossed her legs and shot him a suggestive smile. 她交叉著雙腿，對他露出一個暗示性的微笑。
Something described as suggestive is suggesting romance, sex, etc.; risqué. 被描述為暗示的事物是指暗示浪漫、性等；有傷風化。

meaning: 四 自殺的,自殺性的
sentences: The clinic offers help for suicidal patients. 診所為有自殺傾向的病人提供協助。
Call emergency services if someone feels suicidal. 如果有人有自殺念頭，請聯絡緊急服務。

meaning: 有自殺傾向地；以自殺方式地
sentences: The nurse called for help when the teen spoke suicidally. 那名青少年說出自殺傾向的話時，護理師立刻求助。
He was watched closely because he felt suicidally hopeless. 因為他感到絕望到有自殺傾向，所以大家密切看著他。
The school counselor spoke openly about suicide prevention. 學校輔導老師公開談論自殺預防。
His friends sought urgent help after he mentioned suicide. 他提到自殺後，朋友立刻尋求緊急協助。
He wore a professional dark blue suit for the job interview. 他穿了一套專業的深藍色西裝去面試。
The rainy weather didn't suit our plans for a backyard picnic. 下雨的天氣不適合我們在後院野餐的計畫。
We checked the suitability of the room for children. 我們確認這個房間是否適合孩子。
Her experience showed her suitability for the job. 她的經驗顯示她適合這份工作。
Is this movie suitable for young children to watch alone? 這部電影適合幼童獨自觀看嗎？
We are looking for a suitable location for our new office. 我們正在為我們的新辦公室尋找一個合適的地點。
He packed all his clothes and books into a large leather suitcase. 他把所有的衣服和書都裝進了一個大皮革手提箱。
Please make sure you lock your suitcase securely before traveling. 旅行前請確保鎖好你的手提箱。
The couple stayed in a luxury honeymoon suite at the seaside resort. 這對夫婦住在海濱渡假勝地的一間豪華蜜月套房裡。
The new office software suite includes various tools for data analysis. 新的辦公軟體套裝包含了各種數據分析工具。
He will sulk for hours if you hide the game pad. 如果你把遊戲手把藏起來，他會鬧彆扭好幾個小時。
Do not sulk just because the cake burned. 不要只是因為蛋糕烤焦就一直生悶氣。
She sulkily pushed peas around her plate. 她悶悶不樂地把盤子裡的豌豆撥來撥去。
He sulkily walked home after losing the match. 輸掉比賽後，他悶著氣走回家。
The sulky child refused to answer. 那個悶悶不樂的孩子拒絕回答。
He became sulky after losing the game. 他輸掉比賽後變得悶悶不樂。

meaning: 四 面有慢色的，关内不乐的
sentences: A sullen silence filled the car. 車裡充滿陰鬱的沉默。
She gave him a sullen look. 她給了他一個悶悶不樂的眼神。
He did not wish to sully his hands with gardening. 他不想讓園藝玷汙自己的雙手。
To sully means to soil or stain; to dirty. 玷污意味著弄髒或弄髒；骯髒。

meaning: 世俗職位的持有者，表面上隸屬於哈里發，但實際上擁有王位背後的權力。
sentences: The sultan welcomed guests at the palace. 蘇丹在宮殿接待客人。
The story is set in the court of a sultan. 故事背景是一位蘇丹的宮廷。
The total sum of the expenses was more than we had expected. 花費的總額比我們預想的要多。
To sum up, we need to focus more on environmental protection. 總而言之，我們需要更多關注環境保護。
They were fired summarily at a single plant-wide meeting. 他們在一次全廠會議上被立即解僱。
The team responded summarily to the change. 團隊對這項變化做出了簡短的回應。
At the end of the meeting, the manager asked her to summarize the main points of the discussion. 會議結束時，經理要求她總結（概述）討論的要點。
Could you please summarize the story in just a few sentences? 你能用幾句話概括（總結）一下這個故事嗎？
The manager gave a brief summary of the project's achievements. 經理對專案的成就做了一個簡短的摘要。
Please provide a one-page summary of the main points of book. 請提供這本書主要觀點的一頁摘要。
The lawyer gave a clear summation at the end. 律師最後做了清楚總結。
The report includes a brief summation of the data. 報告包含資料的簡短概括。
We go swimming every summer. 我們每年夏天都去游泳。
Summer is too hot for long walks at noon. 夏天中午太熱，不適合長時間散步。
Children play outside more in summertime. 夏季時孩子們更常在戶外玩。
Summertime in Taipei can be very humid. 台北的夏季可能非常潮濕。
The hikers finally reached the summit of the high mountain. 登山者終於到達了高山的山頂。
The two leaders met at a summit to discuss international trade. 兩位領導人在高峰會上會面，討論國際貿易。
The king decided to summon all his advisors to discuss the crisis. 國王決定召集（召喚）所有顧問討論這場危機。
He managed to summon his courage and tell the truth to his parents. 他設法振作起勇氣，向父母說出了真相。
They served a sumptuous dinner. 他們端出一頓豪華晚餐。
The hotel lobby looked sumptuous. 飯店大廳看起來富麗堂皇。
The wedding hall was sumptuously decorated with gold lights. 婚宴廳用金色燈飾布置得十分華麗。
They dined sumptuously on lobster and fresh fruit. 他們奢華地享用龍蝦和新鮮水果。
The suite's sumptuousness surprised us at check-in. 我們辦理入住時，套房的奢華讓人吃驚。
Even the old theater still shows some sumptuousness. 就連那座老劇院也還看得出幾分華麗。
The sun was shining brightly in the clear blue sky. 陽光在晴朗的藍天中燦爛地照耀著。
The Earth revolves around the sun once every 365 days. 地球每 365 天繞太陽公轉一圈。
He got a sunburn after sleeping on the beach. 他在海灘睡著後曬傷了。
Use sunscreen to avoid sunburn. 使用防曬乳避免曬傷。
His shoulders were sunburned after the beach trip. 海邊旅行後，他的肩膀曬傷了。
Put lotion on sunburned skin. 在曬傷的皮膚上擦乳液。
We visit my grandparents every Sunday. 我們每個星期日去看祖父母。
The shop is closed on Sunday mornings. 這家店星期日早上不營業。
We must leave before sundown. 我們必須在日落前離開。
The sky turned orange at sundown. 日落時天空變成橘色。
She bought sundry items at the market. 她在市場買了各種雜貨。
The drawer is full of sundry cables and keys. 抽屜裡滿是各式線材和鑰匙。
A tall sunflower grew beside the fence. 籬笆旁長了一株高高的向日葵。
She painted a bright sunflower on the card. 她在卡片上畫了一朵明亮的向日葵。
She sprinkled sunflower seed on the salad. 她把葵花子撒在沙拉上。
Birds gathered around the sunflower seed feeder. 鳥兒聚集在葵花子餵食器旁。
The song was sung by a children's choir. 這首歌由兒童合唱團演唱。
She had sung the same tune many times. 她已經唱過同一首曲子很多次。
Wear a sunhat at the beach. 在海邊要戴遮陽帽。
Her wide sunhat protected her face. 她的寬邊遮陽帽保護了臉。

meaning: 四 沉没的，沉入水底的
sentences: Divers explored the sunken ship. 潛水員探索那艘沉船。
His cheeks looked sunken after the illness. 生病後，他的臉頰看起來凹陷。

meaning: 太陽發出的所有電磁輻射；尤其是在可見光譜中並且沐浴在地球上的。
sentences: Sunlight filled the kitchen in the morning. 早晨陽光灑滿廚房。
Plants need sunlight to grow well. 植物需要陽光才能長得好。
It's a beautiful sunny day; let's go for a walk in the park. 今天天氣晴朗，我們去公園散步吧。
The forecast says it will be sunny and warm all weekend. 預報說整個週末都會是晴朗溫暖的天氣。

meaning: 一天中太陽出現在東部地平線上方的時間。
sentences: We woke up early to watch the sunrise. 我們早起看日出。
The beach was quiet at sunrise. 日出時海灘很安靜。
She opened the sunroof to let in fresh air. 她打開汽車天窗讓新鮮空氣進來。
Rain leaked through the old sunroof. 雨水從舊天窗漏了進來。

meaning: 人或物生命的最後階段。
sentences: They walked along the river at sunset. 他們在日落時沿河散步。
The sunset painted the sky pink. 夕陽把天空染成粉紅色。

meaning: 陽光的直射光、光或溫暖。
sentences: The room was warm with afternoon sunshine. 房間因午後陽光而溫暖。
Her smile brought sunshine to the office. 她的笑容讓辦公室變得明亮愉快。
He took a sup of soup and smiled. 他喝了一小口湯就笑了。
Just a sup of tea is enough for me. 我只要一小口茶就夠了。
The director asked a supe to cross the street scene. 導演請一位臨時演員走過街景鏡頭。
One supe waited by the bus stop for the next take. 一位臨時演員在公車站旁等下一次拍攝。
The service at this five-star hotel was absolutely super. 這家五星級飯店的服務簡直太棒了。
That's a super idea! I think everyone will love it. 真是個極佳的主意！我想每個人都會喜歡。
The delay felt huge, but it was superable. 那個延誤看似很大，但其實可以克服。
With two more hands, this problem is superable. 再多兩個人手，這個問題就能解決。
The actors gave a superb performance that moved the entire audience. 演員們進行了卓越的（極好的）表演，感動了全場觀眾。
The hotel offers superb facilities and service to all its guests. 該飯店為所有客人提供卓越的設施和服務。

meaning: 非常好，做到了最好的程度，令人欽佩。
sentences: The team responded superbly to the change. 團隊對這項變化做出了極好的反應。
She handled the problem superbly during the meeting. 她在會議期間出色地處理了這個問題。
He only has a superficial knowledge of the subject and needs to study more. 他對這門學科僅有膚淺的了解，需要進一步學習。
The injury was relatively superficial and did not require any surgery. 傷勢相對較輕（表面的），不需要進行手術。
The architect measured the superficies of the wall. 建築師測量牆面的表面積。
Dust covered the superficies of the old table. 灰塵覆蓋了舊桌子的表面。
A fourth chair is superfluous in this tiny room. 這麼小的房間裡第四把椅子很多餘。
Most of the extra commas were superfluous. 大部分多出的逗號都沒有必要。

meaning: 現實世界中特別著名的英雄，或擁有看似不可能的能力的人。
sentences: The power is out but you're watching TV? You must be a superhero. 停電了，你還在看電視嗎？你一定是超級英雄。
Thanks for driving out here and towing me out of the ditch. You're a superhero! 謝謝你開車來這裡，把我從溝裡拖出來。你是超級英雄！
The map had superimposed lines for bus routes. 那張地圖上疊加了公車路線。
Her face appeared superimposed over the city lights. 她的臉像是疊映在城市燈光上。
He was hired to superintend the building project. 他受聘監督這項建築工程。
A senior nurse will superintend the night shift. 一位資深護理師會管理夜班。
The bridge repair stayed on schedule under careful superintendence. 橋梁維修在細心監督下照進度進行。
Good superintendence kept the warehouse safe. 良好的管理讓倉庫維持安全。
The superintendent of the school board announced several major changes. 學校董事會的負責人（監督人）宣佈了幾項重大變動。
He was appointed as the superintendent of the local police force. 他被任命為當地警隊的負責人（警長）。
The quality of the new model is far superior to the old one. 新型號的品質遠遠優於（優越於）舊款。
He felt superior to his colleagues due to his great success. 由於他的巨大成功，他覺得自己比同事們優越。
The team demonstrated their technical superiority during the entire match. 該隊在整個比賽中展現了技術上的優勢（優越性）。
His sense of superiority made it difficult for him to work with others. 他的優越感（傲慢）使他很難與他人共事。

meaning: 具有非凡或看似超人力量的人。
sentences: The child pretended to be a superman. 那個孩子假裝自己是超人。
The coach called him a superman after the long race. 長跑後，教練稱他像超人一樣。
I need to go to the supermarket to buy some fresh groceries. 我需要去超市買些新鮮雜貨。
The local supermarket is open 24 hours a day for convenience. 當地超市 24 小時營業，非常方便。

meaning: 不尋常；不自然；被尚未完全理解的力量所改變（如果有的話）。
sentences: The house is haunted by supernatural forces. 這棟房子被超自然力量所困擾。
Something described as supernatural is not of the usual; not natural; altered by forces that are not understood fully, if at all. 被描述為超自然的事物並不常見；不自然；被尚未完全理解的力量所改變（如果有的話）。

meaning: 大質量恆星發生強烈而明亮的爆炸，隨後成為中子星或黑洞，或被摧毀。
sentences: A supernova can shine brighter than a whole galaxy. 超新星可能比整個星系還亮。
Astronomers observed a distant supernova. 天文學家觀測到一顆遙遠超新星。
A supersonic jet cracked the quiet sky. 一架超音速噴射機劃破了安靜的天空。
The lab tested a supersonic airflow model. 實驗室測試了一個超音速氣流模型。
The belief that breaking a mirror brings seven years of bad luck is a common superstition. 相信打破鏡子會帶來七年霉運是一個常見的迷信。
Some people still follow ancient superstitions to protect themselves from evil spirits. 有些人仍然遵循古代的迷信來保護自己免受邪靈侵害。
Many people are still superstitious and follow traditional ancient customs. 許多人依然很迷信，遵循著傳統的古代習俗。
She is very superstitious and never walks under a ladder if she can avoid it. 她非常迷信，儘量避免從梯子下面走過。
The manager was hired to supervise the daily activities of the factory workers. 經理受僱負責監督工廠工人的日常活動。
Teachers must carefully supervise students during the practical science experiments. 老師必須在實踐科學實驗期間仔細指導（監督）學生。
The children were playing in the park under the close supervision of their parents. 孩子們在父母的嚴密監督下在公園玩耍。
The project requires constant supervision to ensure that everything is on track. 該專案需要持續的管理（監督），以確保一切按計畫進行。
If you have any problems at work, you should discuss them with your supervisor. 如果你在工作中有任何問題，應該與你的主管討論。
The supervisor was impressed by her dedication and high-quality work. 主管對她的奉獻精神和高品質的工作印象深刻。
She moved into a supervisory role last year. 她去年轉任管理職。
The new worker needs supervisory support for a few weeks. 新員工需要幾週的監督協助。
What are we having for supper tonight? I'm feeling very hungry. 我們今晚晚餐吃什麼？我感到非常餓。
My family usually has a light supper around 7:00 p.m. 我們家通常在晚上七點左右吃一頓簡單的晚餐。
He decided to supplement his income by taking a temporary weekend job. 他決定透過找一份週末臨時工作來增加（補充）收入。
The magazine features a weekly supplement on travel and food. 該雜誌設有每週一次關於旅遊和美食的增刊（補充物）。

meaning: 缺乏固定的時間表（如補充航空公司）。
sentences: Something described as supplemental is lacking a regular schedule (as in a supplemental airline). 所謂補充的航班是指缺乏定期的航班時刻表（如補充航空公司）。
The word supplemental is often used to describe a person, thing, or situation. 補充這個字通常用來描述人、事物或情況。
The teacher gave us supplementary reading. 老師給了我們補充閱讀資料。
Supplementary information is listed at the end of the report. 補充資訊列在報告最後。
A supplementary angle makes the total one hundred eighty degrees. 補角會讓總和成為一百八十度。
The worksheet asks students to find each supplementary angle. 學習單要求學生找出每個補角。
The bakery changed its flour supplier. 麵包店更換了麵粉供應商。
A reliable supplier delivers parts on time. 可靠的供應商會準時送零件。
The company is facing problems with its global supply chain. 公司正面臨全球供應鏈的問題。
The school provides a steady supply of fresh fruit for the kids. 學校為孩子們提供穩定的新鮮水果供應。
I really appreciate all the support you've given me lately. 我非常感激妳最近給我的一切支持。
The bridge is supported by several large and sturdy stone pillars. 這座橋由幾根巨大且結實的石柱支撐著。
She is a strong supporter of public libraries. 她是公共圖書館的堅定支持者。
Supporters waited outside the stadium. 支持者在體育場外等候。
I had a very supportive coach who helped me. 我有一位非常支持我的教練，他幫助了我。
Something described as supportive is providing support. 所謂支持性的東西就是提供支持。
I suppose that we will reach our destination in an hour. 我想我們大約在一小時後會到達目的地。
You are not supposed to talk during the performance at the theater. 在劇院演出期間，你是不應該說話的。
The meeting was supposed to start at nine. 會議原本應該九點開始。
He is the supposed owner of the empty house. 他被認為是那棟空屋的屋主。
The new medicine is supposedly more effective than the older version. 據說（大概）這種新藥比舊版本更有效。
He was supposedly traveling in Europe last month, but nobody saw him. 據說他上個月在歐洲旅行，但沒人見到他。
The government decided to use the army to suppress the violent protest. 政府決定動用軍隊鎮壓暴力抗議。
She tried to suppress a smile when she saw his ridiculous new hat. 當她看到他那頂滑稽的新帽子時，試圖抑制住笑意。
The suppression of free speech worried many citizens. 言論自由受到壓制讓許多市民擔心。
The medicine helps with cough suppression. 這種藥有助於抑制咳嗽。
The wound began to suppurate after several days. 幾天後，傷口開始化膿。
See a doctor if the cut starts to suppurate. 如果傷口開始化膿，請去看醫師。
The nurse checked the wound for suppuration. 護士檢查傷口是否化膿。
Suppuration may mean the cut is infected. 化膿可能表示傷口感染。
The final match decided local soccer supremacy. 最後一場比賽決定了地方足球霸主地位。
The war was fought for naval supremacy. 那場戰爭是為了爭奪海上優勢。
The Supreme Court is the highest legal authority in the country. 最高法院是該國最高的法律權威。
Victory in the final match required a supreme effort from every team member. 決賽的勝利需要每位隊員付出最大的努力。

meaning: 達到最大、最高或最高程度。
sentences: They were supremely confident at the beginning of the season. 他們在賽季初表現得異常自信。
The team responded supremely to the change. 團隊對此變化反應強烈。
The airline added a baggage surcharge at check-in. 航空公司在報到時加收了行李附加費。
We paid a weekend surcharge for late delivery. 我們為週末晚間配送多付了附加費。
Are you sure that you locked the front door? 你確定你鎖了大門嗎？
I'm not sure if I can attend the meeting tomorrow. 我不確定明天是否能參加會議。
You surely saw the red sign by the gate. 你一定看到了大門旁邊那個紅色標誌。
This train will surely be late in the storm. 這班車在暴風雨中想必會誤點。
"sures" appeared alone in the margin of the scan. 掃描頁面的邊緣只出現了這個疑似誤植的詞。
I left "sures" blank because the source looked corrupted. 因為原始內容像是壞掉了，所以我先把這個詞留白。
His uncle acted as surety for the loan. 他的叔叔為貸款擔任保證人。
The court required surety before releasing him. 法院要求擔保後才釋放他。
He loves to go to the beach and surf during the summer vacation. 他喜愛在暑假去海邊衝浪。
You can find a lot of useful information while surfing the internet. 在網上衝浪時，你可以找到很多有用的資訊。
The surface of the ocean was perfectly smooth and calm today. 海面今天非常平滑且平靜。
There is a small scratch on the surface of your computer screen. 妳的電腦螢幕表面有一個小刮痕。
A cube has six faces that add to its surface area. 立方體有六個面，合起來就是表面積。
The larger surface area helps the towel dry faster. 較大的表面積讓毛巾乾得更快。
The diver signaled before surfacing near the boat. 潛水員在船邊浮出水面前先打了手勢。
Quick surfacing can hurt your ears. 太快浮出水面會傷到耳朵。
He waxed his surfboard before sunrise. 他在日出前替衝浪板上蠟。
A cracked surfboard can snap in heavy waves. 裂開的衝浪板在大浪裡可能會斷掉。
The surfer waited for a bigger wave. 衝浪者等待更大的浪。
A local surfer taught us how to stand on the board. 一位當地衝浪者教我們如何站上板子。
A surge of cold air rushed through the door. 一陣冷空氣從門口灌了進來。
The shop saw a surge in umbrella sales. 那家店的雨傘銷量突然大增。
The skilled surgeon performed a complicated heart transplant surgery yesterday. 這位經驗豐富的外科醫生昨天進行了一場複雜的心臟移植手術。
He decided to become a surgeon because he wanted to help people through medical operations. 他決定成為一名外科醫生，因為他想透過醫療手術來幫助人們。
She needs to undergo knee surgery to repair the damaged ligaments. 她需要接受膝蓋手術來修復受損的韌帶。
The patient is currently in the recovery room after a successful surgery. 病人在成功的手術後目前正在恢復室。
The patient needed urgent surgical treatment following the serious accident. 病人在嚴重事故後需要緊急外科治療。
Modern surgical techniques are becoming increasingly sophisticated and accurate. 現代手術技術正變得越來越精密且準確。
Clean the small cut with surgical spirit. 用醫用酒精清潔小傷口。
The nurse opened a bottle of surgical spirit. 護士打開一瓶醫用酒精。

meaning: 與手術有關；透過手術的方式。
sentences: His cancer was treated surgically instead of with drugs or radiation. 他的癌症是透過手術治療的，而不是透過藥物或放射線治療。
The team responded surgically to the change. 該團隊對這一變化做出了外科手術般的反應。
Please write your first name and your surname clearly on the form. 請在表格上清晰地寫下你的名字和姓氏。
Smith is a very common surname in many English-speaking countries. 史密斯（Smith）在許多英語國家是一個非常普遍的姓氏。
The company's total revenue this year is expected to surpass the goal. 預計公司今年的總收入將超過目標。
The beauty of the mountain view far surpassed all our expectations. 山景之美遠遠超出了我們的預期（勝過預期）。

meaning: 超越某事物的行為或過程；一個更好的。
sentences: Her performance was of surpassing beauty. 她的表演美得出眾。
The team showed surpassing skill in the final. 團隊在決賽中展現出超群技巧。
The company has a large surplus of cash that it plans to invest in new projects. 公司有大量的剩餘現金，計畫投資於新專案。
The country experienced a significant budget surplus for the first time in years. 該國多年來首次出現了重大的預算盈餘（剩餘）。
We are planning a surprise birthday party for our mother. 我們正在為母親籌劃一個驚喜生日派對。
The sudden news of his resignation was a big surprise to everyone. 他突然辭職的消息讓每個人都感到非常驚訝。
She was surprised to see her childhood friend after so many years. 隔了這麼多年見到童年好友，她感到很驚訝。
I was surprised that the movie had such a sad ending. 我很驚訝這部電影竟然有個這麼悲傷的結局。
The ending was surprising but satisfying. 結局令人驚訝但很滿足。
It is surprising how quickly the puppy learned. 小狗學得這麼快，真令人驚訝。

meaning: 以一種令人驚訝的方式，因為它是出乎意料的或不尋常的。
sentences: The house was surprisingly small for such a numerous family. 對於如此眾多的家庭來說，房子小得出奇。
Not surprisingly, the electrician didn't come at the time he had said. 毫不奇怪，電工沒有照他說的時間來。
The enemy army was forced to surrender after being surrounded by our troops. 敵軍在被我軍包圍後被迫投降。
He refused to surrender his principles even when facing great pressure. 即使面臨巨大壓力，他仍拒絕放棄自己的原則。

meaning: 一種輕型馬車，座位朝前，可容納兩人或四人，在美國流行；類似設計的機動車廂。
sentences: They rode through the park in a surrey. 他們坐著四輪馬車穿過公園。
The old photo shows a family in a surrey. 舊照片裡是一家人坐在輕便馬車上。
Soy milk works as a surrogate for cream in this soup. 在這道湯裡，豆奶可以代替鮮奶油。
Her aunt acted as a surrogate parent after school. 放學後，她的阿姨充當代理家長。
The small village is surrounded by beautiful green mountains. 那個小村莊被美麗的綠山環繞著。
The parents did everything they could to surround child with love. 父母竭盡所能，讓愛圍繞在孩子身邊。
The hotel is located in beautiful surroundings, with mountains and lakes nearby. 這家飯店坐落在優美的環境中，附近有山有湖。
It took some time for the rescued animals to get used to their new surroundings. 被營救的動物花了一些時間才適應新環境。
The suspect was under constant surveillance by the local police force. 嫌疑人一直處於當地警方的嚴密監視之下。
Security surveillance cameras were installed throughout the city center. 市中心各處都安裝了保全監控攝影機。
The latest opinion survey shows that the policy is popular. 最新的民意調查顯示這項政策很受歡迎。
The researchers conducted a survey to gather consumer data. 研究人員進行了一項調查以蒐集消費者數據。
The bank sent a surveyor to inspect the house. 銀行派了一位勘測員去查看那間房子。
A surveyor marked the new property line with flags. 一位測量員用旗子標出了新的地界線。
The discovery of fire was crucial for the survival of early humans. 火的發現對於早期人類的生存至關重要。
The government is taking steps to ensure the survival of the forest. 政府正採取措施確保森林的生存。
Only a few people managed to survive the tragic plane crash. 只有少數人在那場悲劇性的空難中倖存。
It's difficult for plants to survive in such a harsh and dry climate. 植物在如此惡劣乾燥的氣候中很難存活。
He was the lone survivor of the tragic mountain accident. 他是那場悲劇性山難中的唯一倖存者。
The charity provides support and guidance to cancer survivors. 該慈善機構為癌症康復者提供支持與指導。
Susan left her umbrella by the sink. 蘇珊把雨傘留在洗手台旁。
I saved Susan as "Aunt Susan" on my phone. 我把蘇珊存成手機裡的「蘇珊阿姨」。

meaning: 可能會受到某些事情的影響。
sentences: He was susceptible to minor ailments. 他很容易患一些小病。
Something described as susceptible is likely to be affected by something. 被描述為易受影響的事物可能會受到某些事物的影響。
The police managed to arrest the primary suspect in the case. 警察設法逮捕了該案的主要嫌疑人。
I suspect that he is not telling us the entire truth about it. 我懷疑他沒有告訴我們關於這件事的全部真相。
The suspected leak was behind the washing machine. 疑似漏水點在洗衣機後面。
Police spoke to the suspected thief near the station. 警方在車站附近詢問那名涉嫌行竊的人。
The search for the missing plane was suspended due to the heavy storm. 由於強風暴，搜尋失蹤飛機的工作被暫停了。
The beautiful crystal chandelier was suspended from the ceiling of the ballroom. 精美的水晶吊燈懸掛在宴會廳的天花板上。
Grandpa wore suspenders with his old trousers. 爺爺穿舊長褲時配了吊帶。
The child pulled on his bright red suspenders. 孩子拉了拉自己的紅色吊帶。
The movie was filled with suspense and kept the audience engaged all night. 這部電影充滿了懸疑，整晚都吸引著觀眾。
We were kept in a state of suspense while waiting for the final results. 在等待最後結果期間，我們一直處於焦慮不安（懸疑）的狀態。
The worker was threatened with a temporary suspension from his job. 該員工面臨著被暫時停職的威脅。
The car's advanced suspension system ensures a very smooth and quiet ride. 汽車先進的懸吊系統確保了非常平穩且安靜的行駛。
The suspension bridge swayed in the wind. 吊橋在風中搖晃。
We crossed a suspension bridge over the valley. 我們走過橫跨山谷的吊橋。
The discovery of the missing keys managed to confirm my suspicion. 發現失蹤鑰匙竟然證實了我的懷疑。
His strange behavior manages to arouse a lot of suspicion lately. 他反常的行為最近激起了許多懷疑。
The police found a suspicious package left unattended at the train station. 警察在火車站發現了一個無人看管的可疑包裹。
She became suspicious when he started making frequent secret phone calls. 當他開始頻繁打秘密電話時，她產生了懷疑。

meaning: 某種程度上暗示著懷疑。
sentences: The police officer looked at her suspiciously. 警察疑惑地看著她。
The team responded suspiciously to the change. 團隊對這項變化做出了可疑的反應。
The company was able to sustain its growth despite the economic crisis. 儘管面臨經濟危機，公司仍能維持增長。
He sustained several serious injuries during the violent football match. 他在激烈的足球比賽中遭受了幾處重傷。
The organization promotes sustainable farming practices to protect the environment. 該組織推廣永續耕作方式以保護環境。
We need to find a more sustainable source of energy for our future needs. 我們需要為未來需求尋找一種更具永續性（可持續的）的能源。
Bread and eggs were their only sustenance on the trip. 麵包和雞蛋是他們旅途中唯一的糧食。
The garden gives summer sustenance to the whole family. 那座菜園在夏天供應全家的基本食物。
The doctor placed one suture near the cut. 醫師在傷口旁縫了一針。
The nurse checked whether the suture was clean. 護士檢查縫線是否乾淨。

meaning: 身材苗條的；線條優雅的
sentences: The dancer looked svelte in the black dress. 那位舞者穿黑裙顯得身形修長。
The new phone has a svelte design. 新手機設計得很輕薄優雅。
"swa're" was hard to read in the faded scan. 這個詞在褪色的掃描檔裡很難辨認。
I marked "swa're" as unclear in my notes. 我在筆記裡把這個疑似誤植的詞標成不清楚。
The nurse used a swab to clean the cut. 護理師用藥棉清潔傷口。
The lab took a swab from the patient's throat. 實驗室從病人喉嚨採取棉棒樣本。
The hikers crossed a low swag in the ridge. 健行者穿過山脊上的低凹處。
The conference bag was full of free swag. 研討會袋子裡裝滿免費贈品。
His new boots gave him a little swagger. 他的新靴子讓他走起路來多了幾分神氣。
The singer walked onstage with easy swagger. 那位歌手帶著從容的派頭走上舞台。
Please swallow the pill with plenty of water. 把藥丸配著足夠的水吞下去。
The baby can swallow soft rice now. 那個嬰兒現在已經能吞下軟飯了。

meaning: 印度教苦行僧或宗教導師。
sentences: The swami spoke quietly to the visitors. 那位印度教導師平靜地對訪客說話。
Many people came to hear the swami teach. 許多人前來聽那位宗教導師講道。
Be careful! An alligator was spotted in the swamp earlier this morning. 小心！今天清晨在沼澤地發現了一隻短吻鱷。
The small village was swamped by the sudden and destructive flood. 小村莊被突如其來的毀滅性洪水淹沒了。
The trail turns swampy after a week of rain. 下了一週雨後，那條小徑變得像沼澤一樣濕爛。
These boots are best for swampy ground. 這雙靴子最適合走泥濘潮濕的地面。
A pair of beautiful white swans was swimming in the pond. 一對美麗的白天鵝正在池塘裡游泳。
The story is about a lonely ugly duckling who turns into a swan. 這個故事是關於一隻變成天鵝的孤獨醜小鴨。
Would you like to swap seats so that you can sit next to your friend? 你想換個（交換）座位，以便坐在朋友旁邊嗎？
The two friends decided to swap books after they had finished reading them. 兩位朋友決定讀完書後互相交換。
A large swarm of bees was spotted in the garden near the apple tree. 花園裡的蘋果樹附近發現了一大群蜜蜂。
Thousands of fans swarmed around the famous celebrity at the airport. 數千名歌迷在機場蜂擁圍住了那位著名明星。

meaning: 像昆蟲一樣擊退；擊球、打擊或擊中。
sentences: He swatted the mosquito that was buzzing around in his bedroom. 他拍掉了臥室裡嗡嗡作響的蚊子。
The cat swatted at the feather. 貓拍打羽毛。
She taped a blue swatch to the paint chart. 她把一塊藍色色樣貼到油漆色卡上。
Bring a fabric swatch when you buy curtains. 買窗簾時帶一小塊布樣去比較。

meaning: 廣泛的範圍或範圍，例如土地或人口。
sentences: A large swath of the population is opposed to this government policy. 大量民眾反對政府的這項政策。
Five days after Hurricane Katrina, large swaths of New Orleans are still submerged in water. 卡崔娜颶風過去五天后，新奧爾良的大片地區仍然淹沒在水中。
The tall grass began to sway gently in the afternoon breeze. 高高的草開始在午後的微風中輕輕搖曳（搖擺）。
He tried to sway the jury's opinion with his emotional closing argument. 他試圖用感性的結案陳詞來影響（左右）陪審團的意見。
I swear that I will tell the entire truth and nothing else. 我發誓我會說出事實的全部，絕無虛言。
It is considered impolite to swear in public places or at home. 在公共場合或家裡說髒話（發誓）被認為是不禮貌的。
There were beads of sweat on his forehead after the workout. 激烈運動後，他的額頭上有汗珠。
He worked up a sweat while working in the hot summer garden. 他在夏天炎熱的花園裡忙活，出了一身汗。
She wore a sweatband during tennis practice. 她練網球時戴著吸汗帶。
The runner wiped his face with a sweatband. 跑者用防汗帶擦臉。
It's quite chilly today; you should wear a warm wool sweater. 今天挺冷的；妳應該穿件暖和的羊毛衣。
She knitted a beautiful blue sweater for her younger brother. 她為弟弟織了一件漂亮的藍色毛衣。
She had never met someone so sweaty. 她從來沒有見過一個人如此汗流浹背。
Something described as sweaty is having a tendency to sweat. 被描述為出汗的東西是指有出汗的傾向。
She roasted swede with carrots. 她把大頭菜和胡蘿蔔一起烤。
Swede tastes sweet after it is cooked. 大頭菜煮熟後帶有甜味。
Please sweep the porch before the guests arrive. 客人來之前先把門廊掃乾淨。
Tall waves can sweep toys off the beach. 大浪可能把玩具從沙灘上捲走。
The street sweeper cleaned the road at dawn. 清潔工在黎明時清掃道路。
A small sweeper moved through the parking lot. 一台小型清掃車穿過停車場。

meaning: 廣泛，廣泛，影響或觸及許多事物。
sentences: The government will bring in sweeping changes to the income tax system. 政府將對所得稅制度進行徹底改革。
He loves making sweeping statements without the slightest evidence. 他喜歡在沒有絲毫證據的情況下發表籠統的言論。
This orange is very sweet and juicy. 這顆橘子又甜又多汁。
She has a very sweet voice and loves to sing. 她有一副非常甜美的嗓音且熱愛唱歌。
We grilled sweet corn for dinner. 我們晚餐烤了甜玉米。
Sweet corn tastes best when it is fresh. 甜玉米新鮮時最好吃。
She baked a sweet potato for lunch. 她午餐烤了一條地瓜。
Sweet potato soup is popular in winter. 地瓜湯在冬天很受歡迎。
Do not believe his sweet talk too quickly. 不要太快相信他的甜言蜜語。
She used sweet talk to get a better price. 她用甜言蜜語談到更好的價格。
I ordered sweet-and-sour pork. 我點了糖醋豬肉。
The sauce has a sweet-and-sour taste. 這個醬有酸甜味。
He tried to sweet-talk his way out of trouble. 他試圖用甜言蜜語讓自己脫身。
Don't sweet-talk me if you cannot keep the promise. 如果你不能守承諾，就別用好話哄我。
Add honey to sweeten the tea. 加蜂蜜讓茶變甜。
The store offered a discount to sweeten the deal. 商店提供折扣讓交易更有吸引力。
This coffee has no artificial sweetener. 這杯咖啡沒有人工甜味劑。
She uses a little sweetener instead of sugar. 她用一點甜味劑代替糖。
He gave his sweetheart a small gift. 他送給愛人一份小禮物。
Thanks, sweetheart, for helping with dinner. 親愛的，謝謝你幫忙準備晚餐。
The child chose a red sweetie from the jar. 孩子從罐子裡選了一顆紅色糖果。
Come here, sweetie, and put on your shoes. 親愛的，過來把鞋穿上。
The drink had a sweetish smell. 這杯飲料有點甜甜的味道。
The sauce is sweetish, not spicy. 這個醬有點甜，不辣。
The mango has just the right sweetness. 這顆芒果的甜度剛剛好。
Her note carried a warmth and sweetness I missed. 她的便條帶著我很懷念的溫柔與甜美。
The wound on his arm managed to swell up after the insect bite. 他手臂上的傷口在蟲咬後竟然腫了起來。
The river managed to swell due to the heavy and continuous rain. 河水因為持續大雨而竟然漲了起來。
Something described as swept is cleared of mines (explosive devices). 被描述為掃除的物體已清除了地雷（爆炸裝置）。
The word swept is often used to describe a person, thing, or situation. 「掃蕩」這個字常用來形容人、事物或情況。
The company took swift action to address the customer complaint. 公司採取了迅速的行動來處理客戶投訴。
The swallow is a small bird known for its swift and agile flight. 燕子是一種以飛行迅速敏捷聞名的小鳥。
I love to go for a swim in the outdoor pool every morning. 我喜愛每天早上在戶外泳池游泳。
He managed to swim across the lake in just thirty minutes. 他設法在短短三十分鐘內游過了那座湖。
She is the fastest swimmer on the team. 她是隊上最快的游泳選手。
A tired swimmer climbed out of the pool. 一位疲憊的泳者爬出泳池。
She chose swimming because her ankle was healing. 她選擇游泳，因為腳踝還在恢復。
Morning swimming wakes me up faster than coffee. 早晨游泳比咖啡更能讓我清醒。
She bought a beautiful new swimsuit for her summer vacation. 她為暑假買了一件漂亮的新泳裝。
Don't forget to pack your swimsuit; the hotel has a great pool. 別忘了帶上泳裝；飯店有一個很棒的泳池。
The farm keeps fifty swine behind the barn. 那座農場在穀倉後面養了五十頭豬。
That zipper is a swine to fix. 那個拉鍊非常難修。
The old swing squeaks in the wind. 那座老鞦韆在風中吱呀作響。
This band plays jazz with a light swing. 這個樂團演奏帶有輕快搖擺感的爵士樂。
One swipe opened the phone. 輕輕一刷就打開了手機。
He paid with a quick swipe of his card. 他迅速刷了一下卡就完成付款。
I swirled my brush around in the paint. 我在顏料裡旋轉畫筆。
To swirl means to twist or whirl, as an eddy. 漩渦的意思是像渦流一樣扭曲或旋轉。
The skirt will swish when you walk fast. 你走快時，那條裙子會發出沙沙聲。
Rain began to swish through the bamboo leaves. 雨開始掠過竹葉發出沙沙聲。
Please flip the light switch when you leave the office. 離開辦公室時請隨手關燈（撥動開關）。
The company decided to switch to a new software system next year. 公司決定明年更換到一個新的軟體系統。

meaning: 將投資從一個基金轉移到另一個基金。
sentences: Switching jobs can be stressful. 換工作可能很有壓力。
The bank charges a fee for switching funds. 銀行會對轉換基金收取費用。
The bar stool has a smooth swivel. 那張高腳椅有順暢的旋轉裝置。
This lamp needs a wider swivel to face the desk. 這盞燈需要更大的轉動角度才能照到書桌。
My ankle stayed swollen after the hike. 健行後，我的腳踝一直腫著。
Her eyes looked swollen from crying. 她哭過後眼睛看起來腫腫的。
The fans swooned when the famous singer walked onto the stage. 當那位著名歌手走上台時，粉絲們都神魂顛倒了。
She felt like she was about to swoon from the heat. 她覺得自己快要熱得昏過去了。

meaning: 突然向下飛行或滑翔； （在空中）俯衝或急速下降。
sentences: The lone eagle swooped down into the lake, snatching its prey, a small fish. 孤鷹俯衝入湖，抓住了它的獵物——一條小魚。
To swoop means to fly or glide downwards suddenly; to plunge (in the air) or nosedive. 俯衝意味著突然向下飛行或滑翔； （在空中）俯衝或急速下降。
The brave knight unsheathed his sharp silver sword for battle. 勇敢的騎士拔出他那把鋒利的銀劍準備戰鬥。
Ancient swords are often displayed in museums as historical artifacts. 古劍常在博物館中作為歷史文物展示。
The swordsman bowed before the match. 那位劍客在比賽前先行禮。
That film made the old swordsman look graceful. 那部電影把那位老劍客拍得很優雅。
His sworn statement convinced the judge. 他的宣誓陳述說服了法官。
Something described as sworn is given or declared under oath. 所謂宣誓的事是在宣誓下給予或宣告的。
He is surrounded by sycophants who always agree with him. 他身邊圍繞著總是贊同他的諂媚者。
She is not a sycophant and is always honest with her opinions. 她不是個奉承者，對自己的觀點始終誠實。
The word 'banana' has three syllables: ba-na-na. 「banana」這個單字有三個音節：ba-na-na。
Please pronounce each syllable clearly so that everyone can understand you. 請清晰地發出每個音節，以便大家都能聽懂你的話。
The teacher handed out the syllabus for the new course. 老師發放了新課程的教學大綱。
Make sure you read the syllabus carefully before the first class. 上第一堂課前，請務必仔細閱讀課程提綱。
The museum displayed a sylvester beside old mining tools. 博物館把那種拔坑柱棘輪器和舊礦工具擺在一起展出。
Only the guide knew how a sylvester pulled out pit props. 只有導覽員知道那種裝置怎麼把坑柱拉出來。
Clownfish have a symbiotic bond with sea anemones. 小丑魚和海葵之間有共生關係。
The bakery and café built a symbiotic partnership. 麵包店和咖啡館建立了互利共存的合作。
The white dove is a universal symbol of international peace. 白鴿是國際和平的通用象徵。
Each symbol on the map represents a different type of building. 地圖上的每個符號代表不同類型的建築。
The dove is often used as a symbolic representation of peace and harmony. 鴿子常被用作和平與和諧的象徵性代表。
The gift was a symbolic gesture of friendship and cooperation between the countries. 這份禮物是兩國之間友誼與合作的象徵性姿態。

meaning: 將部分或成分組合在一起。
sentences: The white bird is full of symbolism in the story. 故事中的白鳥充滿象徵意義。
Students discussed the symbolism of the river. 學生討論河流的象徵意義。
The white dove is used to symbolize peace and harmony between nations. 白鴿被用來象徵各國之間的和平與和諧。
In many cultures, the color red is used to symbolize luck and happiness. 在許多文化中，紅色被用來代表（象徵）運氣與快樂。

meaning: 集合 S 上的關係 R，使得 xRy 當且僅當 yRx 對 S 的所有成員 x 和 y（也就是說，如果關係在任何元素和第二個元素之間成立，那麼它也在第二個元素和第一個元素之間成立）。
sentences: "Is a sibling of" is a symmetric relation. 「是……的兄弟姊妹」是對稱關係。

Something described as symmetric is of a relation R on a set S, such that xRy if and only if yRx for all members x and y of S (that is, if the relation holds between any element and a second, it also holds between the second and the first). 被描述為對稱的東西是集合 S 上的關係 R，使得 xRy 當且僅當 yRx 對於 S 的所有成員 x 和 y（也就是說，如果該關係在任何元素和第二個元素之間成立，那麼它也在第二個元素和第一個元素之間成立）。
The butterfly has beautiful symmetrical wings. 蝴蝶有著漂亮對稱的翅膀。
The design of the building is perfectly symmetrical. 這棟建築的設計完全對稱。
The building's design features a high level of classical symmetry and beauty. 這座建築的設計展現了高度的古典對稱美。
The artist used symmetry to create a sense of balance in her painting. 藝術家利用對稱性在畫作中創造出一種平衡感。

meaning: 富有同情心的、憐憫的、支持的
sentences: She gave a sympathetic ear to her friend who was going through a hard time. 她耐心地傾聽（給予同情的耳朵）正處於困境的朋友訴苦。
The manager was sympathetic to his request for a few days off due to family issues. 經理對他因家庭問題請假幾天的要求表示理解（支持）。
I can really sympathize with your situation, as I had a similar problem. 我非常同情（理解）你的處境，因為我也有過類似的問題。
While I don't agree with all his views, I do sympathize with his goals. 雖然我不完全同意他的所有觀點，但我認同他的目標。
We expressed our deepest sympathy to the family for their great loss. 我們對那家人的重大損失表示最深切的同情（慰問）。
I have a lot of sympathy for students who have to work while studying. 我非常同情那些必須邊工作邊讀書的學生。
She enjoyed the rich symphonic sound of the concert. 她很享受音樂會中豐富的交響樂聲。
The band incorporated symphonic elements into their rock music. 樂團將交響樂元素融入他們的搖滾音樂中。
The local symphony orchestra performed a selection of classical masterpieces. 當地交響樂團演奏了一系列古典名作。
The young musician's first symphony received a lot of positive reviews. 這位年輕音樂家的首部交響曲獲得了大量好評。

meaning: 討論某個主題的會議或其他會議，尤其是參與者進行演示的會議。
sentences: The hospital hosted a symposium on heart health. 醫院舉辦了一場心臟健康研討會。
Researchers presented their work at the symposium. 研究人員在研討會上發表成果。
A high fever and persistent cough are common symptoms of the flu. 高燒和持續咳嗽是流感的常見症狀。
The sudden increase in crime is a symptom of deeper social problems. 犯罪率的突然增加是深層社會問題的徵兆。

meaning: 構成症狀或指徵；特徵性的、指示性的。
sentences: The city's problems are symptomatic of the crisis that is spreading throughout the country. 這座城市的問題是正在全國蔓延的危機的症狀。
Something described as symptomatic is constituting a symptom or indication; characteristic, indicative. 被描述為有症狀的事物構成症狀或指徵；特徵性的、指示性的。

meaning: 猶太人或撒瑪利亞人的禮拜場所。
sentences: The family walked to the synagogue on Saturday. 那家人星期六走路去猶太教堂。
The old synagogue was restored last year. 那座老猶太教堂去年修復了。

meaning: 突觸。神經元彼此傳遞訊號的連接處。
sentences: A synapse allows one neuron to pass signals to another cell. 突觸讓一個神經元能把訊號傳給另一個細胞。
Learning may strengthen communication at the synapse. 學習可能會增強突觸處的訊息傳遞。

meaning: 突觸的或與之相關的－神經元末端和另一個細胞之間的連接處。
sentences: Synaptic connections help nerve cells communicate. 突觸連結幫助神經細胞溝通。
The study looked at synaptic changes in the brain. 研究觀察大腦中的突觸變化。

meaning: 同步，尤指資料同步、時間同步或音樂與影片同步。
sentences: Our cloud storage automatically syncs your files to all your devices. 我們的雲端儲存會自動將您的檔案同步到您的所有裝置。
He synced his phone to the laptop to transfer data about the field trip. 他將手機與筆記型電腦同步，以傳輸有關實地考察的數據。

meaning: 正在同步的狀態或屬性。
sentences: The app needs synchronization between phone and laptop. 這個程式需要手機和筆電同步。
Good synchronization kept the dancers together. 良好的同步讓舞者動作一致。
Their synchronized steps made the dance look sharp. 他們同步的步伐讓舞蹈看起來很俐落。
The video and audio stayed synchronized all night. 影片和聲音整晚都保持同步。

meaning: 為處理某些特定業務或促進共同利益而組成的個人或公司團體；自協調小組。
sentences: A crime syndicate controlled the port. 一個犯罪集團控制了港口。
Several banks formed a syndicate to fund the project. 幾家銀行組成財團資助這個專案。
Down syndrome is a genetic condition that affects a person's development. 唐氏症候群是一種影響個人發展的遺傳性疾病。
The report highlights the common symptoms of chronic fatigue syndrome. 報告強調了慢性疲勞症候群的常見症狀。
The two teams decided to synergize their efforts to finish the project faster. 這兩個團隊決定協同合作，好讓專案更快完成。
Good leaders know how to synergize different talents within a group. 優秀的領導者懂得如何讓團隊中不同的才能產生綜效。

meaning: 具有民事權力的集會或理事會（正式）；立法機構。
sentences: The synod met to discuss church policy. 教會會議召開，討論教會政策。
Delegates traveled to the synod from many towns. 代表們從許多城鎮前往宗教會議。
The word 'large' is a common synonym for the word 'big' in English. 「large」是英語中「big」一詞常用的同義詞。
Learning synonyms and antonyms can help you broaden your vocabulary. 學習同義詞和反義詞可以幫助你擴大詞彙量。
Please read the synopsis of the book before the discussion. 討論前請先閱讀這本書的大綱。
He provided a brief synopsis of the project's goals. 他提供了該專案目標的簡要摘要。
The editor fixed a syntactic error in the sentence. 編輯修正了句子中的句法錯誤。
Word order can create a syntactic problem for learners. 語序可能會替學習者造成句法上的問題。

meaning: 一組規則，用於控制單字如何組合以形成短語和句子。
sentences: Python syntax is easy to read. 這種程式語法很容易閱讀。
The sentence has unusual syntax. 這個句子的語法很不尋常。
Students synthesize ideas from several articles in the report. 學生在報告中綜合了多篇文章的觀點。
This lab can synthesize the compound in two days. 這間實驗室能在兩天內合成那種化合物。
The jacket is made of a durable synthetic material that is water-resistant. 這件外套是由耐用的合成（人造）材料製成的，具有防水性。
Some modern perfumes are made using synthetic fragrances and chemicals. 一些現代香水是利用合成香精和化學物質製成的。
The nurse used a sterile syringe to administer the injection. 護士利用無菌注射器進行注射。
He needed a new set of needles and syringes for his medication. 他需要一套新的針頭和注射器來用藥。
She poured some sweet maple syrup over her fresh pancakes for breakfast. 她在早餐的新鮮鬆餅上倒了一些甜楓糖漿。
The doctor prescribed a cough syrup to help relieve the patient's symptoms. 醫生開了一種止咳糖漿來幫助緩解病人的症狀。
The new computer system is much faster and more efficient. 新電腦系統速度更快且更高效。
Education is a vital part of the nation's social system. 教育是國家社會制度中至關重要的一部分。
The company needs a more systematic approach to quality control. 公司需要一種更有系統的方法來進行品質控制。
He carried out a systematic search of the entire house to find the missing keys. 他對整個房子進行了有條理的搜尋，以尋找丟失的鑰匙。

meaning: 嵌入並遍及並影響整個系統、團體、機構、經濟、市場或社會。
sentences: Something described as systemic is embedded within and spread throughout and affecting a whole system, group, body, economy, market, or society. 被描述為系統性的東西嵌入並傳播到整個系統、團體、機構、經濟、市場或社會，並影響整個系統、群體、機構、經濟、市場或社會。
The word systemic is often used to describe a person, thing, or situation. 系統性一詞通常用於描述人、事物或情況。
